doi:10.3103/s0005105526700391.abstract: Abstract Contemporary approaches to subword text tokenization are considered in application to the low-resource Tajik language, which is characterised by a complex morphological structure and high variability of word forms. In the course of the study, a large-scale heterogeneous corpus was compiled and preprocessed, comprising 99 books and 134 497 textual articles of various genres and topics, with a total volume exceeding 33 million tokens. The corpus was cleaned of noise, normalised, and used as a basis for training and subsequent testing of subword models. On the basis of this corpus, five tokenization models were trained and analyzed, implementing the BPE, WordPiece, and Unigram algorithms using the Hugging Face Tokenizers and SentencePiece libraries. A comparative assessment was carried out according to a number of key indicators, including the out-of-vocabulary (OOV) rate, text compression ratio, tokenization speed, as well as n-gram distribution characteristics that make it possible to evaluate the ability of the models to reflect the morphological and structural organization of the language. The experimental results revealed the strengths and weaknesses of various approaches to subword segmentation and identified the most effective tokenization strategies under the conditions of the morphological complexity of the Tajik language. The findings may be used in the development of language models and applied NLP tools for Tajik and other low-resource languages, thus contributing to the expansion of their presence in the digital environment.
doi:10.3103/s0005105526700391.title: Analysis of the Efficiency of Subword Tokenizers in a Low-Resource Linguistic Environment: Implementation Experience for the Tajik Language

doi:10.31436/imjm.v25i02.3370.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Falls are a leading cause of injury and disability among older adults, posing a significant public health challenge. In Malaysia, the prevalence of falls among community-dwelling older adults varies widely. Despite the availability of fall prevention programmes, adoption remains limited. This study aimed to assess fall prevention behaviour and its associated factors among older persons attending Klinik Rawatan Keluarga, Hospital Pakar Universiti Sains Malaysia. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A cross-sectional design was employed involving 213 older adults selected via systematic sampling at a primary care clinic in Hospital Pakar Universiti Sains Malaysia. Data on socio-demographics, comorbidities, and fall history were collected. The validated Malay version of the Fall Prevention Knowledge and Behaviour (FPKB) questionnaire was used to evaluate participants’ knowledge and behaviour. Logistic regression analysis were performed to investigate the associations between sociodemographic, medical characteristics, fall history, Fall Risk Assessment (FRA), and Fall Prevention Knowledge with Fall Prevention Behaviours. RESULTS: Results showed that 43.7% had poor fall prevention knowledge, and 44.1% demonstrated inadequate preventive behaviour. Participants with good knowledge had significantly lower odds of poor behaviour (OR=0.425; 95% CI: 0.244–0.740; p=0.002). CONCLUSION: These findings underscore the crucial role of health literacy in fostering effective fall prevention practices. Strengthening educational interventions in clinical settings may enhance behavioural outcomes and reduce fall-related risks among older adults.
doi:10.31436/imjm.v25i02.3370.title: Fall Prevention Behaviour and Its Predictors Among Older Adults in a Tertiary Centre, Malaysia

doi:10.31539/91g0jx56.abstract: Analisis sentimen terhadap ulasan aplikasi e-commerce pada Google Play Store merupakan salah satu pendekatan penting untuk memahami persepsi pengguna. Namun, karakteristik data yang tidak terstruktur, penggunaan bahasa informal, singkatan, serta variasi dialek dan bahasa daerah masih menjadi tantangan dalam proses klasifikasi sentimen. Penelitian ini membandingkan performa tiga Pre-trained Language Model (PLM) berbahasa Indonesia, yaitu BERT Indonesia, RoBERTa Indonesia, dan IndoBERT, dalam mengklasifikasikan sentimen ulasan Tokopedia berbahasa Indonesia. Sebagai pembanding terhadap aspek efisiensi komputasi, DistilBERT Indonesia turut dievaluasi untuk menganalisis trade-off antara performa klasifikasi dan kebutuhan sumber daya komputasi. Dataset penelitian terdiri atas 10.000 ulasan Tokopedia yang diperoleh melalui web scraping menggunakan google_play_scraper. Tahapan penelitian meliputi preprocessing (pembersihan data, normalisasi teks, dan tokenisasi subword), pelabelan sentimen (positif, negatif, dan netral), pembagian data, proses fine-tuning menggunakan pustaka Hugging Face Transformers, serta evaluasi menggunakan metrik accuracy, precision, recall, dan F1-score. Hasil eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa IndoBERT memperoleh performa terbaik dengan akurasi pengujian sebesar 92,65%, diikuti oleh BERT Indonesia (92,15%) dan RoBERTa Indonesia (91,78%), yang menunjukkan bahwa ketiga model menghasilkan performa klasifikasi yang relatif kompetitif dan selisih akurasi yang kecil. Meskipun memiliki akurasi yang sedikit lebih rendah, DistilBERT Indonesia mencapai akurasi 91,78% dengan waktu pelatihan tercepat, sehingga menawarkan efisiensi komputasi yang lebih baik dibandingkan model lainnya. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa pemilihan pretrained language model tidak hanya dipengaruhi oleh tingkat akurasi, tetapi juga oleh karakteristik arsitektur dan efisiensi komputasi yang diperlukan pada proses analisis sentimen berbahasa Indonesia. Kata Kunci: Analisis Sentimen, Natural Language Processing, BERT Indonesia, IndoBERT, Tokopedia.

doi:10.31539/g806q071.abstract: Penelitian ini membandingkan kinerja Support Vector Machine (SVM) dan IndoBERT untuk analisis sentimen komentar YouTube terkait Program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG). Menggunakan 3.177 data komentar (Januari 2025–Maret 2026) yang diklasifikasikan menjadi sentimen positif, negatif, dan netral. Pengujian dilakukan menggunakan pembagian data 80:20. SVM menerapkan praproses penuh dan ekstraksi fitur TF-IDF, sedangkan IndoBERT menggunakan praproses minimal dan fine-tuning. Hasil menunjukkan IndoBERT secara signifikan lebih unggul dengan akurasi 96,52% dan F1-Score 95%, dibandingkan SVM (akurasi 86,87%, F1-Score 85%). Keunggulan ini berkat kemampuan bidireksional IndoBERT dalam memahami konteks bahasa informal. IndoBERT sangat direkomendasikan untuk sistem pemantauan opini publik pada ranah kebijakan pemerintah. Kata kunci : Analisis sentimen, Support Vector Machine, IndoBERT, TF-IDF, Natural Language Processing

Sebuah model bahasa berbasis arsitektur *Transformer* yang dilatih khusus menggunakan korpus bahasa Indonesia.
Metode pembobotan statistik yang mengukur seberapa penting suatu kata dalam dokumen relatif terhadap seluruh korpus.

background.en:
The national leadership transition in Indonesia introduced the strategic Free Nutritious Meal program, triggering massive public discussions and emotional responses across digital platforms such as YouTube. Analyzing these vast volumes of unstructured public opinions is crucial for the government to evaluate public acceptance objectively, yet doing so manually is prone to human bias and linguistic complexities like slang and sarcasm.

While sentiment analysis offers a computational solution to classify text polarity into positive, negative, and neutral, YouTube comments present a challenging linguistic environment characterized by asynchronous interactions, typing errors, and informal dialects. This gap necessitates robust automated systems capable of accurately mapping public sentiment toward government policy.
background.id:
Transisi kepemimpinan nasional di Indonesia menghadirkan Program Makan Bergizi Gratis yang memicu perbincangan masif dan respons emosional di platform digital seperti YouTube. Analisis terhadap volume opini publik yang tidak terstruktur ini sangat krusial bagi pemerintah untuk mengevaluasi penerimaan masyarakat secara objektif, namun pengerjaan secara manual rentan terhadap bias manusia serta kerumitan linguistik seperti bahasa gaul dan sarkasme.

Meskipun analisis sentimen menawarkan solusi komputasi untuk mengklasifikasikan polaritas teks menjadi positif, negatif, dan netral, komentar YouTube menghadirkan lingkungan linguistik yang menantang dengan karakteristik interaksi asinkron, kesalahan ketik, dan dialek informal. Kesenjangan ini menuntut sistem otomatisasi yang tangguh untuk memetakan sentimen publik secara akurat terhadap kebijakan pemerintah.

contributions.en: This study contributes a direct comparative evaluation between a conventional machine learning model, Support Vector Machine using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency, and a Transformer-based deep learning model, IndoBERT, specifically tailored for analyzing messy YouTube comments about a major government policy. It provides empirical evidence regarding the performance trade-offs, showing how deep learning architectures overcome the limitations of traditional token-frequency models in handling neutral sentiments and informal contexts.
contributions.id: Penelitian ini menyumbangkan evaluasi komparatif langsung antara model pembelajaran mesin konvensional, yaitu *Support Vector Machine* menggunakan *Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency*, dan model *deep learning* berarsitektur *Transformer* yaitu *IndoBERT*, yang dirancang khusus untuk menganalisis komentar YouTube yang berantakan mengenai kebijakan besar pemerintah. Studi ini memberikan bukti empiris mengenai pertukaran kinerja, menunjukkan bagaimana arsitektur *deep learning* mengatasi keterbatasan model frekuensi token tradisional dalam menangani sentimen netral dan konteks informal.

future_work.en: The paper does not explicitly detail major future work limitations beyond suggesting dataset expansion, hyperparameter optimization, and comparisons with other models such as Random Forest and Logistic Regression for future studies.
future_work.id: Makalah ini tidak merinci batasan penelitian lanjutan secara mendalam, selain menyarankan perluasan dataset, *hyperparameter optimization*, dan perbandingan dengan model lain seperti *Random Forest* serta *Logistic Regression* untuk studi masa depan.

method.en:
The research adopts a quantitative approach with a comparative experimental design utilizing 3,177 unique YouTube comments collected via scraping between January 2025 and March 2026. The data underwent manual sentiment annotation into positive, negative, and neutral classes, followed by an 80:20 random split into 2,545 training samples and 632 testing samples.

The pipeline applies distinct preprocessing approaches: the Support Vector Machine pipeline uses radical preprocessing including text cleaning, case folding, tokenization, stopword removal, and stemming via PySastrawi, followed by Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency feature extraction. Conversely, the IndoBERT pipeline utilizes minimal preprocessing, keeping token structures intact, and undergoes fine-tuning over three epochs using the AdamW optimizer. Evaluation uses a confusion matrix measuring accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
method.id:
Penelitian ini mengadopsi pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain eksperimen komparatif menggunakan 3.177 komentar YouTube unik yang dikumpulkan melalui *scraping* antara Januari 2025 hingga Maret 2026. Data menjalani anotasi sentimen manual ke dalam kelas positif, negatif, dan netral, diikuti pembagian acak 80:20 menjadi 2.545 sampel pelatihan dan 632 sampel pengujian.

Alur pemrosesan menerapkan pendekatan praproses yang berbeda: alur *Support Vector Machine* menggunakan praproses radikal yang mencakup *cleaning* teks, *case folding*, *tokenization*, *stopword removal*, dan *stemming* melalui PySastrawi, diikuti ekstraksi fitur *Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency*. Sebaliknya, alur *IndoBERT* menggunakan praproses minimal, menjaga struktur token tetap utuh, dan melalui proses *fine-tuning* selama tiga *epoch* menggunakan *optimizer* AdamW. Evaluasi menggunakan *confusion matrix* yang mengukur akurasi, *precision*, *recall*, dan F1-*score*.

related_work.en:
Previous literature highlights the stability of linear kernel Support Vector Machines in classifying public responses when applied to heavily preprocessed text. Other studies comparing algorithms indicate that IndoBERT models frequently surpass traditional machine learning in handling Indonesian informal language structures and achieving higher F1-scores due to contextual embeddings, although Support Vector Machines remain advantageous in computational efficiency and lighter hardware resource consumption.

Despite these existing evaluations, comparative research directly pitting classical Support Vector Machines against IndoBERT specifically on YouTube comment datasets regarding the Free Nutritious Meal policy remains very limited. This study addresses that specific research gap by evaluating model adaptability on heterogeneous public language.
related_work.id:
Literatur sebelumnya menyoroti stabilitas *Support Vector Machine* ber-*kernel* linear dalam mengklasifikasikan respons publik ketika diterapkan pada teks yang telah melalui praproses ketat. Studi perbandingan algoritma lainnya mengindikasikan bahwa model *IndoBERT* kerap melampaui pembelajaran mesin tradisional dalam menangani struktur bahasa informal Indonesia dan mencapai F1-*score* lebih tinggi berkat *contextual embedding*, meskipun *Support Vector Machine* tetap memiliki keunggulan dalam efisiensi komputasi dan konsumsi sumber daya perangkat keras yang lebih ringan.

Terlepas dari evaluasi yang ada, riset komparatif yang menghadapkan langsung *Support Vector Machine* klasik dengan *IndoBERT* secara khusus pada dataset komentar YouTube mengenai kebijakan Makan Bergizi Gratis masih sangat terbatas. Penelitian ini mengatasi kesenjangan riset tersebut dengan mengevaluasi adaptabilitas model pada bahasa publik yang heterogen.

results.en: The results demonstrate that IndoBERT significantly outperforms the Support Vector Machine model across all metrics, achieving an accuracy of 96.52% and an F1-score of 95%, compared to the Support Vector Machine's 86.87% accuracy and 85% F1-score. IndoBERT particularly excels in classifying neutral sentiments, obtaining a recall of 0.97 compared to 0.71 for the Support Vector Machine, which struggled with lexical overlap between neutral and negative comments. The authors attribute IndoBERT's superiority to its bidirectional self-attention mechanism, which effectively decodes ambiguous informal slang and context-dependent terms like enak.
results.id: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa *IndoBERT* secara signifikan mengungguli model *Support Vector Machine* di seluruh metrik, dengan mencapai akurasi 96,52% dan F1-*score* 95%, dibandingkan akurasi 86,87% dan F1-*score* 85% pada *Support Vector Machine*. *IndoBERT* sangat unggul dalam mengklasifikasikan sentimen netral, memperoleh *recall* 0,97 dibandingkan 0,71 pada *Support Vector Machine* yang mengalami kesulitan akibat tumpang tindih leksikal antara komentar netral dan negatif. Para penulis mengatribusikan keunggulan *IndoBERT* pada mekanisme *self-attention* dua arah yang secara efektif mendekode bahasa gaul informal yang ambigu dan istilah yang bergantung pada konteks seperti enak.

tldr.en: This study compares Support Vector Machine and IndoBERT for sentiment analysis of YouTube comments regarding the Free Nutritious Meal program. The results demonstrate that IndoBERT significantly outperforms the traditional machine learning model by achieving superior accuracy and F1-score.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini membandingkan *Support Vector Machine* dan *IndoBERT* untuk analisis sentimen komentar YouTube terkait Program Makan Bergizi Gratis. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa *IndoBERT* secara signifikan mengungguli model pembelajaran mesin tradisional dengan mencapai akurasi dan F1-*score* yang lebih tinggi.

doi:10.31571/gervasi.v10i2.11003.abstract: Kegiatan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (PKM) ini dilaksanakan di wilayah tepian Sungai Kapuas, Kota Pontianak. Kegiatan ini dilatarbelakangi oleh masih dominannya penggunaan bahasa daerah dalam komunikasi sehari-hari masyarakat, serta kurangnya kesadaran dalam menerapkan bahasa Indonesia yang baik dan benar, khususnya dalam konteks formal maupun sosial. Tujuan kegiatan adalah meningkatkan pengetahuan, kesadaran, dan keterampilan masyarakat dalam menggunakan bahasa Indonesia secara tepat melalui pendekatan Participatory Action Research (PAR). Metode pelaksanaan terdiri atas tiga tahap: persiapan (observasi dan wawancara), pelaksanaan program (sosialisasi, edukasi kebahasaan, dan pendampingan interaktif), serta evaluasi (penilaian perubahan sikap dan praktik berbahasa). Sasaran kegiatan PKM ini adalah 15 orang masyarakat. Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan peningkatan signifikan dalam penggunaan bahasa Indonesia yang baik dan benar, terbentuknya sikap positif, serta meningkatnya kebanggaan terhadap bahasa nasional. Kegiatan ini berdampak positif dalam membangun kebiasaan berbahasa yang sesuai kaidah dan meningkatkan kemampuan komunikasi masyarakat.

doi:10.31764/jmm.v10i4.40922.abstract: Abstrak: Keris merupakan warisan budaya takbenda Indonesia yang diakui UNESCO dan dilestarikan di Museum Keris Nusantara (MKN). Namun, penyampaian nilai sejarah, filosofi, dan budaya keris di MKN belum optimal dalam menjangkau generasi muda dan audiens internasional karena belum tersedia video promosi-edukasi tematik dwibahasa yang persuasif dan tervalidasi secara kuratorial maupun linguistik. Kegiatan pengabdian ini bertujuan meningkatkan literasi budaya melalui pengembangan video promosi-edukasi berbasis kolaborasi internasional. Program dilaksanakan melalui enam tahapan menggunakan metode pendampingan partisipatif dengan model komunikasi persuasif AIDA serta pendekatan communicative translation dan transcreation, melibatkan tiga mitra, yaitu Universitas Sebelas Maret (UNS), MKN, dan The University of Western Australia (UWA), yang berjumlah 25 peserta, dengan evaluasi melalui Focus Group Discussion dan skala ordinal 1–5 pada setiap tahapan. Kegiatan menghasilkan lima video promosi-edukasi dwibahasa dengan capaian 83% pada indikator keberhasilan terpenuhi penuh. Program ini berkontribusi pada SDG 4 (Quality Education) dan SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals) melalui peningkatan literasi budaya, pengalaman project-based learning, dan kolaborasi internasional lintas institusi. Kegiatan ini menghasilkan lima video promosi-edukasi dwibahasa dengan 83% indikator keberhasilan luaran tercapai penuh; angka ini menunjukkan keberhasilan proses dan produk, bukan pengukuran langsung literasi budaya penerima manfaat. Uji coba awal terhadap evaluasi literasi pada lima audiens internasional dari negara berbeda menunjukkan respons sangat positif (rata-rata 4,64 dari 5); seluruh respons berada pada kategori setuju hingga sangat setuju. Program ini berpotensi mendukung SDG 4 dan SDG 17 melalui penyediaan media edukasi budaya tervalidasi dan kolaborasi lintas institusi, sementara pengukuran dampak berskala lebih luas direkomendasikan sebagai tindak lanjut.Abstract: The kris is an Indonesian intangible cultural heritage recognized by UNESCO and preserved at Museum Keris Nusantara (MKN). However, the communication of its historical, philosophical, and cultural values at MKN has not yet effectively reached younger generations and international audiences due to the absence of thematic, bilingual promotional-educational videos that are both persuasive and validated curatorially and linguistically. This community engagement program aimed to enhance cultural literacy through the development of promotional-educational videos based on international collaboration. The program was implemented through six stages using a participatory mentoring method with the AIDA persuasive communication model, communicative translation, and transcreation approaches, involving three partners. They are Universitas Sebelas Maret (UNS), MKN, and The University of Western Australia (UWA)—and about 25 participants, with evaluation conducted through Focus Group Discussions and a 1–5 ordinal scale at each stage. The program produced five bilingual promotional-educational videos, with 83% of success indicators fully achieved. This program contributes to SDG 4 (Quality Education) and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals) through enhanced cultural literacy, project-based learning experiences, and international cross-institutional collaboration. The program produced five bilingual promotional-educational videos, with 83% of output success indicators fully achieved; this reflects the success of the development and validation process rather than a directly measured improvement in beneficiaries’ cultural literacy. An initial literacy assesment with five international viewers from different countries showed highly positive responses (mean 4.64 of 5), all within the agree-to-strongly-agree range. The program supports SDG 4 and SDG 17 through validated cultural-education media and cross-institutional collaboration, while larger-scale impact measurement is recommended as a follow-up.

doi:10.31851/7zhd1n78.abstract: This study evaluates the reading materials in the English for Nusantara Grade VIII textbook through Cunningsworth’s (1995) eight textbook evaluation criteria, with particular attention to reading texts and related activities in Chapters 1–5. Using a qualitative descriptive design and document-based content analysis, the study examined the selected chapters through a 22-item evaluation checklist derived from the eight criteria. Each indicator was categorized as “Fulfilled,” “Partially Fulfilled,” or “Not Fulfilled.” The findings show that 16 indicators were fulfilled, four were partially fulfilled, and two were not fulfilled. Overall, the reading materials correspond closely with the Phase D learning outcomes of Indonesia’s Merdeka Curriculum and demonstrate a consistent before-, during-, and after-reading structure. However, the integration of grammar, initial text exposure, and pronunciation support varies across chapters. The findings provide practical implications for EFL teachers adapting reading instruction, textbook developers revising English for Nusantara, and curriculum evaluators examining reading pedagogy at the junior high school level. Unlike previous comprehensive textbook evaluations that primarily examined individual language skills, this study applies Cunningsworth’s eight-criteria framework specifically and systematically to reading materials at the chapter and unit levels, revealing structural patterns that may otherwise remain overlooked.

doi:10.31851/brqh6k12.abstract: Indonesian and Malay are closely related languages that share a high degree of lexical and pragmatic similarity, enabling intercomprehension among their speakers. This linguistic proximity provides significant potential for developing more effective instructional approaches in Indonesian for Speakers of Other Languages (BIPA), particularly for Malay-speaking learners. This study aims to analyze the forms of lexical and pragmatic intercomprehension between Indonesian and Malay as represented in the Upin & Ipin animated episode Susanti Jangan Pergi and to examine their implications for BIPA instruction. Employing a qualitative approach, this study adopts Qualitative Content Analysis as proposed by Schreier to examine the dialogue transcript as the primary data source. The findings reveal that intercomprehension is manifested through identical lexical items, near-identical vocabulary, distinct lexical forms, false friends, and shared pragmatic strategies, including greetings, politeness expressions, apologies, and emotional expressions. These linguistic and pragmatic similarities enable Malay speakers to comprehend most Indonesian utterances through positive transfer and the activation of their existing linguistic repertoire. Furthermore, the study demonstrates that Upin & Ipin serves as an authentic learning resource by presenting contextualized and communicative language use that reflects the close linguistic and cultural relationship between Indonesia and Malaysia. This study contributes to the growing body of research on intercomprehension among closely related languages while providing an empirical foundation for designing more adaptive BIPA instructional materials tailored to the linguistic background of Malay-speaking learners

doi:10.31851/brqh6k12.venue: Parataksis Jurnal Bahasa Sastra dan Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia

doi:10.31963/rial.v4i2.6460.abstract: This study explores vocabulary acquisition outcomes and learner perceptions among fourth-grade students at SDN 005 Mentarang, a remotely situated primary school in Kalimantan, following instruction delivered through a culturally responsive English Language Teaching (ELT) framework built on Dayak Punan oral traditions. Adopting a descriptive quantitative design, the investigation drew on two data sources: a structured vocabulary test and a five-item Likert-scale perception questionnaire administered to thirty purposively selected participants. The vocabulary test yielded a class mean of 74.67, with 66.67% of students satisfying the Minimum Mastery Criterion (KKM) and 63.33% attaining Good or Excellent proficiency ratings. Questionnaire analysis produced a strongly positive aggregate reception, with 89.86% of all responses falling within the Agree or Strongly Agree categories; items measuring learning motivation (96.5%) and vocabulary retention (90.0%) recorded the highest endorsement rates. These findings affirm the instructional value of anchoring English vocabulary teaching in indigenous cultural materials and carry meaningful implications for ELT curriculum development in geographically remote and culturally distinct Indonesian learning environments.

doi:10.32497/bangunrekaprima.v12i1.7888.abstract: Indonesian language learning at Semarang State Polytechnic is a means to develop students' language skills, both spoken and written. They are required to master soft skills in communication and teamwork as the main foundation before entering the workforce. The purpose of this study is to conduct real performance and optimize the competencies of Semarang State Polytechnic students to be creative and collaborative, maximizing language competence and working together with a team. The method used in this study is an exploratory study on Indonesian language learning and case studies on various activities carried out by students in producing videography worthy of appreciation. The data in this study are in the form of six videos recorded by students to demonstrate their competence in communication while showing the performance of their respective teams. The results of this study are that Semarang State Polytechnic students can improve the quality of the process and outcomes of Indonesian language learning because not only prioritize individual independent competence but learning is based on solid and comprehensive teamwork. Team-based projects can train students in problem management, train comprehension, and improve communication and collaboration skills with a team.
doi:10.32497/bangunrekaprima.v12i1.7888.title: VIDEOGRAFI MAHASISWA BERBASIS TEAM BASED PROJECT PEMBELAJARAN BAHASA INDONESIA DI POLITEKNIK NEGERI SEMARANG

doi:10.32877/bt.v9i1.4130.abstract: Plagiarism remains a serious threat to academic integrity, while most available detection tools operate through literal word matching and are therefore easily defeated by paraphrasing. This study implements the pre-trained IndoBERT model without fine-tuning as a semantic-similarity screening tool for Indonesian-language student assignment documents, using a two-level scheme: a chunk-level similarity score (200 words with a 50-word overlap) as a document-level indicator, and one-to-one sentence alignment as a locator of similar passages. A 768-dimensional embedding is formed through attention-masked mean pooling followed by L2 normalization, and vectors are compared using cosine similarity at a 0.92 threshold. Evaluation was conducted on 20 pairs drawn from 15 documents, of which only 11 were authentic student submissions while 4 were controls derived from a single source document through graded paraphrasing. Similarity scores decreased across the four control conditions ordered by intended paraphrase intensity, namely 100%, 66.67%, 42.34%, and 26.67%, whereas same-theme original pairs averaged 5.93%. Against a proxy sentence-level ground truth, the system obtained 84.79% accuracy, 96.82% precision, 61.13% recall, and a 74.94% F1-score with a 1.19% false positive rate. A User Acceptance Testing exercise with six respondents yielded an index of 82.56%, describing only the participating group rather than general acceptance. These results provide preliminary evidence that the two-level scheme is feasible as an initial semantic-similarity indicator, with the final judgment of plagiarism remaining with the examiner.
doi:10.32877/bt.v9i1.4130.title: Paraphrase Plagiarism Detection in Student Assignments Using IndoBERT and Two-Level Cosine Similarity

doi:10.32890/ahjmm2026.4.14.abstract: ABSTRAK Islam di Malaysia diangkat sebagai agama rasmi Persekutuan di bawah perkara 3 (1) Perlembagaan, namun penganut agama lain tetap bebas untuk mengamalkan kepercayaan masing-masing dalam suasana aman. Majoriti penganut agama Islam adalah orang Melayu yang sedia hidup bersama kaum lain daripada latar belakang berbeza secara harmoni. Keharmonian di Malaysia bukan wujud secara vakum, sebaliknya Islam menjadi faktor dominan yang mencorakkan 'sikap akomodatif orang Melayu' terhadap kepelbagaian etnik serta agama. Namun, konsep 'sikap akomodatif Melayu' lazimnya digunakan secara longgar dan kadang kala disamaratakan dengan istilah toleransi, kompromi atau pluralisme sekular. Malah sering disalahertikan sebagai toleransi pasif di tengah-tengah kegelisahan golongan minoriti terhadap tekanan kontemporari dalam era digitalisasi. Meskipun wacana perpaduan sering dibincangkan secara normatif, terdapat jurang analitis dalam mengadun mekanisme integratif secara hierarki yang merangkumi dimensi sejarah peradaban, perundangan, teologi dan sosiobudaya secara serentak. Artikel ini bertujuan mengkonseptualisasikan sikap akomodatif orang Melayu melalui analisis empat dimensi; sejarah peradaban Melayu, Perlembagaan Persekutuan, pendekatan nilai Islam dan sosiobudaya Melayu. Kaedah kualitatif berasaskan analisis kandungan digunakan terhadap sumber sekunder daripada jurnal akademik, prosiding, buku, tesis dan dokumen dasar kerajaan. Dapatan menunjukkan bahawa keharmonian di Malaysia dipacu oleh integrasi dinamik empat mekanisme utama: (i) Akar sejarah peradaban Melayu yang terbuka; (ii) Prinsip keadilan Islam melalui kerangka perlembagaan; (iii) pendekatan nilai universal Islam berasaskan model Piagam Madinah; serta (iv) manifestasi etika harian melalui penerapan nilai-nilai Islam dalam sosiobudaya Melayu. Integrasi keempat-empat mekanisme ini membuktikan bahawa keharmonian di Malaysia bukanlah sebuah "kebetulan sejarah" atau retorik politik semata-mata tetapi merupakan hasil daripada pengaruh dominan Islam yang membentuk orientasi sosial orang Melayu menjadi komuniti yang terbuka, adil dan akomodatif, sekali gus tunjang kepada kestabilan dan keharmonian nasional dalam kepelbagaian etnik di Malaysia. ABSTRACT In Malaysia, Islam is enshrined as the religion of the Federation under Article 3(1) of the Federal Constitution, yet adherents of other faiths remain free to practice their respective religions in a peaceful environment. The majority of Muslims are Malays who have long coexisted harmoniously with other ethnic groups from diverse backgrounds. This national harmony does not exist in a vacuum; rather, Islam serves as the dominant factor that shapes the 'accommodative attitude of the Malays' toward ethnic and religious plurality. However, the concept of 'Malay accommodative attitude' is often used loosely and is occasionally equated with terms such as tolerance, compromise, or secular pluralism. Furthermore, it is frequently misinterpreted as passive tolerance amidst minority anxieties regarding contemporary pressures in the digital era. Although discourse on unity is often discussed normatively, there remains an analytical gap in synthesizing hierarchical integrative mechanisms that simultaneously encompass the dimensions of civilizational history, legislation, theology, and socio-culture. This article aims to conceptualize the accommodative attitude of the Malays through a four-dimensional analytical framework: Malay civilizational history, the Federal Constitution, Islamic value approaches, and Malay socio-culture. A qualitative method based on content analysis was employed, utilizing secondary sources such as academic journals, proceedings, books, theses, and government policy documents. Findings indicate that harmony in Malaysia is driven by the dynamic integration of four primary mechanisms: (i) the open roots of Malay civilizational history; (ii) the principles of Islamic justice within the constitutional framework; (iii) a universal Islamic value approach based on the Medina Charter model; and (iv) the manifestation of daily ethics through the application of Islamic values within Malay socio-culture. The integration of these four mechanisms proves that harmony in Malaysia is neither a "historical accident" nor mere political rhetoric; instead, it is the result of dominant Islamic influence that shapes the social orientation of the Malays into an open, just, and accommodative community, thereby serving as the backbone of national stability and harmony within Malaysia's ethnic diversity.

doi:10.33003/fjs-2026-1015-5225.abstract: The increasing dependence of Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems on large-scale textual datasets has intensified the use of automated data collection methods such as web scraping, crawling, and autonomous extraction pipelines. While these approaches improve scalability and support the development of Large Language Models (LLMs), they also raise important ethical concerns, particularly in indigenous and low-resource language contexts. Existing data collection systems primarily prioritize data availability and technical efficiency, often overlooking issues related to privacy, cultural sensitivity, consent, and community-centered governance. Consequently, automated pipelines may collect personally identifiable information (PII), culturally sensitive narratives, and indigenous knowledge without adequate contextual understanding or ethical safeguards. This paper proposes an ethical-by-design framework for autonomous indigenous language data collection using an LLM-based multi-agent architecture. The framework integrates ethical safeguards directly into system operations through context-aware filtering, hybrid PII detection, cultural sensitivity classification, and auditability mechanisms. A Design Science Research methodology was adopted to develop and evaluate the framework using scenario-based validation involving privacy-sensitive and culturally sensitive textual data. The evaluation demonstrates that the proposed approach supports transparent and accountable data collection while reducing ethical risks associated with privacy violations and inappropriate extraction of culturally protected information. This study contributes to ongoing research in responsible AI, indigenous data governance, and ethical NLP by demonstrating how ethical principles can be operationalized within autonomous data collection infrastructures. The proposed framework provides a foundation for the development of transparent, culturally aware, and privacy-conscious NLP data collection systems for indigenous and low-resource language technologies.

glossary.explanation_id: Teknik otomatis untuk mengekstrak data dari halaman *web* secara massal.
*Architecture* sistem komputasi di mana beberapa *agent* otonom berinteraksi untuk menyelesaikan tugas yang kompleks.
Informasi apa pun yang dapat digunakan untuk mengidentifikasi seseorang secara langsung maupun tidak langsung.
Metode perancangan instruksi teks untuk memandu keluaran dari *large language model* secara akurat.
Metodologi penelitian yang berfokus pada penciptaan dan evaluasi artefak inovatif untuk memecahkan masalah praktis.

background.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence and natural language processing relies heavily on large-scale textual datasets obtained through automated data collection methods such as web scraping and crawling. While these techniques improve scalability and support the training of large language models, they often prioritize technical efficiency over privacy, cultural sensitivity, and informed consent. In indigenous and low-resource language contexts, this can lead to the unauthorized harvesting of personally identifiable information and culturally sensitive knowledge, raising serious concerns regarding data colonialism.
background.id: Perkembangan pesat kecerdasan buatan dan pengolahan bahasa alami sangat bergantung pada *dataset* teks berskala besar yang diperoleh melalui metode pengumpulan data otomatis seperti *web scraping* dan *crawling*. Meskipun teknik-teknik ini meningkatkan skalabilitas dan mendukung pelatihan *large language model*, metode tersebut sering kali mengutamakan efisiensi teknis di atas privasi, sensitivitas budaya, dan persetujuan yang diinformasikan. Dalam konteks bahasa adat dan *low-resource*, hal ini dapat berujung pada pengambilan informasi pengenal pribadi serta pengetahuan yang sensitif secara budaya tanpa izin, yang memicu kekhawatiran serius terkait kolonialisme data.

contributions.en: The main contributions of this paper include the development of an ethical-by-design framework for autonomous indigenous language data collection, the integration of privacy protection and cultural sensitivity mechanisms into LLM-based agent systems, and the introduction of transparent audit and accountability mechanisms for traceable data processing decisions.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama dari makalah ini mencakup pengembangan *framework* berdesain etis untuk pengumpulan data bahasa adat secara otonom, integrasi mekanisme perlindungan privasi dan klasifikasi sensitivitas budaya ke dalam sistem *agent* berbasis *large language model*, serta pengenalan mekanisme audit dan akuntabilitas yang transparan untuk keputusan pemrosesan data yang dapat dilacak.

future_work.en: The authors state that future research should focus on large-scale empirical validation, community-informed governance mechanisms, and adaptation of the framework across diverse multilingual settings.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyatakan bahwa penelitian masa depan harus berfokus pada validasi empiris berskala besar, mekanisme tata kelola yang diinformasikan oleh komunitas, dan adaptasi *framework* di berbagai pengaturan *multilingual* yang beragam.

method.en: The study employs a Design Science Research methodology to develop and evaluate an ethical-by-design framework centered around an LLM-based multi-agent architecture. The architecture consists of four interconnected components: ethical governance, agent intelligence, processing and validation, and accountability and auditability. The processing pipeline combines rule-based pattern matching with LLM-based contextual reasoning for privacy protection, alongside a three-level cultural sensitivity classification model to categorize content into public, sensitive, or restricted categories. Evaluation is conducted using scenario-based validation involving privacy-sensitive and culturally sensitive textual data.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan metodologi *Design Science Research* untuk mengembangkan dan mengevaluasi *framework* berdesain etis yang berpusat pada *architecture* *multi-agent* berbasis *large language model*. *Architecture* tersebut terdiri dari empat komponen yang saling terhubung: tata kelola etis, kecerdasan *agent*, pemrosesan dan validasi, serta akuntabilitas dan auditabilitas. *Pipeline* pemrosesan menggabungkan pencocokan pola berbasis aturan dengan penalaran kontekstual berbasis *large language model* untuk perlindungan privasi, beserta model klasifikasi sensitivitas budaya tiga tingkat untuk mengkategorikan konten ke dalam kategori publik, sensitif, atau terbatas. Evaluasi dilakukan menggunakan validasi berbasis skenario yang melibatkan data teks yang sensitif terhadap privasi dan budaya.

related_work.en: Prior research highlights significant ethical challenges in automated data collection, notably the phenomenon of data colonialism where marginalized communities contribute linguistic data without control or benefit. Indigenous Data Sovereignty frameworks, such as the CARE Principles, emphasize collective benefit, authority to control, responsibility, and ethics in data management. Additionally, Responsible AI research has introduced concepts like AI4People and datasheets for datasets to improve transparency. However, the authors note that these existing frameworks remain largely policy-oriented and are rarely integrated directly into automated NLP data collection pipelines.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya menyoroti tantangan etis yang signifikan dalam pengumpulan data otomatis, terutama fenomena kolonialisme data di mana komunitas terpinggirkan menyumbangkan data linguistik tanpa kendali atau keuntungan. *Framework* Kedaulatan Data Adat, seperti Prinsip CARE, menekankan manfaat kolektif, otoritas untuk mengontrol, tanggung jawab, dan etika dalam manajemen data. Selain itu, penelitian *Responsible AI* telah memperkenalkan konsep seperti AI4People dan *datasheets for datasets* untuk meningkatkan transparansi. Namun, para penulis mencatat bahwa *framework* yang ada ini sebagian besar masih berorientasi pada kebijakan dan jarang diintegrasikan secara langsung ke dalam *pipeline* pengumpulan data *NLP* otomatis.

results.en: The evaluation demonstrates that the proposed framework successfully supports context-aware filtering, privacy protection, and transparent decision-making. Rule-based mechanisms combined with LLM-based contextual analysis effectively detected both explicit and implicit personally identifiable information. Furthermore, the cultural sensitivity classification model successfully distinguished between public informational content, sensitive narratives flagged for review, and restricted sacred practices. The integrated audit trail mechanism successfully recorded metadata and processing histories to ensure traceability.
results.id: Evaluasi menunjukkan bahwa *framework* yang diusulkan berhasil mendukung penyaringan sadar konteks, perlindungan privasi, dan pengambilan keputusan yang transparan. Mekanisme berbasis aturan yang dikombinasikan dengan analisis kontekstual berbasis *large language model* secara efektif mendeteksi informasi pengenal pribadi yang eksplisit maupun implisit. Selain itu, model klasifikasi sensitivitas budaya berhasil membedakan antara konten informasional publik, narasi sensitif yang ditandai untuk ditinjau, dan praktik sakral yang dibatasi. Mekanisme jejak audit yang terintegrasi berhasil mencatat metadata dan riwayat pemrosesan untuk memastikan ketertelusuran.

tldr.en: This paper proposes an ethical-by-design framework for autonomous indigenous language data collection using an LLM-based multi-agent architecture. The evaluation demonstrates that the approach supports transparent and accountable data collection while reducing privacy and cultural sensitivity risks.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengusulkan sebuah *framework* berdesain etis untuk pengumpulan data bahasa adat secara otonom menggunakan *architecture* berbasis *large language model* dengan *multi-agent*. Evaluasi menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan ini mendukung pengumpulan data yang transparan dan akuntabel sekaligus mengurangi risiko privasi serta sensitivitas budaya.

doi:10.33003/fjs-2026-1015-5225.title: Ethical Safeguards in Autonomous Data Collection: Protecting Cultural Context and Privacy in Indigenous Language NLP

doi:10.33022/ijcs.v15i4.5195.abstract: The spread of hoax news in Indonesian online media has become an increasing concern, highlighting the need for accurate automatic detection systems. This study proposes an integrated hoax detection approach that combines IndoBERT, which captures semantic context in Indonesian text, with a Knowledge Graph that verifies relationships between entities. IndoBERT's performance is also compared with SVM+TF-IDF, FastText, 1D-CNN, and LSTM. Experimental results show that IndoBERT achieves the highest performance, reaching 98.05% accuracy on headline data and 96.35% on narrative data using a dataset of 8,433 news articles. Although the Knowledge Graph alone produces lower accuracy, it enhances information verification by validating entity relationships. Integrating IndoBERT and the Knowledge Graph using a 90:10 weighting scheme further improves overall performance, achieving 98.00% accuracy on headline data and 96.20% on narrative data. The proposed approach provides a more accurate and comprehensive solution for Indonesian hoax detection.
doi:10.33022/ijcs.v15i4.5195.title: Indonesian Hoax News Detection Using IndoBERT and Knowledge Graph

doi:10.33024/jkpm.v9i9.27186.abstract: ABSTRAK Bahasa Alune merupakan salah satu bahasa daerah yang digunakan oleh masyarakat adat di Kabupaten Seram BagianBarat, Provinsi Maluku, Indonesia. Dalam beberapa tahun terakhir, terjadi kecenderungan menurunnya penggunaan Bahasa Alune pada generasi muda, terutama dalam konteks pendidikan formal. Salah satu faktor penyebabnya adalahbelum tersedianya buku ajar yang sistematis dan berbasis budaya lokal, serta terbatasnya kapasitas penutur jatidalam pengembangan bahan ajar. Program ini bertujuan untuk memberdayakan penutur jati dalam pengembanganbuku ajar Bahasa Alune melalui pendekatan partisipatif dan berbasis komunitas. Metode yang digunakan adalahParticipatory Action (PAR) dengan tahapan: persiapan dan koordinasi, pelatihan dokumentasi bahasa, pengumpulankosakata dan teks budaya, penyusunan buku ajar secara kolaboratif, uji coba terbatas di sekolah mitra, serta finalisasi produk. Luaran yang ditargetkan meliputi: (1) draf buku ajar Bahasa Alune tingkat dasar; (2) terdokumentasinya minimal 500 kosakata dan beberapa teks budaya, serta (4) peningkatan kapasitas minimal 15penutur jati dalam penyusunan materi ajar. Buku ajar disusun secara tematik dan komunikatif denganmengintegrasikan nilai budaya masyarakat Alune. Program ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat pelestarian BahasaAlune melalui jalur pendidikan formal serta membangun kemitraan berkelanjutan antara komunitas penutur dan Universitas Pattimura. Dengan demikian, kegiatan ini tidak hanya menghasilkan produk pembelajaran, tetapi jugameningkatkan kapasitas komunitas sebagai agen pelestarian bahasa daerah. Kata Kunci: Penutur Jati, Bahasa Alune, Buku Ajar. ABSTRACT Alune is one of the indigenous languages spoken by the local community in West Seram Regency, Maluku Province, Indonesia. In recent years, the use of the Alune language among younger generations has shown a declining trend, particularly within formal educational settings. One of the main contributing factors is the lack of systematic, culturally based teaching materials, as well as the limited capacity of native speakers to develop instructional resources. This program aims to empower native speakers to develop an Alune language textbook through a participatory and community-based approach. The program employs the Participatory Action Research (PAR) method, which consists of several stages: preparation and coordination, language documentation training, collection of vocabulary and cultural texts, collaborative textbook development, limited pilot implementation in partner schools, and finalization of the teaching materials. The expected outputs include: (1) a draft of an elementary-level Alune language textbook; (2) documentation of at least 500 vocabulary items and several cultural texts; and (3) enhanced capacity of at least 15 native speakers in developing language teaching materials. The textbook is designed using thematic and communicative approaches while integrating the cultural values of the Alune community. This program is expected to strengthen the preservation of the Alune language through formal education and to establish sustainable partnerships between the Alune-speaking community and Pattimura University. Ultimately, the program is intended not only to produce quality learning materials but also to enhance the community's capacity as active agents in preserving their indigenous language. Keywords: Native Speakers, Alune Language, Textbook.
doi:10.33024/jkpm.v9i9.27186.title: Pemberdayaan Komunitas Penutur Jati Dalam Pengembangan Buku Ajar Bahasa Alune sebagai Upaya Revitalisasi Bahasa Daerah di Desa Patahuwe Kabupaten Seram Bagian Barat

doi:10.33087/sjee.v10i2.428.abstract: Indonesia is a country with extraordinary linguistic diversity, with more than 718 regional languages, making almost all elementary school students grow up in multilingual environments. This study aims to identify the complexity of multilingual use among elementary school students in Indonesia, examine its implications for speaking and listening skills in Indonesian language learning, and formulate appropriate and responsive learning strategies. The method employed is a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) by searching Google Scholar, Garuda, Semantic Scholar, and Publish or Perish databases using keywords for the period 2016–2026, yielding 15 selected articles after four rigorous selection stages from 150 initial sources. The findings reveal that multilingual complexity among elementary students manifests in three main forms: language interference, code-mixing, and code-switching, all of which directly affect students' speaking and listening achievement. In speaking skills, first-language interference and low self-confidence are the primary barriers, while storytelling methods, role-playing, and integrated multilingual programs have proven effective in overcoming them. In listening skills, multilingual cognitive load and monotonous teaching methods are obstacles that can be addressed through audiovisual media and locally-based cultural media. This study affirms that multilingualism is not an obstacle but a linguistic potential that must be managed through translanguaging approaches, experience-based learning, creative media utilization, and inclusive curriculum design. Teachers' competence in understanding students' linguistic diversity is the key to the success of all these strategies.

glossary.explanation_id: Praktik pedagogis yang memanfaatkan seluruh repertoar linguistik siswa multibahasa sebagai sumber daya dalam proses pembelajaran.
Fenomena peralihan penuh dari satu bahasa ke bahasa lain secara bergantian dalam suatu percakapan.
Penyisipan unsur kata atau frasa dari bahasa lain ke dalam tuturan bahasa utama yang sedang digunakan.
Masuknya unsur sistem bahasa pertama ke dalam penggunaan bahasa kedua yang sedang dipelajari.
Metode tinjauan pustaka sistematis untuk mengidentifikasi, menilai, dan menganalisis seluruh penelitian yang tersedia terkait topik tertentu.
Kesadaran kritis yang dikembangkan dalam ruang belajar untuk memahami dan menghargai keberagaman budaya serta linguistik.

background.en: Indonesia possesses extraordinary linguistic diversity with over 718 regional languages, causing almost all elementary school students to grow up in multilingual environments where they acquire a regional language as their first language and Indonesian as a second language learned formally at school. This situation creates a unique linguistic complexity that directly affects students' cognitive development and learning processes. However, learning policies and classroom practices tend to be monolingual, placing elementary teachers in a dilemma between enforcing formal Indonesian and allowing regional languages.
background.id: Indonesia memiliki keragaman bahasa yang luar biasa dengan lebih dari 718 bahasa daerah, menyebabkan hampir seluruh siswa sekolah dasar tumbuh di lingkungan multibahasa tempat mereka memperoleh bahasa daerah sebagai bahasa pertama dan bahasa Indonesia sebagai bahasa kedua yang dipelajari secara formal di sekolah. Situasi ini menciptakan kompleksitas linguistik unik yang berdampak langsung pada perkembangan kognitif dan proses pembelajaran siswa. Namun, kebijakan pembelajaran dan praktik di kelas cenderung bersifat monolingual, menempatkan guru sekolah dasar dalam dilema antara menegakkan bahasa Indonesia formal dan membiarkan bahasa daerah.

contributions.en: This study contributes a systematic literature review analyzing fifteen selected articles from an initial pool of one hundred fifty sources published between 2016 and 2026. It systematically identifies the three main forms of multilingual complexity—language interference, code-mixing, and code-switching—and maps their specific impacts on speaking and listening skills. Furthermore, it formulates concrete pedagogical strategies, including the translanguaging approach, experience-based learning methods, and creative media utilization for Indonesian language classrooms.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi melalui *systematic literature review* yang menganalisis lima belas artikel terpilih dari total seratus lima puluh sumber awal yang diterbitkan antara tahun 2016 hingga 2026. Studi ini secara sistematis mengidentifikasi tiga bentuk utama kompleksitas multibahasa—interferensi bahasa, campur kode, dan alih kode—serta memetakan dampak spesifiknya terhadap keterampilan berbicara dan menyimak. Selain itu, studi ini merumuskan strategi pedagogis konkret, termasuk pendekatan *translanguaging*, metode pembelajaran berbasis pengalaman, dan pemanfaatan media kreatif untuk kelas pembelajaran bahasa Indonesia.

future_work.en: The paper does not explicitly detail formal future work limitations, but it recommends that future researchers conduct deeper empirical and experimental studies on the relationship between multilingualism and listening skills across various regional contexts in Indonesia.
future_work.id: Makalah ini tidak secara eksplisit merinci keterbatasan pekerjaan masa depan, tetapi merekomendasikan agar peneliti selanjutnya melakukan studi empiris dan eksperimental yang lebih mendalam mengenai hubungan antara multibahasa dan keterampilan menyimak di berbagai konteks daerah di Indonesia.

method.en: The research employs a Systematic Literature Review methodology. Literature searches were conducted across Google Scholar, Garuda, Semantic Scholar, and Publish or Perish databases using Boolean keywords such as multilingualism, listening skills, speaking skills, elementary school, and Indonesian language. Out of one hundred fifty initial search results, a rigorous four-stage selection process based on title relevance, abstract and keyword screening, and deep content evaluation yielded fifteen primary articles for detailed analysis.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan metodologi *Systematic Literature Review*. Pencarian literatur dilakukan di basis data Google Scholar, Garuda, Semantic Scholar, dan Publish or Perish menggunakan kata kunci Boolean seperti multibahasa, keterampilan menyimak, keterampilan berbicara, sekolah dasar, and bahasa Indonesia. Dari seratus lima puluh hasil pencarian awal, proses seleksi empat tahap yang ketat berdasarkan relevansi judul, penyaringan abstrak dan kata kunci, serta evaluasi konten mendalam menghasilkan lima belas artikel utama untuk analisis terperinci.

related_work.en: Prior research on multilingualism covers the cognitive and academic impacts on early childhood, showing both multilingual advantages and challenges. Other studies have explored translanguaging practices as a pedagogical resource and phonological or morphological interference in local contexts. However, prior research specifically connecting multilingualism to listening skills remains relatively limited, and existing classroom practices often fail to accommodate the complex linguistic realities of students.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu mengenai multibahasa mencakup dampak kognitif dan akademis pada anak usia dini, yang menunjukkan baik manfaat maupun tantangan dari *multilingualism*. Studi lain telah mengeksplorasi praktik *translanguaging* sebagai sumber daya pedagogis serta interferensi fonologis atau morfologis pada konteks lokal. Namun, penelitian terdahulu yang secara khusus menghubungkan multibahasa dengan keterampilan menyimak masih relatif terbatas, dan praktik kelas yang ada sering kali gagal mengakomodasi realitas linguistik siswa yang kompleks.

results.en: The findings show that multilingual complexity manifests in three main forms: language interference, code-mixing, and code-switching. In speaking skills, first-language interference and low self-confidence serve as primary barriers, which can be mitigated through storytelling, role-playing, and integrated programs like Sarigabah. In listening skills, multilingual cognitive load and monotonous teaching methods hinder comprehension, but these are successfully addressed using audiovisual media and locally-based cultural media such as shadow puppets.
results.id: Temuan menunjukkan bahwa kompleksitas multibahasa bermanifestasi dalam tiga bentuk utama: interferensi bahasa, campur kode, dan alih kode. Dalam keterampilan berbicara, interferensi bahasa pertama dan rendahnya rasa percaya diri bertindak sebagai hambatan utama, yang dapat dikurangi melalui metode bercerita, bermain peran, dan program terintegrasi seperti Sarigabah. Dalam keterampilan menyimak, beban kognitif multibahasa dan metode pengajaran yang monoton menghambat pemahaman, namun hal ini berhasil diatasi dengan menggunakan media audiovisual dan media budaya berbasis kearifan lokal seperti pertunjukan wayang.

tldr.en: This paper investigates the complexity of multilingual use among elementary school students in Indonesia and its implications for Indonesian language learning. The findings reveal that multilingualism manifests through interference, code-mixing, and code-switching, requiring responsive strategies like translanguaging and inclusive curriculum design.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyelidiki kompleksitas penggunaan multibahasa pada siswa sekolah dasar di Indonesia serta implikasinya terhadap pembelajaran bahasa Indonesia. Temuannya mengungkapkan bahwa multibahasa bermanifestasi melalui interferensi, campur kode, dan alih kode, yang memerlukan strategi responsif seperti *translanguaging* dan perancangan kurikulum inklusif.

doi:10.33087/sjee.v10i2.428.title: Kompleksitas Penggunaan Multibahasa Pada Siswa Sekolah Dasar: Implikasinya Terhadap Keterampilan Berbicara dan Menyimak dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia

doi:10.33093/jclc.2026.6.2.26.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based teaching approaches have gained increasing attention in Malaysia’s higher education system, particularly in relation to the Higher Education Development Plan 2026–2035. Although previous studies have reported low to moderate levels of AI literacy among educators, limited empirical attention has been given to AI literacy within language education contexts, where pedagogical interaction, communicative competence, and ethical considerations are central topics. Drawing on a multidimensional AI literacy framework encompassing cognitive, affective, behavioural, and ethical dimensions, this study assessed AI literacy among language academics at the Faculty of Major Language Studies (FPBU) at Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM). A bilingual Malay–English version of the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Questionnaire (AILQ) was administered to 72 academic staff. Data were analysed using descriptive and inferential methods to determine overall AI literacy levels, relationships between demographic factors and AI literacy, and correlations among the AI literacy dimensions. The findings revealed a high level of self-reported AI literacy among the participants. Further analysis showed no significant relationship between gender, age, years of services and the participants’ AI literacy. However, significant correlations were found between affective and behavioural learning and between affective and cognitive learning, while the correlation between affective and ethical learning was relatively low. Overall, the findings suggest that language academics at FPBU USIM report relatively high AI literacy across the measured dimensions. This study contributes to the theoretical understanding of AI literacy dimensions and offers practical implications for institutional policy, professional development, and AI integration strategies in language education.

doi:10.33306/mjssh/466.abstract: This study aimed to examine the effectiveness of Kadazandusun language teaching and learning methods employed by primary school teachers specializing in the instruction of the Kadazandusun language. The research focused on the implementation of systematic pedagogical approaches that incorporate a variety of instructional techniques and strategies to enhance the teaching and learning process. Specifically, the study investigated the application of teaching methods such as dialogue-based activities, role-playing, drilling, singing, demonstrations, and educational games in facilitating language acquisition and learner engagement. A total of 20 Kadazandusun language teachers from primary schools across the Tambunan District, Sabah, participated in the study. A quantitative research approach employing a descriptive survey design was adopted to obtain insights into teachers’ perceptions of the effectiveness of these instructional methods. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire comprising 30 items and subsequently analyzed using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 23.0. Descriptive statistical analyses, including mean scores and standard deviations, were utilized to interpret the data. The findings revealed that the overall level of acceptance and perceived effectiveness of the teaching methods was positive, with an overall mean score of 3.05. This result suggests that the instructional approaches employed by the teachers were generally effective in supporting the teaching and learning of the Kadazandusun language. Nevertheless, the findings also indicate the need for greater integration of learner-centered instructional models and the more effective utilization of teaching resources and educational materials. Such enhancements may contribute to improved classroom management practices, increased effectiveness of teaching and learning activities, and a reduction in teachers’ instructional workload. Based on these findings, several recommendations are proposed to strengthen pedagogical practices and further improve the quality of Kadazandusun language education in primary schools.

Effective pedagogical approaches are crucial for facilitating language acquisition and learner engagement among students in Sabah, yet there remains a need to evaluate current teaching practices.

Pendekatan pedagogis yang efektif sangat krusial untuk memfasilitasi pemerolehan bahasa dan keterlibatan pembelajar di kalangan siswa di Sabah, namun masih terdapat kebutuhan untuk mengevaluasi praktik pengajaran saat ini.

contributions.en: The primary contribution is an empirical evaluation of pedagogical techniques utilized by Kadazandusun language teachers, providing insights into teachers' perceptions of instructional effectiveness within the Tambunan District.

Data dikumpulkan dari 20 guru sekolah dasar bahasa Kadazandusun di Distrik Tambunan menggunakan *kuesioner* terstruktur dengan 30 butir, dan selanjutnya dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif seperti skor rata-rata dan simpangan baku melalui *SPSS* versi 23.0.

Namun, hasilnya juga menyoroti perlunya integrasi yang lebih besar dari model instruksional yang berpusat pada pembelajar dan pemanfaatan sumber daya pengajaran yang lebih baik untuk mengurangi beban kerja instruksional.

tldr.en: This study examines the effectiveness of various teaching methods used by primary school teachers for Kadazandusun language instruction in Sabah. The findings reveal a positive overall perception of these instructional approaches among teachers.
