doi:10.36841/cendekiapendidikan.v5i3.895.abstract: In order to determine how interactive video media affects fifth graders' understanding and autonomy in learning, this study will use students from UPTD SDN Sepulu 1 Bangkalan as subjects. Quantitative methodologies, including comprehension tests and student self-assessment questionnaires, provided the data for this research. Expert validation confirmed that the research instruments were suitable for data collecting. The pre-experimental design of the research, which included 30 students, was a one-group pretest-posttest. There was a positive and statistically significant effect of using interactive video media on students' understanding and learning autonomy, as evidenced by the improvements in scores between the pre- and post-treatment periods. With a significant level of 0.831 (>0.05) and a level of 0.699 (>0.05) for comprehension, the normality test demonstrated that both the comprehension and learning autonomy variables followed a normal distribution. Furthermore, the Paired Sample t-test results demonstrated a statistically significant disparity (p < 0.05) between the pretest and posttest scores. The use of interactive video media has the potential to substantially improve students' comprehension and ability for self-directed learning.
doi:10.36841/cendekiapendidikan.v5i3.895.title: PENGARUH MEDIA VIDEO INTERAKTIF TERHADAP PEMAHAMAN DAN KEMANDIRIAN BELAJAR SISWA KELAS V PADA MATA PELAJARAN BAHASA INDONESIA DI UPTD SDN SEPULU 1

doi:10.36841/cendekiapendidikan.v5i3.896.abstract: This research aims to investigate the effects of puzzle-based learning media on the early reading abilities and desire to learn Indonesian as a topic of second graders from UPTD SDN Sepulu 1. This research was motivated by the need to address students' low early reading competency and willingness to learn via the use of more engaging and interactive media-based instructional methodologies. Researchers used a quantitative strategy based on a one-group pretest-posttest design to determine the extent to which the intervention improved students' skills. All of the research instruments, including reading comprehension tests and questionnaires about students' willingness to learn, had their validity and reliability checked before use. We used a paired-sample t-test and a normality test to look at the numbers. The results of the investigation showed that the paired-sample t-test for early reading ability had a significance value of 0.000 (<0.05), indicating that the media heavily used puzzles to noticeably improve children's reading abilities. Using puzzle-based learning media had a positive effect on students' willingness to learn Indonesian language, as shown by a significant value of 0.044 (<0.05) obtained from the test on learning motivation. Therefore, using puzzle-based learning tools may improve primary school students' early reading skills and their motivation to study.

glossary.explanation_id: Desain penelitian eksperimental yang mengevaluasi subjek penelitian menggunakan tes sebelum dan sesudah diberikan suatu *treatment*.
Uji statistik parametrik yang digunakan untuk membandingkan rata-rata dua kelompok sampel yang berpasangan atau berasal dari subjek yang sama.
Pengujian yang dilakukan untuk memastikan apakah suatu instrumen penelitian benar-benar sah dan akurat dalam mengukur variabel yang diteliti.
Prosedur untuk menguji konsistensi instrumen penelitian agar dapat diandalkan ketika digunakan berulang kali.
Pengujian statistik untuk menentukan apakah data sampel yang dikumpulkan terdistribusi secara normal.
Skala psikometrik yang umum digunakan dalam kuesioner untuk mengukur sikap, pendapat, atau persepsi individu.
Variabel bebas yang menjadi sebab atau memengaruhi perubahan pada variabel lainnya dalam suatu eksperimen.
Variabel terikat yang nilainya dipengaruhi atau menjadi akibat dari adanya variabel independen.

background.en: Early reading and learning motivation are crucial foundational components for comprehensive student development in primary education. However, traditional lecture-based teaching methods often render students passive, leading to low early reading competency and restricted interaction with course content. To address this gap, educators must utilize engaging, interactive, and specific instructional media to enhance both reading comprehension and learning motivation.
background.id: Membaca permulaan dan motivasi belajar merupakan komponen fondasi yang sangat penting untuk perkembangan siswa yang menyeluruh di pendidikan dasar. Namun, metode pengajaran berbasis ceramah tradisional sering kali membuat siswa pasif, yang berujung pada rendahnya kompetensi membaca awal dan terbatasnya interaksi dengan isi materi. Untuk mengatasi kesenjangan ini, para pendidik harus memanfaatkan media pembelajaran yang menarik, interaktif, dan spesifik guna meningkatkan pemahaman membaca serta motivasi belajar.

contributions.en: This paper contributes an empirical evaluation of puzzle-based learning media specifically tailored for second-grade students learning Indonesian. The novelty lies in simultaneously measuring the dual impact of puzzle interventions on cognitive outcomes, such as early reading ability, and affective outcomes, such as learning motivation, utilizing rigorous quantitative pretest-posttest designs and statistical testing via SPSS.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyumbangkan evaluasi empiris mengenai media pembelajaran berbasis puzzle yang dirancang khusus untuk siswa kelas dua yang mempelajari bahasa Indonesia. Kebaruannya terletak pada pengukuran simultan terhadap dampak ganda intervensi puzzle pada hasil kognitif, seperti kemampuan membaca permulaan, dan hasil afektif, seperti motivasi belajar, dengan menggunakan desain *pretest-posttest* kuantitatif yang ketat serta pengujian statistik melalui SPSS.

future_work.en: The authors note that the study lacks a control group for comparison and contains discrepancies in sample size reporting between sections, which should be addressed in future research. Future studies are recommended to incorporate control groups, utilize broader sample sizes with stronger experimental designs, and develop puzzles with adjustable difficulty levels tailored to students' reading capabilities.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat bahwa penelitian ini belum melibatkan kelompok kontrol sebagai pembanding serta terdapat ketidakonsistenan pelaporan jumlah sampel antarbagian yang harus diperbaiki pada riset mendatang. Studi selanjutnya disarankan untuk menyertakan kelompok kontrol, menggunakan ukuran sampel yang lebih luas dengan desain penelitian yang lebih kuat, serta mengembangkan puzzle dengan tingkat kesulitan yang disesuaikan dengan kemampuan membaca siswa.

method.en: The study employs a quantitative one-group pretest-posttest design involving second-grade students at UPTD SDN Sepulu 1. Research instruments include reading comprehension tests and Likert-scale questionnaires measuring learning motivation, all subjected to validity and reliability checks. Data analysis is performed using the Kolmogorov-Smirnov normality test and paired-sample t-test via SPSS to evaluate differences before and after the puzzle intervention.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan desain kuantitatif *one-group pretest-posttest* yang melibatkan siswa kelas dua di UPTD SDN Sepulu 1. Instrumen penelitian mencakup tes pemahaman bacaan dan kuesioner skala Likert untuk mengukur motivasi belajar, yang semuanya telah melalui uji validitas dan reliabilitas. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan uji normalitas Kolmogorov-Smirnov dan *paired-sample t-test* melalui SPSS untuk mengevaluasi perbedaan sebelum dan sesudah intervensi puzzle.

related_work.en: Previous studies emphasize that beginning reading requires understanding the context of words and sentences rather than merely decoding symbols on a page. Researchers build upon prior work exploring game-based learning tools and puzzle media, which encourage active student participation, critical thinking skills, and intrinsic motivation. These earlier investigations highlight that incorporating interactive elements into instructional media effectively supports student engagement and learning outcomes.
related_work.id: Penelitian-penelitian sebelumnya menekankan bahwa membaca permulaan memerlukan pemahaman konteks kata dan kalimat, bukan sekadar menguraikan simbol pada halaman. Para peneliti mendasarkan karya mereka pada studi terdahulu yang mengeksplorasi alat bantu belajar berbasis permainan dan media puzzle, yang mendorong partisipasi aktif siswa, keterampilan berpikir kritis, dan motivasi intrinsik. Investigasi awal ini menyoroti bahwa penggabungan unsur interaktif ke dalam media pembelajaran secara efektif mendukung keterlibatan siswa dan hasil belajar.

results.en: The results show a significance value of 0.000 (<0.05) for early reading ability from the paired-sample t-test, indicating a statistically significant improvement after using puzzle media. Similarly, the learning motivation test yielded a significance value of 0.044 (<0.05), confirming a positive effect on students' willingness to study. The authors interpret these findings as proof that puzzle media successfully enhances both cognitive reading skills and affective learning motivation.
results.id: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,000 (<0,05) untuk kemampuan membaca permulaan dari *paired-sample t-test*, yang mengindikasikan adanya peningkatan yang signifikan secara statistik setelah menggunakan media puzzle. Demikian pula, tes motivasi belajar menghasilkan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,044 (<0,05), yang mengonfirmasi pengaruh positif terhadap kemauan siswa untuk belajar. Para penulis menginterpretasikan temuan ini sebagai bukti bahwa media puzzle berhasil meningkatkan keterampilan membaca kognitif maupun motivasi belajar afektif.

tldr.en: This research investigates the effects of puzzle-based learning media on early reading abilities and learning motivation among second-grade students in Indonesia. The findings demonstrate that the intervention significantly improves both early reading competency and students' willingness to learn.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini menyelidiki pengaruh media pembelajaran berbasis puzzle terhadap kemampuan membaca permulaan dan motivasi belajar pada siswa kelas dua di Indonesia. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa intervensi tersebut secara signifikan meningkatkan kompetensi membaca awal dan kemauan siswa untuk belajar.

doi:10.36948/ijfmr.2026.v08i04.85777.abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) for low-resource languages is challenging due to the lack of linguistic resources, sparse digital content and the absence of structured knowledge bases. In this paper, we present an adaptive knowledge-augmented framework for Mizo Large Language Models by combining Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with continual learning. This methodology harnesses semantic retrieval with dense embeddings and FAISS indexing, adaptive evidence re-ranking, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and incremental knowledge updating to enhance factual accuracy and decrease hallucinations. Experimental evaluation shows better retrieval performance, greater text creation quality, and superior human evaluation scores than typical multilingual LLMs and static RAG methods. Moreover, the continual learning technique allows for effective integration of newly accessible Mizo resources, without re-training the model from scratch. The suggested architecture offers a scalable, stable and reusable method for the development of intelligent language technologies for Mizo and other low-resource languages.
doi:10.36948/ijfmr.2026.v08i04.85777.title: A Framework for Adaptive Knowledge-Augmented Mizo Large Language Models Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Continual Learning

doi:10.37110/jell.v11i02.354.abstract: Language plays a significant role in the effectiveness of environmental campaigns by conveying information and encouraging public participation through persuasive communication. Although previous studies have examined sentence types in advertising and other media, limited attention has been given to their communicative functions in environmental video campaigns, particularly within the Indonesian context. This study aims to identify the sentence types employed in AQUA’s “#BijakBerplastik Hari Wayang Nasional” environmental video campaign and to analyze their communicative functions in delivering persuasive environmental messages. This study employed a descriptive qualitative research design. The data consisted of spoken utterances taken from the official campaign video and were collected through document analysis. The utterances were classified into sentence types and subsequently analyzed to identify their communicative functions. The findings reveal that the campaign employs only two sentence types: 11 declarative sentences (73.3%) and 4 imperative sentences (26.7%), while interrogative and exclamatory sentences are absent. Declarative sentences primarily function to provide information, explain environmental issues, and build audience awareness, whereas imperative sentences encourage audiences to adopt environmentally responsible behaviour through invitations and persuasive appeals. The findings demonstrate that grammatical sentence types contribute to the effectiveness of persuasive environmental communication by balancing information delivery with behavioural encouragement. The study also extends the application of sentence type analysis to an Indonesian environmental advertising campaign and provides a useful reference for future research on advertising discourse and environmental campaigns

doi:10.37134/pendeta.vol17.2.1.2026.abstract: Di bawah dorongan strategi nasional dan transformasi digital pendidikan, model pembentukan bakat komunikasi bahasa Persatuan Negara-Negara Asia Tenggara (ASEAN) memerlukan penambahbaikan. Kajian ini menumpukan kepada dokumen jurusan sarjana muda Bahasa Melayu versi 2025 di Universiti Komunikasi China sebagai objek penyelidikan. Kaedah analisis tema dan kaedah kajian kes digunakan untuk menilai sistem kursus dan laluan pelaksanaan model pembentukan bakat antarabangsa. Hasil kajian menunjukkan model ini berpusat pada objektif membentuk bakat komunikasi antarabangsa yang “berbilang bahasa, berbilang disiplin, berbilang keupayaan”, membina paradigma pendidikan yang sistematik dengan orientasi nilai yang menyatukan patriotisme dan wawasan antarabangsa, pengetahuan dan keupayaan yang mengintegrasikan lintas budaya, lintas disiplin, dan lintas bidang, serta pendidikan pintar yang memajukan integrasi inovatif antara kerjasama manusia-mesin dan pendidikan bahasa ASEAN. Kajian mendedahkan mekanisme sistematik dan menyediakan pengalaman bagi reformasi pembentukan bakat bahasa ASEAN. Motivated by the dual driving forces of serving national strategies and advancing digital transformation in education, the talent cultivation model for Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) languages urgently requires optimization. This study examines a series of documents from the 2025 undergraduate talent cultivation plan for the Malay program (Sino-Malaysian Cultural Exchange and International Affairs Track) at Communication University of China. Employing a thematic analysis and a case study approach, this study deconstructs the curriculum framework and implementation path of the international communication talent cultivation model. The study finds that the plan, centered on the goal of cultivating outstanding international communication talents with multilingual proficiency, interdisciplinary knowledge, and multidimensional competence, constitutes a systematic educational paradigm. In terms of value orientation, it highlights the strong integration of national identity with a global perspective. In terms of knowledge and capabilities, it focuses on the deep convergence of cross-cultural, cross-disciplinary, and cross-domain competencies. In terms of intelligent education, it promotes integrated innovation through human-machine collaboration and the advancement of ASEAN languages education. This study reveals the systematic construction mechanism and continuous optimization logic of the talent cultivation plan from a textual perspective, offering a valuable reference for the reform of talent cultivation in ASEAN languages programs in the era of artificial intelligence.

doi:10.37134/pendeta.vol17.2.2.2026.abstract: Kajian ini menilai keberkesanan Peta Minda Digital (PMD) dalam pengajaran dan pembelajaran novel Pengabdian bagi mata pelajaran Kesusasteraan Melayu (KM). PMD digunakan sebagai alat visual untuk menyusun maklumat, menghubungkan idea, dan meningkatkan kefahaman teks. Seramai 20 orang pelajar tahun 10 dari salah sebuah sekolah menengah di Daerah Brunei dan Muara telah dipilih sebagai peserta kajian tindakan ini bagi menilai keberkesanan intervensi yang dijalankan. Skor ujian pra dan ujian pasca, soal selidik berasaskan Model ARCS dan temu bual separa berstruktur merupakan kaedah yang digunakan untuk mengumpul data dalam kajian ini. Keputusan menunjukkan peningkatan pencapaian apabila skor pasca ujian melepasi skor pra ujian. Dari segi pengetahuan, pelajar beralih daripada mengingat isi asas kepada analisis dan penilaian selaras dengan Taksonomi Bloom. Soal selidik mencatatkan skor min tinggi bagi semua komponen ARCS (perhatian, kebolehsesuaian, keyakinan dan kepuasan) menandakan peningkatan motivasi. Dapatan temu bual mengesahkan bahawa elemen visual, warna dan susunan maklumat PMD memudahkan pemahaman, mengurangkan kebosanan, serta menggalakkan pembelajaran kolaboratif dan kendiri. Secara keseluruhan, PMD bukan sahaja menyokong pencapaian kognitif, malah berfungsi sebagai strategi pedagogi inovatif yang meningkatkan motivasi dan minat pelajar terhadap KM. This study evaluates the effectiveness of Digital Mind Maps (PMD) in teaching and learning the novel Pengabdian within the Malay Literature curriculum. PMD served as a visual tool to organise information, connect ideas, and enhance text comprehension—an action research design involving 20 Year 10 students at a secondary school in the Brunei and Muara District. Data were gathered via pre and post-tests, a questionnaire grounded in Keller’s ARCS model (1987), and semi structured interviews. Results indicate achievement gains, with post test scores exceeding pretest scores. In terms of knowledge, students progressed from simple recall to analysis and evaluation in line with Bloom’s Taxonomy (1956). Questionnaire results showed high mean scores across all ARCS components (attention, relevance, confidence, and satisfaction) signalling increased motivation. Interview data corroborated that PMD’s visuals, colour use, and structured layout facilitated comprehension, reduced boredom, and fostered both collaborative and self-directed learning. Overall, PMD not only supports cognitive achievement but also functions as an innovative pedagogical strategy that enhances students’ motivation and interest in Malay Literature.

doi:10.37134/pendeta.vol17.2.3.2026.abstract: Kajian ini dilaksanakan untuk meneliti tahap penguasaan kemahiran bertutur bahasa Melayu dalam kalangan pelajar kaum Melanau, khususnya dari aspek struktur ayat yang meliputi ketepatan tatabahasa, kepelbagaian jenis ayat dan struktur ayat. Penguasaan kemahiran ini penting memandangkan bahasa Melanau sebagai bahasa ibunda serta penggunaan dialek Melayu Sarawak dalam komunikasi harian berpotensi mempengaruhi kecekapan penggunaan bahasa Melayu standard. Sejajar dengan tajuk kajian, objektif penyelidikan ini adalah untuk menganalisis ketepatan tatabahasa, menilai kepelbagaian jenis ayat serta menentukan tahap struktur ayat dalam pertuturan pelajar Tingkatan 5 kaum Melanau. Kajian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif berbentuk deskriptif. Seramai 10 orang pelajar Tingkatan 5 kaum Melanau di Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Mukah, Sarawak dipilih sebagai responden melalui kaedah persampelan rawak mudah. Pengumpulan data dijalankan melalui ujian lisan yang dirangka berasaskan tema Citra Bahasa dan Sastera Kita daripada Buku Teks Bahasa Melayu Tingkatan 5. Setiap responden diberikan masa selama tiga minit untuk membaca petikan teks dan menjawab tiga soalan yang merangkumi aras pemikiran rendah, sederhana dan tinggi bagi mencungkil keupayaan pertuturan secara spontan. Prestasi pelajar dinilai menggunakan rubrik kemahiran bertutur yang diubah suai daripada Dokumen Standard Kurikulum dan Pentaksiran (DSKP), dengan penekanan khusus terhadap aspek struktur ayat. Rubrik tersebut mengandungi enam tahap penguasaan, iaitu sangat terhad hingga cemerlang, dan setiap aspek dinilai dengan markah maksimum 10, menjadikan jumlah keseluruhan 30 markah. Data yang diperoleh dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif seperti skor menentukan tahap penguasaan pelajar sama ada rendah, sederhana atau tinggi. Selain itu, pengaruh bahasa ibunda Melanau turut mempengaruhi aspek fonologi seperti sebutan dan intonasi. Dapatan kajian menunjukkan bahawa majoriti pelajar berada pada tahap penguasaan memuaskan hingga cemerlang dalam ketiga-tiga aspek yang dikaji. Secara keseluruhannya, kajian ini menegaskan keperluan pendekatan pedagogi yang lebih berfokus kepada pembinaan struktur ayat yang tepat dan pelbagai, di samping mengambil kira latar linguistik dan sosiobudaya pelajar bagi meningkatkan kecekapan komunikasi lisan dalam bahasa Melayu. This study was conducted to examine the level of Malay language speaking proficiency among Melanau students, particularly from the perspective of sentence structure, which encompasses grammatical accuracy, variety of sentence types, and sentence completeness. Mastery of these skills is crucial, as the Melanau language serves as the students’ mother tongue, and the frequent use of the Sarawak Malay dialect in daily communication has the potential to influence their proficiency in standard Malay. In line with the title of the study, the objectives of this research are to analyse grammatical accuracy, evaluate the variety of sentence types, and determine the level of sentence completeness in the spoken language of Form Five Melanau students. This study employed a quantitative descriptive approach. A total of ten Form Five Melanau students from Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Mukah, Sarawak, were selected as respondents through simple random sampling. Data were collected through an oral test designed based on the theme Citra Bahasa dan Sastera Kita from the Form Five Malay Language textbook. Each respondent was given three minutes to read a text excerpt and respond to three questions representing lower-, intermediate-, and higher-order thinking levels to elicit spontaneous speech. Students’ performance was assessed using a speaking skills rubric adapted from the Dokumen Standard Kurikulum dan Pentaksiran (DSKP), with particular emphasis on sentence structure. The rubric comprises six proficiency levels, ranging from very limited to excellent, with each aspect evaluated using a maximum score of 10, resulting in a total possible score of 30. The data obtained were analysed using descriptive statistics, specifically scores, to determine whether the students’ proficiency levels were low, moderate, or high. In addition, the influence of the Melanau mother tongue was found to affect phonological aspects such as pronunciation and intonation. The findings indicate that the majority of students achieved a satisfactory to excellent level of proficiency across all three aspects examined. Overall, the study underscores the need for more focused pedagogical approaches that emphasise the construction of accurate and varied sentence structures, while also taking into account the students’ linguistic and sociocultural backgrounds to enhance their oral communication proficiency in the Malay language.

doi:10.37134/pendeta.vol17.2.4.2026.abstract: Peribahasa Melayu merupakan khazanah warisan budaya yang kaya dengan nilai didaktik dan kearifan tempatan yang diwarisi secara turun-temurun dalam kalangan masyarakat Melayu. Kajian ini bertujuan mengklasifikasikan unsur didaktik yang terkandung dalam peribahasa Melayu berdasarkan kerangka 26 Teras Hati Budi Melayu (THBM). Pendekatan kualitatif digunakan dalam kajian ini melalui kaedah analisis kandungan dokumen terhadap peribahasa terpilih yang diperoleh daripada buku Peribahasa Melayu: Penelitian Makna dan Nilai hasil penulisan Zaitul Azma Zainon Hamzah dan Ahmad Fuad Mat Hassan (2011) sebagai korpus utama kajian. Kerangka 26 THBM yang diasaskan oleh Hashim Musa et al. (2012) dijadikan landasan teori utama bagi mengklasifikasikan unsur didaktik yang terdapat dalam setiap peribahasa yang dikaji. Dapatan kajian menunjukkan bahawa unsur didaktik dalam peribahasa Melayu dapat diklasifikasikan secara sistematik merentasi kesemua 26 THBM, dengan teras yang paling dominan meliputi ilmu pendidikan, pekerjaan dan keagamaan. Kajian ini turut mendapati bahawa setiap peribahasa mengandungi lapisan makna didaktik yang bersifat eksplisit dan implisit, mencerminkan sistem nilai dan falsafah hidup masyarakat Melayu yang bersepadu. Implikasi kajian ini menegaskan kepentingan peribahasa Melayu sebagai instrumen pendidikan nilai dan pembentukan karakter bangsa yang masih relevan dalam konteks semasa. Kajian ini menyumbang kepada pengembangan ilmu linguistik budaya dan leksikografi Melayu, khususnya dalam usaha mendokumentasikan dan memartabatkan khazanah peribahasa Melayu sebagai warisan tamadun bangsa. Malay proverbs represent a rich cultural heritage treasure imbued with didactic values and local wisdom passed down through generations within Malay society. This study aims to classify the didactic elements embedded in Malay proverbs based on the framework of the 26 Teras Hati Budi Melayu (THBM). A qualitative approach was employed through document content analysis of selected proverbs drawn from the book of Peribahasa Melayu: Penelitian Makna dan Nilai authored by Zaitul Azma Zainon Hamzah and Ahmad Fuad Mat Hassan (2011), which served as the primary corpus of this study. The 26 THBM framework established by Hashim Musa et al. (2012) was adopted as the main theoretical foundation for classifying the didactic elements present in each proverb examined. The findings reveal that the didactic elements within Malay proverbs can be systematically classified across all 26 THBM cores, with the most dominant cores encompassing knowledge and education, livelihood and vocation, and religiosity. The study further found that each proverb contains layers of didactic meaning that are both explicit and implicit in nature, reflecting the integrated value system and life philosophy of Malay society. The implications of this study underscore the significance of Malay proverbs as an instrument for value education and national character formation that remains relevant in the contemporary context. This study contributes to the advancement of cultural linguistics and Malay lexicography, particularly in efforts to document and elevate the treasure of Malay proverbs as a heritage of civilisational legacy.

doi:10.37150/6q8rmw80.abstract: Hasil belajar merupakan salah satu indikator penting untuk mengetahui tingkat keberhasilan siswa dalam mencapai tujuan pembelajaran. Namun, hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia siswa sekolah dasar, khususnya pada materi kata konjungsi, masih tergolong rendah. Hal ini disebabkan oleh rendahnya pemahaman siswa terhadap penggunaan kata konjungsi dalam kalimat, kurangnya keterlibatan siswa selama proses pembelajaran, serta penggunaan model dan media pembelajaran yang belum mampu memfasilitasi siswa untuk belajar secara aktif dan bermakna. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui peningkatan hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia siswa sebelum dan sesudah diterapkannya model pembelajaran Make a Match berbantuan media KEGOJI (Kentang Goreng Konjungsi) serta mengetahui peningkatan hasil belajar siswa setelah penerapan model tersebut. Penelitian dilaksanakan di SD 3 Rejosari pada siswa kelas IV yang berjumlah 17 siswa. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan metode Pre-Experimental Design menggunakan desain One-Group Pretest-Posttest Design. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan program SPSS melalui uji normalitas Shapiro-Wilk sebagai uji prasyarat, uji Paired Sample T-Test, dan uji N-Gain. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan adanya peningkatan rata-rata skor hasil belajar dari 59,24 sebelum perlakuan menjadi 79,82 setelah perlakuan, dengan nilai N-Gain sebesar 0,4920 yang tergolong kategori sedang. Selain itu, nilai N-Gain dalam bentuk persentase memiliki rata-rata sebesar 49,1984%, yang menunjukkan bahwa peningkatan hasil belajar siswa tergolong sedang. Dengan demikian, dapat disimpulkan bahwa model pembelajaran Make a Match berbantuan media KEGOJI efektif dalam meningkatkan hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia siswa sekolah dasar.

doi:10.37231/afaq.2026.v4i2.222.abstract: The number of Malay literary works that have crossed into Arabic remains small, and scholarly evaluation of those translations has so far stopped largely at the lexical level. Failures at the level of communicative intent therefore go undetected, because the instruments in use measure referential accuracy alone. This article shifts evaluation from the lexical to the pragmatic level by constructing a reusable typology of pragmatic loss for the Malay and Arabic language pair. The pragmatic dimension of Koller's equivalence model (1979, 1995) supplies the categories, while Baker's (2018) account of implicature and House's (2015) logic of translation quality assessment convert that dimension from an evaluative concept into a codable construct. A total of 66 pragmatic translation units were drawn from Chapters 1 to 3 of the novel Ustaz by S. Othman Kelantan and its Arabic translation entitled al-Ustaz by Sultan Ahmad bin Abdur and Mujahid Mustafa Bahjat (2010), then analysed through directed qualitative content analysis supported by descriptive statistics. Each unit was coded into one of five loss categories and cross tabulated with translation strategy and degree of loss. Agreement between two coders reached a Cohen's Kappa value of 0.78, and the coding framework was validated by a panel of two experts. The findings show that the flattening of idioms and tropes (KP5) dominates the corpus at 40.9 per cent, and that the literal strategy accounts for 77.8 per cent of all cases of total loss. Lexical proximity between the two languages emerges as a risk rather than an advantage, since it encourages the acceptance of cognate equivalents without verification of current meaning. The instrument is designated the Pragmatic Loss Typology, and is designed to transfer to other language pairs with a long history of lexical borrowing, including Persian and Arabic, Turkish and Arabic, Urdu and Arabic, and Swahili and Arabic. The article contributes an assessment instrument that is both replicable and transferable, alongside the argument that effective cultural mediation depends on the preservation of illocutionary force rather than on denotative accuracy.
doi:10.37231/afaq.2026.v4i2.222.title: Tipologi kehilangan pragmatik dalam penterjemahan sastera Melayu ke Arab: Satu instrumen penilaian berasaskan model Kesepadanan Koller

doi:10.37859/jf.v16i2.12020.abstract: This study develops a multi-domain, human-labelled Text-to-SQL dataset in Indonesian to address the absence of such resources for the language. The dataset was constructed through a corpus-based approach comprising four stages: corpus planning, corpus construction, corpus validation, and model evaluation. Database schemas represented as Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD) were used as the structural foundation for generating pairs of Indonesian natural language questions and SELECT-type SQL queries, all created through manual annotation. Validation was performed through four sequential mechanisms: SQL syntax checking, schema conformity verification, query execution testing, and semantic alignment assessment between questions and SQL queries. The resulting dataset is Spider-compatible in JSON format, covering 40 databases, 27 domains, 1,524 questions, and 1,355 unique SQL queries distributed across four difficulty levels. Preliminary evaluation using SQLNet and TypeSQL baseline models under example split and database split scenarios confirms that the dataset provides a representative and challenging evaluation environment for Indonesian Text-to-SQL experiments, though model performance remains limited on complex queries and previously unseen database schemas. The dataset is publicly available and is intended to support future development and evaluation of Indonesian Text-to-SQL models..

background.en: Natural Language Interface to Databases systems allow users to query databases using everyday language without mastering complex SQL syntax. Although Text-to-SQL has advanced rapidly, most research focuses on English, leaving low-resource languages like Indonesian with a critical gap in multi-domain, human-labelled datasets. Without quality data, models tend to overfit and fail to generalize.
background.id: Sistem *Natural Language Interface to Databases* memungkinkan pengguna untuk mengkueri basis data menggunakan bahasa sehari-hari tanpa menguasai sintaks SQL yang rumit. Meskipun *Text-to-SQL* telah berkembang pesat, sebagian besar penelitian berfokus pada bahasa Inggris, meninggalkan bahasa dengan sumber daya rendah seperti bahasa Indonesia dengan kesenjangan kritis berupa ketiadaan dataset multi-domain yang dianotasi manusia. Tanpa data berkualitas, model cenderung mengalami *overfitting* dan gagal bergeneralisasi.

contributions.en: The main contributions include providing the first multi-domain Indonesian Text-to-SQL dataset, adapting an Entity Relationship Diagram-based corpus construction methodology with rigorous multi-layer validation, and conducting preliminary evaluations using SQLNet and TypeSQL models under example and database split scenarios.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama mencakup penyediaan dataset *Text-to-SQL* berbahasa Indonesia multi-domain yang pertama, pengadaptasian metodologi konstruksi korpus berbasis *Entity Relationship Diagram* dengan validasi berlapis yang ketat, serta pelaksanaan evaluasi awal menggunakan model *SQLNet* dan *TypeSQL* pada skenario *example split* dan *database split*.

future_work.en: The authors suggest expanding dataset size with more databases and domains, enriching query structures for very difficult categories, and evaluating with modern Large Language Models using fine-tuning or prompt engineering.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyarankan untuk memperluas ukuran dataset dengan lebih banyak basis data dan domain, memperkaya struktur kueri untuk kategori yang sangat sulit, serta mengevaluasi dengan *large language model* modern menggunakan *fine-tuning* atau *prompt engineering*.

method.en: The corpus was constructed through corpus planning, construction, validation, and evaluation stages. Using Entity Relationship Diagrams as a structural foundation, a single annotator manually created SELECT-type SQL queries and Indonesian natural language questions across 40 SQLite databases and 27 domains. Validation involved SQL syntax checking, schema conformity verification, execution testing, and semantic alignment assessment. Evaluation used SQLNet and TypeSQL under example split and database split configurations, measured by Exact Match and Component Matching F1 scores.
method.id: Korpus dikonstruksi melalui tahap perencanaan korpus, konstruksi, validasi, dan evaluasi. Menggunakan *Entity Relationship Diagram* sebagai fondasi struktural, seorang *annotator* tunggal membuat kueri SQL bertipe SELECT dan pertanyaan bahasa alami secara manual di seluruh 40 basis data SQLite dan 27 domain. Validasi melibatkan pemeriksaan sintaks SQL, verifikasi kesesuaian skema, pengujian eksekusi, dan penilaian keselarasan semantik. Evaluasi menggunakan *SQLNet* dan *TypeSQL* pada konfigurasi *example split* dan *database split*, yang diukur dengan skor *Exact Match* dan *Component Matching* F1.

related_work.en: Previous Text-to-SQL benchmarks such as ATIS, GeoQuery, WikiSQL, and Spider have driven progress in semantic parsing. However, multilingual extensions like MultiSpider show performance drops due to the limitations of automated translation, emphasizing the need for direct human annotation. Existing Indonesian studies are limited to single-domain or small-scale data, failing to provide comprehensive evaluation resources.
related_work.id: Benchmark *Text-to-SQL* sebelumnya seperti ATIS, GeoQuery, WikiSQL, dan Spider telah mendorong kemajuan dalam *semantic parsing*. Namun, ekstensi multibahasa seperti MultiSpider menunjukkan penurunan performa akibat keterbatasan terjemahan mesin, yang menekankan perlunya anotasi manusia secara langsung. Studi bahasa Indonesia yang ada terbatas pada data domain tunggal atau skala kecil, sehingga gagal menyediakan sumber daya evaluasi yang komprehensif.

results.en: The dataset contains 1,524 questions and 1,355 unique SQL queries across four difficulty levels. TypeSQL outperformed SQLNet, achieving Exact Match accuracies of 11.8 percent on example split and 7.8 percent on database split, while SQLNet achieved 5.9 percent and 5.6 percent respectively. Performance drops on database split highlight the challenge of cross-domain schema generalization, exacerbated by Indonesian morphological variations.
results.id: Dataset ini berisi 1.524 pertanyaan dan 1.355 kueri SQL unik yang tersebar di empat tingkat kesulitan. *TypeSQL* mengungguli *SQLNet*, mencapai akurasi *Exact Match* sebesar 11,8 persen pada *example split* dan 7,8 persen pada *database split*, sementara *SQLNet* masing-masing mencapai 5,9 persen dan 5,6 persen. Penurunan performa pada *database split* menyoroti tantangan generalisasi skema lintas domain, yang diperparah oleh variasi morfologi bahasa Indonesia.

tldr.en: This study develops a multi-domain, human-labelled Indonesian Text-to-SQL dataset to address the lack of such resources. Evaluation using baseline models confirms that the dataset provides a challenging environment for evaluating Indonesian semantic parsing models.
tldr.id: Studi ini mengembangkan dataset *Text-to-SQL* berbahasa Indonesia yang bersifat multi-domain dan dianotasi manusia untuk mengatasi ketiadaan sumber daya serupa. Evaluasi menggunakan model *baseline* mengonfirmasi bahwa dataset ini menyediakan lingkungan yang menantang untuk mengevaluasi model *semantic parsing* berbahasa Indonesia.

doi:10.37859/jf.v16i2.12020.title: Pembangunan Multi-Domain Human-Labelled Dataset untuk Konversi Bahasa Alami ke SQL pada Bahasa Indonesia

doi:10.37905/jjeee.v8i2.39805.abstract: The massive volume of consumer reviews on the social commerce platform TikTok Shop makes it difficult for local shoe brands such as Ventela to understand consumer perception in a structured manner, while Indonesian-language Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) studies on this platform remain very limited. This study aims to apply fine-tuned IndoBERT for aspect-based sentiment classification and to measure consumer perception of four product aspects, namely Comfort, Design, Durability, and Price. Using a computational experiment approach, 1,000 reviews were collected, automatically annotated using a lexicon-based method with negation handling, restructured into 706 review-aspect pairs and divided using an 80:20 stratified split, and used to train and compare three models: TF-IDF with Logistic Regression, TF-IDF with Linear SVM, and fine-tuned IndoBERT. Testing on 142 test samples shows that fine-tuned IndoBERT is superior, achieving an Accuracy of 0.8521 and an F1-Macro of 0.7813 and surpassing both baselines on four of five primary metrics. Analysis of 706 review-aspect pairs identifies Design (75.6% positive) and Price (71.8% positive) as the main strengths, while Comfort (32.7% negative) and Durability (30.8% negative) emerge as improvement areas related to sizing and the quality of adhesive and stitching. This study enriches Indonesian ABSA literature in the social commerce domain and delivers a ready-to-use web-based simulator built with Gradio to facilitate periodic consumer-perception monitoring for data-driven decision-making processes.

doi:10.37905/jjeee.v8i2.39805.title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) of Ventela Shoe Reviews on TikTok Shop Using Fine-Tuned IndoBERT
doi:10.37905/jjeee.v8i2.39805.venue: Jambura Journal of Electrical and Electronics Engineering

doi:10.37905/jjeee.v8i2.39885.abstract: User reviews of online learning applications such as Ruangguru provide valuable information for evaluating service quality, user experience, and digital learning effectiveness. Although IndoBERT has demonstrated strong performance in Indonesian sentiment analysis, previous studies generally compared imbalance handling techniques using different datasets, model architectures, and experimental protocols, making the relative effectiveness of data-level and cost-sensitive learning approaches difficult to evaluate objectively under the same Transformer backbone. This study compares a Data-Level Approach using Latent-SMOTE with a Cost-Sensitive Learning Approach using Class-Weighted Loss on an identical IndoBERT architecture. The dataset consists of 3,767 Ruangguru user reviews collected from Google Play Store and processed through text preprocessing, IndoBERT tokenization, stratified train-validation-test splitting, and evaluation using Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Macro F1-score, confusion matrix, Cochran's Q Test, and McNemar Test. Experimental results show that the Baseline model achieved the highest Accuracy (90.05%), while the Cost-Sensitive Learning approach obtained the highest Macro F1-score (0.6275), outperforming both the Baseline (0.5658) and the Data-Level approach. These findings indicate that class-weighted optimization improves minority-class recognition without modifying the original training distribution, whereas Latent-SMOTE enhances minority representation but does not outperform Class-Weighted Loss. McNemar testing further confirms that the improvements over the Baseline are statistically significant. The main contribution of this work is an objective comparison of Data-Level and Cost-Sensitive Learning approaches using the same IndoBERT backbone, dataset, preprocessing pipeline, hyperparameters, and evaluation protocol. In addition, the study applies Latent-SMOTE in the latent feature space and complements performance evaluation with statistical significance testing, providing stronger empirical evidence for handling imbalanced Indonesian sentiment datasets

doi:10.37905/jjeee.v8i2.39885.title: Comparative Analysis of Data-Level and Cost-Sensitive Learning in IndoBERT-Based Sentiment Analysis of Ruangguru App Reviews
doi:10.37905/jjeee.v8i2.39885.venue: Jambura Journal of Electrical and Electronics Engineering

doi:10.46229/jifotech.v6i2.1145.abstract: Ulasan daring di Google Maps merupakan sumber strategis bagi manajemen restoran, tetapi satu ulasan kerap memuji satu aspek sekaligus mengkritik aspek lain, sehingga sentimen tingkat dokumen menjadi lebih kompleks.tidak dapat menunjukkan aspek mana yang sebenarnya memuaskan atau dikeluhkan pelanggan. Penelitian ini menerapkan Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) pada ulasan restoran Soramen melalui alur dua tahap berbasis span—ekstraksi aspek (ATE) lalu klasifikasi sentimen (ASC)—atas empat aspek (FOOD, SERVICE, PRICE, PLACE) dengan IndoBERT, serta menguji Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) yang hemat parameter dibandingkan full fine-tuning yang lebih mahal untuk memetakan aspek layanan kritis. Data terdiri dari 1.742 ulasan asli (3.930 span) yang diperluas menjadi 3.061 ulasan melalui augmentasi terkontrol berbasis penggantian sinonim, dibagi dengan StratifiedGroupKFold 5-fold. Hasilnya, LoRA r=16 mencapai Joint Partial F1 sebesar 0,7744 dengan hanya 0,48% parameter terlatih, setara dengan full fine-tuning (0,7727); selisih tersebut tidak signifikan secara statistik (paired t-test, p=0,82), sehingga LoRA r=16 setara dengan full fine-tuning meski memakai parameter sekitar 200 kali lebih sedikit. Mengganti span prediksi dengan span acuan (gold) menaikkan Macro-F1 delapan kelas dari 0,8853 menjadi 0,9631, menunjukkan bahwa ekstraksi aspek (ATE), bukan klasifikasi, merupakan penghambat utama alur. Analisis korpus berlabel (dengan ulasan negatif sengaja diperbanyak) menunjukkan FOOD sebagai aspek yang paling sering disebut (64,4% ulasan), sementara SERVICE dan PRICE memuat proporsi keluhan terbesar (masing-masing sekitar 36%) dan FOOD serta PLACE tetap didominasi sentimen positif. Penelitian ini menegaskan LoRA sebagai alternatif efisien untuk ABSA berbahasa Indonesia sekaligus menghasilkan rekomendasi manajerial berbasis tema keluhan bagi Soramen.
doi:10.46229/jifotech.v6i2.1145.title: Analisis Sentimen Berbasis Aspek pada Ulasan Google Maps Restoran Soramen Menggunakan IndoBERT-LoRa

doi:10.46481/jnsps.2026.3097.abstract: Conversational agents for low-resource languages (LRLs), such as Igbo, face major challenges, including limited annotated data, code-switching, and weak contextual coherence in multi-turn dialogue. This study proposes a multilevel-attention and hybrid-embedding framework that integrates FastText subword representations with multilingual BERT (mBERT) to improve semantic understanding and context retention. The architecture applies hierarchical attention at the word, utterance, and dialogue levels, enabling effective modeling of conversational dependencies and reducing context drift. The model was evaluated on a curated Igbo--English conversational dataset and benchmarked against long short-term memory (LSTM), Transformer, FastText, mBERT, and XLM-R baselines. For response generation, the proposed framework achieved a bilingual evaluation understudy (BLEU) score of 44.1%, a longest-common-subsequence recall-oriented understudy for gisting evaluation (ROUGE-L) score of 60.3%, and a context-retention accuracy (CRA) of 81.5%. For intent classification, it attained an F1-score of 87.3% and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.91; for context-dependency detection, it achieved an F1-score of 84.3%. The framework also reduced inference latency and was robust to code-switching and noisy conversational input. Human evaluation confirmed improvements in response clarity, cultural relevance, and multi-turn coherence. The findings show that hybrid embeddings combined with multilevel attention provide an effective and scalable approach to conversational AI for LRLs, with potential applicability to other African languages.
doi:10.46481/jnsps.2026.3097.journal_ref: Journal of the Nigerian Society of Physical Sciences
doi:10.46481/jnsps.2026.3097.title: Bridging context gaps in low-resource language chatbots through multilevel attention and hybrid embedding approaches
doi:10.46481/jnsps.2026.3097.venue: Journal of the Nigerian Society of Physical Sciences

doi:10.46576/djtechno.v7i2.9212.abstract: Perkembangan teknologi informasi mendorong Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM) untuk mengadopsi solusi digital guna meningkatkan efisiensi operasional dan kualitas layanan. Es Teh Nusantara BTJ, UMKM minuman di Lhokseumawe, masih menjalankan proses pemesanan dan transaksi secara manual sehingga membatasi efektivitas pengelolaan bisnis dan akses pelanggan. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengembangkan aplikasi mobile commerce yang mendukung pemesanan dan pengiriman online secara terintegrasi. Sistem dikembangkan menggunakan metode Waterfall yang meliputi analisis kebutuhan, perancangan, implementasi, pengujian, dan pemeliharaan. Aplikasi mobile dibangun menggunakan Flutter, dengan Laravel sebagai backend, MySQL sebagai basis data, Midtrans sebagai payment gateway, serta OpenStreetMap untuk pelacakan lokasi. Sistem terdiri atas aplikasi pelanggan, aplikasi pengemudi, dan panel administrasi berbasis web. Fitur utama meliputi katalog produk, keranjang belanja, checkout, pembayaran digital, voucher, pengelolaan pengiriman, dan pelacakan pesanan secara real-time. Pengujian menggunakan Black Box Testing terhadap 42 kasus uji menunjukkan seluruh fungsi berjalan sesuai kebutuhan dengan tingkat keberhasilan 100%. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa sistem mampu mendukung digitalisasi proses bisnis, meningkatkan efisiensi operasional, serta memberikan kemudahan bagi pelanggan.
doi:10.46576/djtechno.v7i2.9212.title: PENGEMBANGAN APLIKASI MOBILE COMMERCE UNTUK PEMESANAN DAN PENGIRIMAN ONLINE PADA ES TEH NUSANTARA BTJ

doi:10.46923/ijets.v8i1.449.abstract: The rapid spread of misinformation in digital media has become a serious challenge, particularly in the context of Indonesian online news consumption. Therefore, this study aims to develop an effective fake news detection system by leveraging a contextual language model tailored to the Indonesian language. This study proposes the use of the Indonesian Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (IndoBERT) model to detect fake news by optimizing the model architecture and hyperparameter settings. IndoBERT, as a contextual language model, functions to capture the nuances of language in text and can be adjusted at the output layer for classification tasks. In this study, the model architecture is enhanced by adding classification layers, including a linear layer, ReLU activation function, dropout, and a sigmoid output layer, which is expected to improve the accuracy of fake news detection. This study uses Indonesian news data from two sites, Turnbackhoax and Detik.com, covering various topics. The model is trained with different hyperparameter settings, including batch size, dropout, and learning rate, to find the best combination that achieves high accuracy in detecting fake news. The trained model is integrated into a Flask-based web application, allowing users to automatically verify the truth of news through a simple and user-friendly interface. The results show that the best combination, with a learning rate of 2e-5, dropout of 0.1, and a batch size of 32, achieves an accuracy of 96.4%. This study demonstrates that IndoBERT, with the appropriate settings, can be effectively applied to detect fake news with high accuracy, contributing to the development of hoax detection applications.
doi:10.46923/ijets.v8i1.449.journal_ref: International Journal of Engineering Technology and Natural Sciences
doi:10.46923/ijets.v8i1.449.title: Fake News Detection on News Websites Using Indonesian Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (IndoBERT)
doi:10.46923/ijets.v8i1.449.venue: International Journal of Engineering Technology and Natural Sciences

doi:10.47233/jteksis.v8i3.194.abstract: The mental readiness of student organization cadres, particularly those in the Muhammadiyah Student Association (IMM), has traditionally been evaluated qualitatively and subjectively, making data-driven decisions regarding workload distribution and cadre development difficult. This study aims to classify the mental readiness of IMM cadres at Universitas Muhammadiyah Kalimantan Timur (UMKT) as an initial basis for a data-driven organizational human-resource evaluation system. The study applies a multimodal Machine Learning approach by combining semantic representations of interview transcripts extracted using IndoBERT with nonverbal observation scores covering self-confidence, communication fluency, and narrative depth. Data were collected from 16 in-depth interviews and expanded to 32 samples using Random Deletion augmentation with a 20% probability. The 768-dimensional text representation was concatenated with three observation features to form a 771-dimensional multimodal feature vector and classified using XGBoost. Evaluation was conducted using Stratified 3-Fold Cross-Validation with scale_pos_weight to address class imbalance. The model achieved an overall accuracy of 88%, with precision and recall of 91% for the “Ready” class and 80% for the “Vulnerable” class. These results indicate that combining textual information with nonverbal observations provides a sufficiently strong classification signal for distinguishing cadre mental readiness. However, because only 16 original data samples were available, this study should be regarded as a proof of concept rather than a generalizable performance benchmark. Further validation using larger and more diverse samples is required to assess model generalization.
doi:10.47233/jteksis.v8i3.194.journal_ref: Jurnal Teknologi Dan Sistem Informasi Bisnis

glossary.explanation_id: *IndoBERT* adalah model bahasa berbasis *transformer* yang telah dilatih secara ekstensif pada korpus teks berbahasa Indonesia.
*XGBoost* adalah algoritma *machine learning* berbasis *gradient boosting* yang sangat efisien dan populer untuk tugas klasifikasi.
*Random Deletion* adalah teknik augmentasi data yang menghilangkan kata-kata tertentu dalam kalimat secara acak berdasarkan probabilitas tertentu.
*Stratified K-Fold Cross-Validation* adalah metode validasi silang yang memastikan setiap *fold* mempertahankan proporsi kelas yang sama dengan *dataset* keseluruhan.
*Multimodal Feature Fusion* adalah proses menggabungkan fitur dari berbagai jenis modalitas data ke dalam satu representasi vektor gabungan.
Token `[CLS]` adalah token khusus pada model *BERT* yang merepresentasikan makna keseluruhan kalimat pada lapisan terakhir.
*scale_pos_weight* adalah parameter pada *XGBoost* yang digunakan untuk memberikan penalti lebih besar pada kesalahan klasifikasi kelas minoritas.

background.en: The mental readiness of student organization cadres, particularly within the Muhammadiyah Student Association, has traditionally been evaluated through subjective qualitative methods. This limitation hinders data-driven decision-making regarding workload distribution and effective cadre development.
background.id: Kesiapan mental kader organisasi mahasiswa, khususnya di dalam Ikatan Mahasiswa Muhammadiyah, selama ini dievaluasi melalui metode kualitatif yang bersifat subjektif. Keterbatasan ini menghambat pengambilan keputusan berbasis data terkait pembagian beban kerja dan pengembangan kader yang efektif.

contributions.en: The study introduces a multimodal human resource evaluation framework combining semantic representations from IndoBERT with structured nonverbal observation scores, classified via XGBoost. Implemented as a proof of concept for organizational decision support, it bridges qualitative assessments and quantitative machine learning.
contributions.id: Penelitian ini memperkenalkan kerangka evaluasi sumber daya manusia multimodal yang menggabungkan representasi semantik dari *IndoBERT* dengan skor observasi nonverbal terstruktur, yang diklasifikasikan melalui *XGBoost*. Diimplementasikan sebagai *proof of concept* untuk sistem penunjang keputusan organisasi, penelitian ini menjembatani penilaian kualitatif dan *machine learning* kuantitatif.

future_work.en: The authors state that due to the small original sample size of 16 data points, the study should be regarded as a proof of concept rather than a generalizable benchmark. Future work requires larger, more diverse datasets and ablation studies across modalities to validate model generalization.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyatakan bahwa karena ukuran sampel asli yang kecil yaitu 16 titik data, penelitian ini harus dianggap sebagai *proof of concept* daripada *benchmark* yang dapat digeneralisasi. Pekerjaan masa depan memerlukan *dataset* yang lebih besar dan beragam serta pengujian *ablation* antar modalitas untuk memvalidasi generalisasi model.

method.en: Data was collected from 16 in-depth interviews, producing verbatim transcripts and three-point ordinal nonverbal observation scores, and then expanded to 32 samples using Random Deletion augmentation. Text features extracted via IndoBERT tokenizer and last hidden state [CLS] token yielded a 768-dimensional vector, which was concatenated with 3 observation features to form a 771-dimensional multimodal vector. Classification was performed using XGBoost with Stratified 3-Fold Cross-Validation and scale_pos_weight to handle class imbalance.
method.id: Data dikumpulkan dari 16 wawancara mendalam yang menghasilkan transkrip verbatim dan skor observasi nonverbal ordinal tiga tingkat, lalu diperluas menjadi 32 sampel menggunakan augmentasi *Random Deletion*. Fitur teks yang diekstrak melalui *tokenizer IndoBERT* dan token `[CLS]` *hidden state* terakhir menghasilkan vektor berdimensi 768, yang digabungkan dengan 3 fitur observasi untuk membentuk vektor multimodal berdimensi 771. Klasifikasi dilakukan menggunakan *XGBoost* dengan *Stratified 3-Fold Cross-Validation* dan parameter *scale_pos_weight* untuk menangani ketidakseimbangan kelas.

related_work.en: Prior psychological evaluations rely primarily on static data such as Likert-scale questionnaires or single-modality text analysis using models like Support Vector Machines. Such approaches fail to capture critical contextual cues like body language, confidence, and communication fluency observed during direct interactions.
related_work.id: Evaluasi psikologis terdahulu terutama mengandalkan data statis seperti kuesioner skala Likert atau analisis teks modalitas tunggal menggunakan model seperti *Support Vector Machine*. Pendekatan semacam itu gagal menangkap petunjuk kontekstual penting seperti bahasa tubuh, tingkat kepercayaan diri, dan kelancaran komunikasi yang diamati selama interaksi langsung.

results.en: The multimodal XGBoost model achieved an overall accuracy of 88 percent, with precision and recall of 91 percent for the Ready class and 80 percent for the Vulnerable class. These metrics demonstrate that combining textual semantics and nonverbal observations provides strong classification signals for cadre mental readiness despite the small sample size.
results.id: Model *XGBoost* multimodal mencapai akurasi keseluruhan sebesar 88 persen, dengan *precision* dan *recall* sebesar 91 persen untuk kelas Siap serta 80 persen untuk kelas Rentan. Metrik ini menunjukkan bahwa penggabungan semantik teks dan observasi nonverbal memberikan sinyal klasifikasi yang kuat untuk kesiapan mental kader meskipun ukuran sampelnya kecil.

tldr.en: This paper proposes a multimodal machine learning approach combining IndoBERT text features and nonverbal observations to classify student organization cadre mental readiness using XGBoost. The model achieves an overall accuracy of 88 percent on augmented interview data, serving as a proof of concept for data-driven human resource evaluation.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengusulkan pendekatan *machine learning* multimodal yang menggabungkan fitur teks *IndoBERT* dan observasi nonverbal untuk mengklasifikasikan kesiapan mental kader organisasi mahasiswa menggunakan *XGBoost*. Model ini mencapai akurasi keseluruhan sebesar 88 persen pada data wawancara teraugmentasi, berfungsi sebagai *proof of concept* untuk evaluasi sumber daya manusia berbasis data.

doi:10.47233/jteksis.v8i3.194.title: Klasifikasi Kesiapan Mental Kader IMM UMKT Menggunakan Multimodal IndoBERT dan XGBoost
doi:10.47233/jteksis.v8i3.194.venue: Jurnal Teknologi Dan Sistem Informasi Bisnis

doi:10.47467/alkharaj.v8i8.12845.abstract: Perfume is a sensory and experiential product whose purchase decision is often backed by direct sniffing, skin testing, and personal interpretation of aroma character. Consumers who buy perfume online typically face purchase uncertainty, since they cannot smell the products immediately and have difficulty interpreting fragrance language. This is particularly true for SCENTARA, a new Indonesian perfume brand inspired by the Nusantara identity. The goal of this study is to build and conduct an early validation of a prototype for an AI assisted perfume recommendation website for SCENTARA. The study applies a design oriented research strategy with a qualitative dominant mixed method design. Exploratory interviews were carried out with eight potential customers to uncover purchase uncertainty, fragrance language problems, and demands for website guidance. The prototype was then tested on 60 questionnaire responses, followed by a follow up physical sample expectation match validation with 10 selected respondents. The results demonstrate that the prototype was favourably accepted across all five assessment dimensions. Users liked the Scent Finder and the explainable recommendation logic because they made abstract scent preferences more comprehensible for product selection. However, the least favourable item level outcome was the item on lowering uncertainty without personally smelling the product, confirming that digital assistance may lessen but not completely remove uncertainty. The physical sample validation gave directional evidence that the recommendation flow provided a meaningful starting direction for selected high confidence respondents. This study concludes that SCENTARA should develop its website not as a typical product display format, but as a dynamic platform for discovery and conversion assistance. Managerial recommendations include strengthening recommendation transparency, improving scent references and scent performance information, adding social proof, and incorporating behavioural data to refine the AI assisted recommendation logic.
doi:10.47467/alkharaj.v8i8.12845.journal_ref: Al-Kharaj Jurnal Ekonomi Keuangan & Bisnis Syariah
doi:10.47467/alkharaj.v8i8.12845.title: Design and Early Validation of an AI-Assisted Perfume Website to Reduce Purchase Uncertainty in Online Perfume Selection: A Prototype-Based Study of SCENTARA
doi:10.47467/alkharaj.v8i8.12845.venue: Al-Kharaj Jurnal Ekonomi Keuangan & Bisnis Syariah

doi:10.47687/snppvp.v7i1.2300.abstract: Krisis pangan global, perubahan iklim, alih fungsi lahan, serta menurunnya minat generasi muda terhadap sektor pertanian telah menjadi tantangan besar bagi negara berkembang, termasuk Indonesia. Sebagai respons terhadap permasalahan tersebut, integrasi teknologi Artificial Intelligence (AI) dan Internet of Things (IoT) dalam bidang pertanian menawarkan solusi transformasional untuk memperkuat ketahanan pangan berbasis lokal. Penelitian ini mengeksplorasi konsep “Sawah Digital Nusantara,” yaitu kerangka pertanian digital yang menggabungkan sistem smart farming, analitik berbasis AI, dan pemantauan berbasis IoT untuk meningkatkan produktivitas, efisiensi, dan keberlanjutan pertanian padi di Indonesia. Dengan menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif yang didukung kajian literatur dan analisis komparatif, penelitian ini mengkaji bagaimana agroteknologi digital dapat memberdayakan petani lokal sekaligus mempertahankan kearifan pertanian tradisional. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa teknologi AI dan IoT mampu mengoptimalkan sistem irigasi, memprediksi serangan hama, memantau kesuburan tanah, serta mendukung pengambilan keputusan pertanian berbasis data. Selain itu, implementasi pertanian cerdas berkontribusi terhadap peningkatan hasil panen, penurunan biaya produksi, dan penguatan ketahanan terhadap ketidakpastian iklim. Penelitian ini juga menyoroti pentingnya dukungan pemerintah, literasi digital, pembangunan infrastruktur, serta ekosistem kolaboratif antara akademisi, industri, dan masyarakat lokal. Pada akhirnya, Sawah Digital Nusantara merepresentasikan strategi inovatif untuk mempercepat modernisasi pertanian sekaligus mempertahankan identitas budaya dan kearifan lokal masyarakat tani Indonesia. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa transformasi digital di sektor pertanian sangat penting untuk mewujudkan ketahanan pangan berkelanjutan dan meningkatkan daya saing pertanian nasional di era Society 5.0.

doi:10.47687/snppvp.v7i1.2370.abstract: Pengelolaan arsip merupakan salah satu aspek penting dalam mendukung efektivitas administrasi organisasi, khususnya pada bagian Sumber Daya Manusia (SDM) yang menangani berbagai dokumen kepegawaian. Namun, berdasarkan hasil observasi di Bagian SDM PT Sinergi Gula Nusantara – PG Pesantren Baru, ditemukan permasalahan berupa arsip inaktif yang tersimpan secara tidak teratur, belum terklasifikasi dengan baik, serta belum memiliki sistem kode arsip yang terstandarisasi. Kondisi tersebut menyebabkan proses pencarian dokumen menjadi kurang efektif dan sering menimbulkan kebingungan bagi pengguna arsip. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengembangkan aplikasi sistem arsip inaktif berbasis Microsoft Excel untuk mempermudah pencarian arsip fisik dan digital serta meningkatkan efisiensi pengelolaan arsip pada Bagian SDM. Metode yang digunakan adalah metode kuantitatif dengan pendekatan pre-test dan post-test yang dianalisis menggunakan uji t berpasangan (paired sample t-test). Hasil implementasi menunjukkan bahwa aplikasi mampu membantu pengguna menemukan lokasi arsip fisik maupun dokumen digital secara lebih cepat dan sistematis. Aplikasi yang dikembangkan juga mendukung tertib administrasi melalui penyajian informasi arsip yang terstruktur berdasarkan kategori, kode arsip, lokasi penyimpanan, dan tautan dokumen digital. Dengan demikian, aplikasi sistem arsip inaktif berbasis Microsoft Excel dapat menjadi solusi inovatif yang sederhana, mudah diterapkan, dan efektif dalam mendukung pengelolaan arsip fisik dan digital pada lingkungan kerja vokasi maupun industri.

doi:10.47738/jads.v7i3.1456.abstract: Enriching educational ontologies automatically from low-resource-language text remains an unsolved integration problem: conventional large language model (LLM)-to-knowledge-graph pipelines require a vocabulary-alignment step and lack hallucination control at the commit boundary. This study removes both bottlenecks and tests whether the resulting ontology can drive measurable learning gains. The core idea is schema co-design: the JSON schema constraining LLM output is the OWL T-box of the target ontology, so extracted records are directly populatable and no alignment step is needed; a literal-presence filter rejects entities absent from the source text before commit, the HermiT reasoner verifies consistency, and Kazakh, Russian and English labels are generated in a single follow-up call. The pipeline (Python 3.9, OWLready2) was benchmarked on 90 Kazakh paragraphs across GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Gemini 1.5 Pro, and the resulting adaptive textbook was evaluated quasi-experimentally with 65 Grade 6 students (control n = 32, experimental n = 33) in two Astana schools over 16 weeks. Of 312 source chunks, 271 (86.9%) survived the full validation chain, yielding 1,847 OWL individuals, 2,931 object-property assertions and 6,512 data-property annotations across 47 classes; the literal-presence filter intercepted 5.2% of validated responses and the reasoner a further 1.1%. Extraction F1 reached 0.89 (GPT-4o), 0.87 (Claude) and 0.86 (Gemini), with hallucination rates of 4.9–8.3%; the one-time corpus build cost USD 3.47–9.64, with zero marginal LLM cost per learner. The experimental group outperformed controls on task accuracy (+19.4 points, d = 2.30), repeated errors (−53.6%, d = 1.85) and sessions to mastery (−34.3%, d = 1.50), all p < 0.001 under Bonferroni correction. The novelty lies in making the ontology T-box itself the extraction schema, combined with pre-commit literal grounding, validated in a real low-resource classroom deployment.
doi:10.47738/jads.v7i3.1456.title: Ontology-Driven Adaptive Learning Environment Using Large Language Models for Educational Knowledge Extraction

doi:10.47794/jesica.v3i2.47.abstract: The increasing use of digital healthcare applications has generated large volumes of user reviews that reflect user experiences and satisfaction. This study aimed to perform Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA) of Indonesian healthcare application reviews using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and IndoBERT. A total of 3,000 reviews were collected from Halodoc, Alodokter, and SATUSEHAT Mobile through the Google Play Store. After preprocessing, 1,460 valid reviews were analyzed. LDA was applied to identify discussion aspects, while IndoBERT was used to classify review sentiments into positive, neutral, and negative categories. The analysis identified seven major aspects related to consultation services, doctor responsiveness, medication delivery, payment processes, and system accessibility. Negative sentiment dominated the dataset (51.78%), followed by positive (40.82%) and neutral (7.40%) sentiments. Doctor Responsiveness and Service Quality achieved the highest positive sentiment (86.57%), whereas Login, OTP, and System Access Problems showed the highest negative sentiment (89.71%). The findings indicated that users appreciated healthcare professionals but frequently reported technical and operational issues. The study concluded that improvements in system reliability, authentication mechanisms, payment services, and medication delivery processes are essential to enhance user satisfaction with Indonesian healthcare applications
doi:10.47794/jesica.v3i2.47.journal_ref: Journal of Enhanced Studies in Informatics and Computer Applications
doi:10.47794/jesica.v3i2.47.title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis of Indonesian Healthcare Application Reviews Using Latent Dirichlet Allocation and IndoBERT
doi:10.47794/jesica.v3i2.47.venue: Journal of Enhanced Studies in Informatics and Computer Applications

doi:10.47810/jclib.2.2026.06.abstract: The digitisation of historical, administrative, and personal documents in Bulgarian faces considerable challenges due to the lack of robust Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) systems tailored for the Cyrillic alphabet. While modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and large transformer-based architectures achieve state-ofthe-art results, their performance and resource efficiency on low-resource languages remain prohibitive for decentralised, privacy-preserving applications. In this paper, we present a comprehensive, resource-efficient pipeline for extracting printed and handwritten Cyrillic text. Our system integrates advanced image preprocessing, YOLO-based document structure and table recognition, and a Permuted Autoregressive Sequence (PARSeq) model trained specifically for Bulgarian. We generated custom synthetic Bulgarian cursive datasets to mitigate the severe lack of real-world training data. Our evaluation indicates that the specialised PARSeq model outperforms traditional OCR tools such as Tesseract and EasyOCR on our custom degraded printed test set, and provides a practical, resource-efficient baseline for handwriting recognition compared to a modern local VLM (Qwen3-VL-4B). Finally, we discuss the discrepancy between synthetic and real handwritten data, highlighting the urgent need for a standardised, annotated Bulgarian HTR dataset.
doi:10.47810/jclib.2.2026.06.title: Extraction of Handwritten and Printed Cyrillic Text from Documents: A Resource-Efficient Pipeline

doi:10.47836/ac.19.2.paper01.abstract: In today’s world of heritage conservation, communication is essential in digital platforms. While these platforms offer opportunities for knowledge sharing and education, concerns remain about their effectiveness in engaging students in conservation efforts at the higher education level. Objectives of the study are to investigates the element of social media for heritage conservation education in the Malay traditional houses context and explores the use of social media as a learning resource in heritage conservation education, especially in Malay traditional houses. Using a qualitative case study approach, data were collected through semi-structured interviews with seven informants and content analysis to explore the subject in depth. Analysis using Atlas.ti identified three main themes which are content development, Instagram for education setting and functional traits. Finding reveals that visual storytelling and interactivity maximize the heritage conservation education by Instagram in promoting Malay traditional houses. Instagram can be a valuable educational tool especially for creative educators by effectively using Instagram in planning and meet lesson objectives to engage students in heritage conservation education. Therefore, highlighting the platform’s potential in fostering a collaborative and contextual learning environment, thereby encouraging student involvement in heritage conservation education. Keywords: Conservation Education, Digital Platform, Heritage, Malay Traditional Houses, Social Media

doi:10.47836/ac.19.2.paper01.title: Enhancing Heritage Conservation Education Through Social Media: The Case of Malay Traditional House
