doi:10.54373/ijset.v6i4.7283.abstract: Indonesian language instruction regarding pantun (traditional Malay poetic forms) for fifth-grade students at SDN 2 Tiudan, Tulungagung Regency, currently lacks engaging and innovative learning media. This situation results in low student motivation and difficulties in comprehending the material. Therefore, there is a need for digital learning media that are both engaging and easy to understand. This study aims to develop a Canva-assisted digital E-Infographic learning medium for the pantun topic for fifth-grade elementary students and to determine its validity and practicality. The study employs the Research and Development (R&D) method using the ADDIE model, which encompasses the stages of Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation. Data were collected through observation, interviews, documentation, and validation questionnaires completed by media, subject matter, and language experts, as well as response questionnaires from teachers and students. The results indicate that the E-Infographic achieved validity scores of 94% from media experts, 93% from subject matter experts, and 96% from language experts, placing it in the "highly valid" category. Practicality tests yielded scores of 92% from students and 90% from teachers, placing it in the "highly practical" category. Thus, the Canva-assisted E-Infographic is deemed highly valid and highly practical for use as a learning medium for Indonesian language instruction on the subject of pantun

glossary.explanation_id: Model *ADDIE* adalah kerangka kerja perancangan instruksional yang terdiri dari lima tahap utama: *Analysis*, *Design*, *Development*, *Implementation*, dan *Evaluation*.
*Canva* adalah platform desain grafis berbasis web yang digunakan untuk merancang berbagai materi visual dan media pembelajaran digital.
*E-Infografis* adalah representasi informasi visual digital yang menyajikan data dan materi secara ringkas, terstruktur, dan menarik.
*Research and Development* adalah metode penelitian yang digunakan untuk menghasilkan produk tertentu dan menguji keefektifannya.
Sampiran adalah dua baris pertama pada pantun yang biasanya berupa sampiran alam atau suasana dan tidak memiliki hubungan makna langsung dengan isi.
Pantun adalah bentuk karya sastra puisi tradisional Melayu yang terdiri dari empat baris per bait dengan rima a-b-a-b serta memiliki sampiran dan isi.

background.en: Indonesian language instruction regarding pantun, which are traditional Malay poetic forms, for fifth-grade students at SDN 2 Tiudan in Tulungagung Regency currently lacks engaging and innovative learning media. This limitation leads to low student motivation and comprehension difficulties regarding the subject matter, necessitating the creation of digital learning tools that are both interesting and easy to understand.
background.id: Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia mengenai pantun untuk peserta didik kelas V di SDN 2 Tiudan, Kabupaten Tulungagung, saat ini masih kekurangan media pembelajaran yang menarik dan inovatif. Keterbatasan ini memicu rendahnya motivasi belajar peserta didik serta kesulitan dalam memahami materi, sehingga diperlukan pembuatan sarana pembelajaran digital yang menarik dan mudah dipahami.

contributions.en: The paper contributes a Canva-assisted digital E-Infographic product for fifth-grade Indonesian language instruction that seamlessly combines visual material presentation with educational games and interactive quizzes focused on pantun. It targets the specific gap of lacking integrated visual and interactive digital tools for traditional poetry learning in elementary education.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyumbangkan produk E-Infografis digital berbantuan Canva untuk pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia kelas V yang memadukan penyajian materi visual dengan permainan edukatif serta kuis interaktif yang berfokus pada pantun. Penelitian ini menargetkan celah spesifik berupa kurangnya perangkat digital visual dan interaktif yang terintegrasi untuk pembelajaran puisi tradisional di pendidikan dasar.

future_work.en: The authors state that the study does not test the effectiveness of the media on student learning outcomes, limiting the scope to development, validity, and practicality. Future researchers are recommended to develop similar digital learning media for other subjects with broader testing scopes and conduct deeper evaluations regarding their effectiveness on student learning outcomes.
future_work.id: Penulis menyatakan bahwa penelitian ini tidak menguji efektivitas media terhadap hasil belajar peserta didik, sehingga cakupannya terbatas pada pengembangan, kevalidan, dan kepraktisan. Peneliti selanjutnya disarankan untuk mengembangkan media pembelajaran digital serupa pada mata pelajaran lain dengan cakupan uji coba yang lebih luas serta melakukan evaluasi yang lebih mendalam mengenai efektivitasnya terhadap hasil belajar peserta didik.

method.en: The study employs the Research and Development method using the ADDIE model, which consists of Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation stages. Data were gathered through observation, interviews, documentation, expert validation questionnaires involving media, subject matter, and language specialists, as well as response questionnaires administered to teachers and students.
method.id: Penelitian ini menerapkan metode *Research and Development* menggunakan model *ADDIE* yang terdiri dari tahapan *Analysis*, *Design*, *Development*, *Implementation*, dan *Evaluation*. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, dokumentasi, angket validasi ahli yang melibatkan spesialis media, materi, dan bahasa, serta angket respons yang diberikan kepada guru dan peserta didik.

related_work.en: Prior studies have developed digital media and infographics to support education, but they often exhibit limitations in integrating pantun content with concise visual presentations and educational games within a single platform. Earlier research tended to develop visual media and learning games separately, failing to combine both specifically for pantun instruction in elementary schools.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu telah mengembangkan media digital dan infografis untuk mendukung pendidikan, namun seringkali menunjukkan keterbatasan dalam mengintegrasikan materi pantun dengan penyajian visual yang ringkas serta permainan edukatif dalam satu platform. Riset sebelumnya cenderung mengembangkan media visual dan permainan pembelajaran secara terpisah, sehingga gagal menggabungkan keduanya secara khusus untuk pembelajaran pantun di sekolah dasar.

results.en: Expert validation tests showed that the E-Infographic achieved validity scores of 94% from media experts, 93% from subject matter experts, and 96% from language experts, categorizing it as highly valid. Furthermore, practicality tests yielded scores of 92% from students and 90% from teachers, placing the medium in the highly practical category.
results.id: Uji validasi ahli menunjukkan bahwa E-Infografis memperoleh skor validitas sebesar 94% dari ahli media, 93% dari ahli materi, dan 96% dari ahli bahasa, sehingga dikategorikan sangat valid. Selanjutnya, uji kepraktisan menghasilkan skor 92% dari peserta didik dan 90% dari guru, menempatkan media tersebut ke dalam kategori sangat praktis.

tldr.en: This study develops a Canva-assisted digital E-Infographic learning medium for teaching pantun to fifth-grade elementary students using the ADDIE model. The results show that the developed medium achieves high validity and practicality ratings from experts, teachers, and students.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengembangkan media pembelajaran digital E-Infografis berbantuan Canva untuk materi pantun bagi peserta didik kelas V sekolah dasar menggunakan model *ADDIE*. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa media yang dikembangkan mencapai tingkat validitas dan kepraktisan yang sangat tinggi dari para ahli, guru, dan peserta didik.

doi:10.54392/ijll2633.abstract: Artificial intelligence has grown quickly in language teaching, particularly since the introduction of generative AI and large language models. Even so, the existing evidence is dispersed across various technologies, teaching applications, learner groups, and research approaches. This systematic integrative review examined 40 primary empirical or technical studies. It also used 15 systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and bibliometric syntheses to provide contextual evidence. The selected publications were published between 2017 and July 2026, while the majority of the primary evidence appeared after 2022. The review employed descriptive mapping, thematic synthesis, design-sensitive methodological assessment, and framework development. The primary papers were evaluated based on AI technology, educational application, language skill, learner group, research design, outcome type, multilingual representation, methodological quality, and ethical or governance concerns. Writing assistance, automated feedback, speaking practice, learner perceptions, teacher support, and AI-assisted pedagogy were the most extensively researched topics. In contrast, reading, listening, younger learners, low-resource languages, delayed learning outcomes, and validation across contexts received less attention. The evidence points to potential short-term improvements for writing revision, speaking practice, motivation, engagement, and teacher support. However, confidence in these findings is limited because many studies used small sample sizes, brief interventions, single-institution settings, self-reported measures, incomplete model and prompt reporting, and minimal external validation. Generative systems increased interactivity, adaptability, and task coverage but also introduced output variability, hallucination, authorship ambiguity, privacy risk, and reproducibility problems. Based on the integrated findings, the review proposes a responsible-adoption framework connecting AI-system characteristics, pedagogical design, human–AI interaction, contextual conditions, educational outcomes, and institutional governance. The findings indicate that educational value depends less on technological novelty than on task alignment, teacher mediation, learner agency, methodological rigour, multilingual inclusion, and accountable human oversight.

doi:10.54392/ijll2633.title: Artificial Intelligence in Language Education in the Generative-AI Era: A Systematic Integrative Review of Pedagogical Evidence, Methodological Quality, and Responsible Adoption
doi:10.54392/ijll2633.venue: Indian Journal of Language and Linguistics

doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.330.abstract: As large language models are deployed across multilingual environments, the benchmarks used to evaluate their safety remain largely designed for high-resource, English-dominant contexts. Trust & Safety systems increasingly rely on automated classifiers and generative models to moderate harmful content across dozens of languages, yet the tools used to assess them often fail to capture linguistic variation and culturally specific harm. This paper presents a structured review of 37 benchmarks relevant to multilingual safety evaluation, 27 of them safety benchmarks, published between 2019 and 2026. Using a nine-dimension taxonomy spanning linguistic authenticity, cultural grounding, and evaluation transparency, we analyze how benchmarks construct evaluation datasets and report safety performance. We identify recurring design patterns: reliance on translated English prompts rather than native-language data, aggregate metrics that obscure cross-language variation, and limited use of locally grounded harm categories or community-informed evaluation. These patterns show that broader language coverage alone does not ensure benchmarks capture how harm is expressed across cultural contexts. We therefore propose a design framework emphasizing native-authored data, disaggregated reporting, locally grounded harm taxonomies, symmetric evaluation of false positives, coverage of dialect and code-switching, and testing under deployment-relevant conditions.

glossary.explanation_id: Sebuah standar atau set data terstandarisasi yang digunakan untuk mengukur dan membandingkan kinerja *large language model*.
Kondisi di mana suatu bahasa atau domain memiliki ketersediaan data digital, pelatihan, dan sumber daya komputasi yang sangat terbatas.
Proses pelatihan lanjutan pada *large language model* menggunakan data spesifik agar model dapat menyesuaikan diri dengan tugas atau domain tertentu.
Tahap awal pelatihan *large language model* pada korpus teks skala besar untuk mempelajari pola bahasa secara umum.
Fenomena pencampuran dua bahasa atau lebih atau ragam bahasa secara bergantian dalam satu kalimat atau percakapan yang sama.
Proses adaptasi kreatif dari suatu teks ke bahasa lain yang tidak hanya menerjemahkan kata-kata tetapi juga menyesuaikan makna budaya dan konteks lokal.
Kesalahan model yang menolak menjawab perintah yang sebenarnya aman atau jinak karena terlalu sensitif dalam membatasi konten.
Kemampuan model untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas tanpa memerlukan contoh demonstrasi atau pelatihan spesifik sebelumnya pada tugas tersebut.

background.en:
As large language models are deployed globally, the safety benchmarks used to evaluate them remain largely designed for high-resource, English-dominant contexts. Trust and safety systems increasingly rely on automated classifiers and generative models to moderate harmful content across dozens of languages, yet these assessment tools often fail to capture linguistic variation, colloquialisms, and culturally specific forms of harm in Majority World contexts.

The paper examines three analytically separate forms of scarcity that complicate this landscape: data scarcity, which refers to limited pretraining and fine-tuning data; evaluation scarcity, denoting the absence of purpose-built benchmarks for a language; and institutional scarcity, representing limited research infrastructure, annotation capacity, and community representation. The absence of adequate evaluation frameworks in low-resource environments creates a significant blind spot in assessing the true safety profile of deployed models across diverse sociolinguistic settings.
background.id:
Seiring diterapkannya *large language model* secara global, *benchmark* keamanan yang digunakan untuk mengevaluasinya sebagian besar tetap dirancang untuk konteks yang kaya sumber daya dan dominan berbahasa Inggris. Sistem kepercayaan dan keamanan semakin mengandalkan pengklasifikasi otomatis dan model generatif untuk memoderasi konten berbahaya di berbagai bahasa, namun alat penilai ini sering kali gagal menangkap variasi linguistik, bahasa sehari-hari, dan bentuk bahaya spesifik budaya dalam konteks Majority World.

Makalah ini meneliti tiga bentuk kelangkaan yang terpisah secara analitis yang memperumit lanskap ini: kelangkaan data, yang merujuk pada terbatasnya data *pretraining* dan *fine-tuning*; kelangkaan evaluasi, yang menunjukkan ketiadaan *benchmark* yang dibuat khusus untuk suatu bahasa; serta kelangkaan institusional, yang mewakili terbatasnya infrastruktur penelitian, kapasitas anotasi, dan representasi komunitas. Ketiadaan kerangka kerja evaluasi yang memadai di lingkungan *low-resource* menciptakan titik buta yang signifikan dalam menilai profil keamanan model yang diterapkan di berbagai pengaturan sosiolinguistik.

contributions.en:
This paper provides two primary contributions to the field of multilingual AI safety. First, it presents a structured review and comparative analysis of thirty-seven benchmarks published between 2019 and 2026, comprising twenty-seven safety benchmarks and ten capability benchmarks, evaluated through a novel nine-dimension scoring taxonomy spanning linguistic authenticity, cultural grounding, and evaluation transparency.

Second, the paper proposes a practical six-principle design framework for multilingual safety evaluation. This framework directly addresses the observed shortcomings in current benchmark design by emphasizing native-authored data, disaggregated reporting, locally grounded harm taxonomies, symmetric evaluation of false positives, comprehensive coverage of dialects and code-switching, and operational validity testing under deployment-relevant conditions.
contributions.id:
Makalah ini memberikan dua kontribusi utama pada bidang keamanan AI *multilingual*. Pertama, makalah ini menyajikan tinjauan terstruktur dan analisis komparatif dari tiga puluh tujuh *benchmark* yang diterbitkan antara tahun 2019 dan 2026, yang terdiri dari dua puluh tujuh *benchmark* keamanan dan sepuluh *benchmark* kemampuan, yang dievaluasi melalui taksonomi penilaian sembilan dimensi baru yang mencakup keaslian linguistik, landasan budaya, dan transparansi evaluasi.

Kedua, makalah ini mengusulkan kerangka kerja desain enam prinsip yang praktis untuk evaluasi keamanan *multilingual*. Kerangka kerja ini secara langsung mengatasi kekurangan yang diamati dalam desain *benchmark* saat ini dengan menekankan data hasil penulisan asli (*native-authored*), pelaporan terdisagregasi, taksonomi bahaya yang berakar secara lokal, evaluasi simetris terhadap positif palsu, cakupan komprehensif dari dialek dan *code-switching*, serta pengujian validitas operasional di bawah kondisi yang relevan dengan penerapan.

future_work.en: The authors acknowledge several methodological limitations, including the reliance on a single primary evaluator for initial scoring, the moderate inter-rater agreement before adjudication, and the potential underrepresentation of work published in regional venues or non-English languages. They also note that the nine-dimension taxonomy represents an interpretive evaluation framework rather than a universal standard, and that the proposed design framework is derived from observational patterns rather than proven causal relationships. Future research should empirically test whether adopting these proposed design principles leads to measurable improvements in downstream deployed safety systems.
future_work.id: Para penulis mengakui beberapa keterbatasan metodologis, termasuk ketergantungan pada satu evaluator utama untuk penilaian awal, kesepakatan antar-penilai yang moderat sebelum adjudikasi, serta potensi kurangnya representasi dari karya yang diterbitkan di *venue* regional atau bahasa non-Inggris. Mereka juga mencatat bahwa taksonomi sembilan dimensi merepresentasikan kerangka kerja evaluasi interpretatif daripada standar universal, dan bahwa kerangka kerja desain yang diusulkan berasal dari pola pengamatan daripada hubungan kausal yang terbukti. Penelitian masa depan harus menguji secara empiris apakah mengadopsi prinsip-prinsip desain yang diusulkan ini mengarah pada peningkatan yang terukur pada sistem keamanan hilir yang diterapkan.

method.en:
The authors conducted a systematic corpus selection by searching major natural language processing and AI safety venues, preprint servers, and technical reports to identify thirty-seven relevant works. They developed a nine-dimension scoring taxonomy organized under three meta-dimensions: Linguistic Authenticity, Cultural Grounding, and Evaluation Transparency. Each dimension is scored on a zero to two scale, where zero indicates absence, one indicates partial engagement, and two indicates systematic engagement.

To ensure reliability, the first author scored all thirty-seven benchmarks, and a second author independently re-scored a stratified random subset of twelve benchmarks under a blind evaluation protocol. The resulting inter-rater agreement was assessed using quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa, and discrepancies were adjudicated against source papers to refine anchor definitions and update corpus scores.
method.id:
Para penulis melakukan pemilihan korpus secara sistematis dengan mencari di berbagai venue pemrosesan bahasa alami dan keamanan AI utama, server *preprint*, dan laporan teknis untuk mengidentifikasi tiga puluh tujuh karya yang relevan. Mereka mengembangkan taksonomi penilaian sembilan dimensi yang dikelompokkan di bawah tiga meta-dimensi: Keaslian Linguistik, Landasan Budaya, dan Transparansi Evaluasi. Setiap dimensi dinilai pada skala nol hingga dua, di mana nol menunjukkan ketiadaan, satu menunjukkan keterlibatan parsial, dan dua menunjukkan keterlibatan sistematis.

Untuk memastikan keandalan, penulis pertama menilai semua tiga puluh tujuh *benchmark*, dan penulis kedua secara independen menilai ulang subset acak berstrata dari dua puluh *benchmark* di bawah protokol evaluasi butar (*blind*). Kesepakatan antar-penilai yang dihasilkan dinilai menggunakan *quadratic-weighted Cohen's kappa*, dan perbedaan diselesaikan terhadap makalah sumber untuk menyempurnakan definisi jangkar dan memperbarui skor korpus.

related_work.en:
The review builds upon a growing body of literature documenting the persistent language gap in AI safety research, where English-language datasets and evaluations dominate while multilingual contexts remain underexplored. Prior studies have highlighted how multilingual capabilities acquired during pretraining coexist with safety calibration that is largely English-centric. Research such as work by Yong et al. and Peppin et al. demonstrates that tools developed to address multilingual safety challenges often inherit the training distributions of the datasets on which they are built.

Furthermore, independent evaluations like S-Eval and MultiJail have reported declining safety performance along a language-resource gradient, with low-resource languages producing harmful outputs at significantly higher rates than high-resource languages. The authors utilize these foundational studies alongside established methodological reference points, including capability benchmarks like AfriQA and BharatBench, to map systematic design gaps across the broader landscape of multilingual evaluation.
related_work.id:
Tinjauan ini dibangun di atas literatur yang terus berkembang yang mendokumentasikan kesenjangan bahasa yang persisten dalam penelitian keamanan AI, di mana data set dan evaluasi berbahasa Inggris mendominasi sementara konteks *multilingual* tetap kurang dieksplorasi. Studi sebelumnya telah menyoroti bagaimana kemampuan *multilingual* yang diperoleh selama *pretraining* berdampingan dengan kalibrasi keamanan yang sebagian besar berpusat pada bahasa Inggris. Penelitian seperti karya Yong et al. dan Peppin et al. menunjukkan bahwa alat yang dikembangkan untuk mengatasi tantangan keamanan *multilingual* sering kali mewarisi distribusi pelatihan dari data set tempat mereka dibangun.

Lebih lanjut, evaluasi independen seperti S-Eval dan MultiJail telah melaporkan penurunan kinerja keamanan sepanjang gradien sumber daya bahasa, di mana bahasa *low-resource* menghasilkan keluaran berbahaya pada tingkat yang secara signifikan lebih tinggi daripada bahasa yang kaya sumber daya. Para penulis menggunakan studi dasar ini beserta titik referensi metodologis yang mapan, termasuk *benchmark* kemampuan seperti AfriQA dan BharatBench, untuk memetakan kesenjangan desain sistemis di seluruh lanskap evaluasi *multilingual* yang lebih luas.

results.en:
The evaluation reveals significant uneven progress and recurring design flaws across the corpus. Performance is strongest in disaggregated reporting and data scarcity acknowledgment, but critically weak in dialect and code-switching coverage, locally derived harm taxonomies, over-refusal analysis, and operational applicability. The analysis shows that translation-only pipelines frequently distort culturally embedded harms, while aggregate metrics obscure severe cross-language disparities, such as drops in F1 score from seventy-eight percent on Singlish down to two percent on Tamil within the same evaluated systems.

Furthermore, the authors identify three distinct benchmark archetypes: participatory native benchmarks, transcreated hybrid benchmarks, and synthetic adaptation pipelines. Each archetype represents a coherent trade-off between cultural validity, evaluation infrastructure scale, and financial or institutional cost.
results.id:
Evaluasi ini mengungkap kemajuan yang tidak merata secara signifikan dan kelemahan desain yang berulang di seluruh korpus. Kinerja paling kuat dalam pelaporan terdisagregasi dan pengakuan kelangkaan data, tetapi sangat lemah dalam cakupan dialek dan *code-switching*, taksonomi bahaya yang berasal dari lokal, analisis penolakan berlebih (*over-refusal*), dan aplikabilitas operasional. Analisis menunjukkan bahwa saluran khusus terjemahan sering kali mendistorsi bahaya yang tertanam secara budaya, sementara metrik agregat mengaburkan disparitas lintas bahasa yang parah, seperti penurunan skor F1 dari tujuh puluh delapan persen pada Singlish menjadi dua persen pada Tamil di dalam sistem yang dievaluasi sama.

Selain itu, para penulis mengidentifikasi tiga arketipe *benchmark* yang berbeda: *benchmark* berbasis partisipasi penutur asli (*native*), *benchmark* hibrida hasil *transcreation*, dan saluran adaptasi sintetik. Setiap arketipe merepresentasikan pertukaran (*trade-off*) yang koheren antara validitas budaya, skala infrastruktur evaluasi, dan biaya finansial atau institusional.

tldr.en: This paper presents a structured review of thirty-seven benchmarks for multilingual safety evaluation using a nine-dimension taxonomy. The analysis reveals that existing tools rely heavily on translated English data and aggregate metrics, frequently failing to capture culturally specific harm and linguistic variation.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan tinjauan terstruktur terhadap tiga puluh tujuh *benchmark* untuk evaluasi keamanan *multilingual* menggunakan taksonomi sembilan dimensi. Analisis mengungkapkan bahwa alat yang ada sangat bergantung pada data bahasa Inggris terjemahan dan metrik agregat, serta sering kali gagal menangkap bahaya spesifik budaya dan variasi linguistik.

doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.330.title: Evaluating Multilingual Safety Benchmarks for Low-Resource Languages in the Majority World
doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.330.venue: Journal of Online Trust and Safety

doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.332.abstract: I examine online gender-based violence (GBV) targeted at Quechua women social media users who post in Quechua and how trust and safety systems address this problem. This builds on previous research on how such systems operate in low-resource languages and the literature on online GBV in the Majority World. I use an intersectional framework to examine how the overlapping identities of race, gender, and language shape who has power when posting in a low-resource language (i.e., Quechua). Using a 2024/25 survey of Quechua social media users; interviews with content moderators, linguistic activists, and others; and social media comments about Quechua women influencers on TikTok and YouTube during 2025, I find that Quechua women are targeted with online GBV because of their race, gender, and language. The analysis also suggests that trust and safety systems fail to provide protection for these women, in part because moderation and reporting policies are ineffective and because the AI-based tools used by social media companies perform worse in Quechua. I argue that social media platforms should treat the content of historically oppressed groups differently—with greater protection, community engagement, and investment.
doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.332.journal_ref: Journal of Online Trust and Safety
doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.332.title: “Our Content Should Be Treated Differently”: Race, Gender, Language, and the Experiences of Quechua Women on Social Media
doi:10.54501/jots.v3i3.332.venue: Journal of Online Trust and Safety

doi:10.54554/jacta.2026.08.01.002.abstract: The Free Nutritious Meal Program (MBG) is a government initiative aimed at improving public nutritional quality and reducing stunting rates in Indonesia. The implementation of this program has generated various public responses, particularly those expressed through social media platform X. Therefore, sentiment analysis is required to identify public opinion tendencies toward the program. This study aims to analyze public sentiment toward the Free Nutritious Meal Program using the Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) method, specifically the IndoBERT model. The dataset consists of 10,925 tweets collected through scraping using the X API and a public dataset from Kaggle. The data were processed through preprocessing stages including cleaning, case folding, and normalization. Sentiment labeling was conducted using a lexicon-based approach combined with manual labeling into three sentiment classes, positive, negative, and neutral. To address data imbalance, random oversampling was applied prior to model training. Model performance was evaluated using a confusion matrix with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. The results show that the IndoBERT model performs well in classifying public sentiment, achieving an accuracy of 90.2%, precision of 90.4%, recall of 90.2%, and an F1-score of 90.3%. Overall, public sentiment toward the Free Nutritious Meal Program is predominantly positive.
doi:10.54554/jacta.2026.08.01.002.journal_ref: Journal of Advanced Computing Technology and Application (JACTA)

glossary.explanation_id: IndoBERT adalah model bahasa berbasis transformer yang dilatih menggunakan korpus teks berbahasa Indonesia yang besar untuk tugas pemrosesan bahasa alami.
Random Oversampling adalah teknik penyeimbangan data dengan menduplikasi data dari kelas minoritas secara acak agar jumlah sampel antar kelas menjadi seimbang.
Case Folding adalah proses mengubah seluruh huruf dalam teks menjadi huruf kecil untuk menyeragamkan format data.
Lexicon adalah kamus sentimen yang berisi daftar kata beserta skor polaritasnya untuk menentukan apakah suatu kata bernada positif atau negatif.
Confusion Matrix adalah tabel evaluasi yang membandingkan hasil prediksi model dengan label aktual untuk mengukur kinerja klasifikasi.
Fine-tuning adalah proses melatih ulang model pra-latih pada dataset spesifik untuk menyesuaikannya dengan tugas tertentu.
SMOTE adalah algoritma penyeimbangan data yang menghasilkan data sintetik baru untuk kelas minoritas guna mengatasi masalah ketidakseimbangan kelas.
Transformer adalah arsitektur *deep learning* yang menggunakan mekanisme *attention* untuk memahami hubungan kontekstual antar kata dalam teks.

background.en: Stunting in toddlers remains a global nutritional issue and a significant challenge in Indonesia, where prevalence rates still exceed the World Health Organization target of twenty percent. To address malnutrition and support human resource development, the government implemented the Free Nutritious Meal Program, previously known as Free Lunch. However, the program's massive scale and estimated budget of up to four hundred fifty trillion rupiah have sparked controversy on social media platforms such as X. Consequently, sentiment analysis is necessary to understand public responses and perceptions regarding this policy.
background.id: Stunting pada balita tetap menjadi masalah gizi global dan tantangan signifikan di Indonesia, di mana tingkat prevalensinya masih melebihi target Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia sebesar dua puluh persen. Untuk mengatasi malnutrisi dan mendukung pengembangan sumber daya manusia, pemerintah mengimplementasikan Program Makan Bergizi Gratis yang sebelumnya dikenal sebagai Makan Siang Gratis. Namun, skala besar program dan perkiraan anggaran hingga empat ratus triliun rupiah telah memicu kontroversi di platform media sosial seperti X. Oleh karena itu, analisis sentimen diperlukan untuk memahami tanggapan dan persepsi publik mengenai kebijakan ini.

contributions.en: This study contributes by implementing the IndoBERT model combined with Random Oversampling to analyze public sentiment on social media data related to the Free Nutritious Meal Program. It addresses the scarcity of research on this specific government policy and solves class imbalance issues where neutral sentiment data was significantly underrepresented compared to positive and negative classes.
contributions.id: Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi dengan mengimplementasikan model *IndoBERT* yang dikombinasikan dengan *Random Oversampling* untuk menganalisis sentimen publik pada data media sosial terkait Program Makan Bergizi Gratis. Penelitian ini mengatasi kelangkaan riset mengenai kebijakan pemerintah tersebut dan menyelesaikan masalah ketidakseimbangan kelas di mana data sentimen netral jauh lebih sedikit dibandingkan kelas positif dan negatif.

future_work.en: Recommendations for future research include developing sentiment analysis methods that account for complex linguistic context such as irony and sarcasm to further improve accuracy, as well as exploring alternative data balancing techniques such as SMOTE.
future_work.id: Rekomendasi untuk penelitian selanjutnya mencakup pengembangan metode analisis sentimen yang memperhitungkan konteks linguistik kompleks seperti ironi dan sarkasme untuk lebih meningkatkan akurasi, serta mengeksplorasi teknik penyeimbangan data alternatif seperti *SMOTE*.

method.en: The dataset comprises 10,925 tweets collected via X API scraping and a public Kaggle dataset. Preprocessing involved cleaning to remove punctuation and symbols, case folding to lowercase, and normalization to match standard Indonesian dictionary rules. Sentiment labeling utilized an initial lexicon-based approach combined with manual verification into positive, negative, and neutral classes. To mitigate class imbalance, Random Oversampling was applied. The IndoBERT model was trained using a fine-tuning approach with a learning rate of 2e-5, a batch size of 16, and 4 epochs, and evaluated using a confusion matrix with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics.
method.id: Dataset terdiri dari 10.925 twit yang dikumpulkan melalui *scraping* API X dan *dataset* publik Kaggle. Pra-pemrosesan melibatkan *cleaning* untuk menghapus tanda baca dan simbol, *case folding* menjadi huruf kecil, serta *normalisasi* agar sesuai dengan kaidah kamus bahasa Indonesia baku. Pelabelan sentimen menggunakan pendekatan berbasis leksikon yang dikombinasikan dengan verifikasi manual ke dalam kelas positif, negatif, dan netral. Untuk mengatasi ketidakseimbangan kelas, diterapkan *Random Oversampling*. Model *IndoBERT* dilatih menggunakan pendekatan *fine-tuning* dengan *learning rate* 2e-5, *batch size* 16, dan 4 *epoch*, serta dievaluasi menggunakan *confusion matrix* dengan metrik *accuracy*, *precision*, *recall*, dan *F1-score*.

related_work.en: Previous research in sentiment analysis has compared traditional machine learning classification methods like Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines, K-Nearest Neighbor, and Long Short-Term Memory models on various datasets. While transformer-based methods such as BERT and IndoBERT have been applied extensively to Indonesian text, most studies focused on general topics like product reviews, application reviews, and digital services. Research concerning public sentiment toward the Free Nutritious Meal Program remains limited, particularly regarding the combination of IndoBERT with data balancing techniques such as Random Oversampling.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya dalam analisis sentimen telah membandingkan metode klasifikasi *machine learning* tradisional seperti *Naive Bayes*, *Support Vector Machine*, *K-Nearest Neighbor*, dan model *Long Short-Term Memory* pada berbagai *dataset*. Meskipun metode berbasis *transformer* seperti *BERT* dan *IndoBERT* telah diterapkan secara ekstensif pada teks berbahasa Indonesia, sebagian besar studi berfokus pada topik umum seperti ulasan produk, ulasan aplikasi, dan layanan digital. Penelitian mengenai sentimen publik terhadap Program Makan Bergizi Gratis masih terbatas, terutama terkait kombinasi *IndoBERT* dengan teknik penyeimbangan data seperti *Random Oversampling*.

results.en: The IndoBERT model achieved high performance in classifying public sentiment, obtaining an accuracy of 90.2%, precision of 90.4%, recall of 90.2%, and an F1-score of 90.3%. Training and validation losses decreased across epochs, indicating effective learning of data patterns. Qualitative evaluation on external test data further demonstrated the model's ability to accurately categorize sentiments according to sentence context, revealing an overall predominantly positive public response toward the program.
results.id: Model *IndoBERT* mencapai kinerja tinggi dalam mengklasifikasikan sentimen publik, dengan *accuracy* sebesar 90,2%, *precision* 90,4%, *recall* 90,2%, dan *F1-score* 90,3%. *Training loss* dan *validation loss* menurun di setiap *epoch*, yang mengindikasikan pembelajaran pola data yang efektif. Evaluasi kualitatif pada data uji eksternal lebih lanjut mendemonstrasikan kemampuan model untuk mengkategorikan sentimen secara akurat sesuai konteks kalimat, yang menunjukkan respons publik yang secara keseluruhan didominasi oleh sentimen positif.

tldr.en: This study analyzes public sentiment toward Indonesia's Free Nutritious Meal Program using the IndoBERT model on social media data. The results show that IndoBERT achieves high classification performance, with public sentiment being predominantly positive.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini menganalisis sentimen publik terhadap Program Makan Bergizi Gratis di Indonesia menggunakan model *IndoBERT* pada data media sosial. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa *IndoBERT* mencapai kinerja klasifikasi yang tinggi, dengan sentimen publik yang didominasi oleh kategori positif.

doi:10.54698/kl.2026.21.427.abstract: The purpose of this study is to empirically analyze the impact of Korean language classes utilizing English as a Medium of Instruction (EMI) on the academic achievement and perceptions of international students in the “English Track.” To this end, a 15-week study was conducted with 69 multinational learners enrolled in an elementary liberal arts Korean class at ‘S’ University in Daejeon. The findings are as follows: First, the English-mediated teaching method had a positive effect on the achievement of all learners, regardless of their region of origin. Both written and speaking scores rose across all regions between the midterm and final exams, with learners from Southeast Asia recording the highest levels of achievement and the most significant improvement. Second, learners reported a very high level of satisfaction with English-mediated instruction. In particular, auxiliary explanations in English during the stages of explaining grammatical rules, conjugations, and vocabulary meanings played a decisive role in lowering learning barriers and enhancing cognitive accessibility. Third, EMI(English as an Mdedium Instruction) reduced learners' psychological anxiety and improved their communicative self-efficacy. This led to approximately 74% of the learners expressing a strong intention to continue their Korean language studies in the future. In conclusion, for elementary-level English track learners with multinational and multilingual backgrounds, English has proven to be an effective strategic teaching and learning resource beyond a mere tool of convenience. This study proposes an efficient Korean language education model that aligns with the changing university environment and highlights the necessity of integrating English-mediated instruction with a systematic learning management system when designing future elementary Korean language curricula.
doi:10.54698/kl.2026.21.427.title: An Analysis of the Effects of English Medium of Korean Language Education for English Track : International Students: Focusing on Changes in Achievement by Region

doi:10.54923/researchreview.v5i2.566.abstract: This study aims to determine the effect of using the Duolingo application on the English vocabulary mastery of students at MTsN 2 Gorontalo Regency. The study employed a quantitative approach with a pre-experimental research design, specifically a one-group pre-test and post-test design. The participants were given a pre-test to measure their vocabulary mastery before receiving the treatment. They then participated in learning activities using the Duolingo application as a learning medium. After the treatment, a post-test was administered to measure changes in students’ vocabulary mastery following the use of the application. The research data were obtained from the students’ pre-test and post-test scores and were subsequently analyzed using the N-Gain score to determine the level of improvement in students’ vocabulary mastery. The results showed an improvement in students’ vocabulary mastery after the implementation of Duolingo in the learning process. This improvement was indicated by the difference between the students’ scores before and after the treatment. The N-Gain calculation demonstrated that the use of the Duolingo application contributed positively to students’ vocabulary improvement. In addition, Duolingo can serve as an engaging learning medium because it provides interactive learning activities and opportunities for students to practice vocabulary independently. Therefore, the use of Duolingo can positively contribute to improving the English vocabulary mastery of students at MTsN 2 Gorontalo Regency and can be considered an alternative learning medium to support English language instruction.
doi:10.54923/researchreview.v5i2.566.title: The Effect of the Duolingo Application on Junior High School Students’ Vocabulary Mastery at MTsN 2 Gorontalo Regency

doi:10.54938/ijemdss.2026.05.4.820.abstract: Classroom discourse is a complex socio-linguistic field where language options, involvement and institutional authority are negotiated in day-to-day pedagogical activities. The methodology adopted in this study is Critical Discourse Analysis (CDA) as developed by Fairclough for analysing the marginalization of indigenous language Sindhi in the multilingual classrooms in spite of its cultural importance. The qualitative research, based on audio-visual recordings of six classroom sessions, transcripts, and field observations from a public sector girls' degree college in Hyderabad, Sindh, shows three interrelated patterns: pupil utterances are limited to the teacher's initiative, learners who are Sindhi dominant cannot be central to the formal response when it is in Urdu or English, and Sindhi is used only in the informal support and not the academic explanation. These findings indicate that linguistic sustainability cannot solely be a policy problem, but one that is dependent on the everyday interactional choices that legitimate or marginalize indigenous languages. This study can provide the contribution to language teaching by making a direct connection between classroom discourse practices and the vitality of indigenous languages and by promoting inclusive multilingual approaches that view students' full linguistic systems as a resource for learning.

doi:10.55041/ijcope.v2i8.284.abstract: The proposed Raithu Sahayak system presents a voice-driven AI-based approach for assisting farmers with agricultural financial calculations. Traditional financial systems often require manual data entry and familiarity with digital interfaces, which can create difficulties for users with limited digital literacy. Raithu Sahayak addresses these limitations by allowing users to provide financial information through voice. The system uses speech recognition and text processing to identify relevant numerical information and performs calculations such as total cost, total income, and profit. The integration of regional-language interaction and text-to-speech output makes the system more accessible and user-friendly. The currency breakdown feature further helps users understand financial results in a practical manner. Overall, Raithu Sahayak demonstrates how voice-based AI can be used to simplify financial calculations and improve digital accessibility for farmers. Future enhancements can extend the system with additional regional languages, agricultural advisory services, real-time market information, and more advanced natural-language understanding.

doi:10.55123/storage.v5i3.8850.abstract: Batak script is a cultural heritage of the Batak people in North Sumatra that requires preservation through digitization. This study proposes the FastViT-SA12 architecture for handwritten Batak script recognition using the Batak Char 20 dataset, which consists of 117 character classes. To address data imbalance, data augmentation was performed using ImgAug, resulting in 650 images per class. The dataset was divided into training, validation, and testing sets with a ratio of 70:20:10, and all images were resized to 64 × 64 pixels to reduce computational overhead. The model was trained for 30 epochs using the Adam optimizer with a learning rate of 0.001 and a batch size of 64. The proposed model achieved a training accuracy of 99.97%, a validation accuracy of 97.96%, and a test accuracy of 89.31%, with weighted precision, recall, and F1-score of 91.84%, 89.31%, and 88.99%, respectively. FastViT-SA12 demonstrates promising potential for recognizing 117 Batak script classes while maintaining computational efficiency with a compact parameter footprint, making it a viable candidate for mobile-first Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems in manuscript preservation.

doi:10.55197/qjssh.v7i4.1277.abstract: Kata serapan Arab dalam bahasa Melayu mengalami perubahan leksikal, fonologi dan semantik. Perubahan leksikal dan bunyi dapat dikenalpasti dengan mudah, namun perubahan semantik merupakan aspek yang mencabar kerana melibatkan perbezaan makna antara bahasa sumber dan bahasa penerima yang memerlukan rujukan kamus dan konteks penggunaan. Perbezaan ini berpotensi menimbulkan kekeliruan dalam kalangan penutur, khususnya dalam domain agama yang berisiko membawa kepada kesalahan dalam pemahaman terhadap sesuatu kata. Justeru itu, kajian ini dijalankan untuk menganalisis semantik serta menjelaskan perubahan makna kata serapan Arab dalam bahasa Melayu berdasarkan perbandingan makna antara Kamus Lisan Arab (KLA) dan Kamus Dewan Perdana (KDP). Fokus kajian adalah pada lapan kata serapan Arab yang kerap digunakan dalam teks khutbah Hari Raya Aidilfitri 1447H/2026 bagi negeri-negeri dalam Zon Utara iaitu negeri Kedah, Perlis, Pulau Pinang dan Perak. Kata serapan yang dikaji adalah Islam, umat, rahmat, maksud, surah, ibadah, syukur dan berkat. Kajian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif melalui analisis dokumen dan perbandingan semantik berdasarkan teori perubahan semantik Millar. Dapatan kajian menunjukkan perubahan semantik yang mendominasi kata serapan yang dikaji adalah penyempitan makna, diikuti peluasan makna serta beberapa pemindahan makna dan perubahan sinekdoki. Oleh itu, dengan analisis semantik dalam kajian ini, makna kata serapan Arab dalam bahasa Melayu dan dalam bahasa asalnya dapat dilihat dengan lebih mudah dan jelas. Analisis ini memperlihatkan perbezaan makna antara kedua-dua bahasa dan diharap mampu memudahkan pemahaman serta mengelakkan kekeliruan penutur dalam memahami dan menggunakan kata serapan Arab pada masa akan datang. Arabic loanwords in the Malay language have undergone lexical, phonological, and semantic changes. While lexical and phonological changes can be identified relatively easily, semantic change remains a more challenging aspect as it involves differences in meaning between the source language and the recipient language, which require reference to dictionaries and contextual usage. These differences may lead to confusion among speakers, particularly within the religious domain, where misinterpretation of certain terms may occur. Therefore, this study was conducted to analyse the semantics and explain the semantic changes of Arabic loanwords in Malay through a comparison between the meanings recorded in Lisan al-Arab Dictionary (KLA) and Kamus Dewan Perdana (KDP). The study focuses on eight Arabic loanwords frequently used in the 1447H/2026 Eid al-Fitr sermon texts across the Northern Zone states of Kedah, Perlis, Penang, and Perak. The selected loanwords analysed in this study comprise Islam, umat, rahmat, maksud, surah, ibadah, syukur, and berkat. This study employed a qualitative approach through document analysis and semantic comparison based on Millar Semantic Change Theory. The findings indicate that semantic narrowing is the most dominant type of semantic change identified in the analysed loanwords, followed by semantic broadening, as well as several cases of semantic transfer and synecdochic change. Hence, the semantic analysis presented in this study enables the meanings of Arabic loanwords in Malay and their original Arabic meanings to be understood more clearly and systematically. The analysis highlights the semantic differences between the two languages and is expected to facilitate better understanding while reducing confusion among speakers in comprehending and using Arabic loanwords in the future.

doi:10.55197/qjssh.v7i4.1325.abstract: Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia (KPM) telah merangka Pelan Strategik Kementerian Pendidikan Malaysia (PSKPM) 2024–2030 bagi memperkukuh sistem pendidikan negara selaras dengan perkembangan pendidikan digital semasa. Dalam konteks ini, pelaksanaan Pentaksiran Bilik Darjah (PBD) berasaskan Kecerdasan Buatan Generatif (Gen-AI) bagi mata pelajaran Bahasa Melayu semakin mendapat perhatian, khususnya berkaitan isu kesahan dan kebolehpercayaan pentaksiran. Kajian ini bertujuan membincangkan isu dan cabaran pelaksanaan PBD menggunakan Gen-AI dalam mata pelajaran Bahasa Melayu. Kajian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif berbentuk tinjauan literatur melalui analisis dokumen, artikel jurnal dan laporan berkaitan PBD serta pendidikan digital. Dapatan kajian menunjukkan bahawa pelaksanaan PBD berasaskan Gen-AI berhadapan dengan pelbagai cabaran melibatkan guru, murid, pentadbir sekolah, infrastruktur serta sokongan ibu bapa dan masyarakat. Selain itu, isu kompetensi digital guru, tekanan pentaksiran berterusan, jurang digital dan ketidaksediaan infrastruktur turut mempengaruhi keberkesanan pelaksanaan PBD. Implikasi kajian menekankan kepentingan latihan profesional guru, penambahbaikan infrastruktur digital, pemantauan pentaksiran serta penggunaan teknologi secara beretika bagi memastikan kesahan dan kebolehpercayaan instrumen pentaksiran dapat dipertingkatkan. Kajian ini juga mencadangkan agar lebih banyak penyelidikan dijalankan berkaitan pembangunan instrumen PBD berasaskan Gen-AI yang lebih sistematik, autentik dan sesuai dengan konteks pendidikan Bahasa Melayu. The Ministry of Education Malaysia (MOE) introduced the Ministry of Education Malaysia Strategic Plan (PSKPM) 2024–2030 to strengthen digital education and assessment practices. In this context, the implementation of Classroom Assessment (PBD) using Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen-AI) in the Malay Language subject has raised concerns regarding the validity and reliability of assessment. This study aims to discuss the issues and challenges of implementing Gen-AI-based PBD in Malay Language education. A qualitative literature review approach was employed through the analysis of journal articles, reports, and related documents. The findings show that challenges involve teachers’ competency, students’ readiness, school management, infrastructure, and parental support. Issues such as digital competency, assessment pressure, and the digital divide also affect the effectiveness of PBD implementation. Therefore, continuous teacher training, infrastructure improvement, and ethical technology use are essential to ensure effective and reliable assessment practices. Future studies are recommended to focus on developing more systematic and authentic Gen-AI-based assessment instruments for Malay Language education.

doi:10.55197/qjssh.v7i4.1331.abstract: Kajian penyelidikan ini meneliti status sintaksis frasa preposisi sebagai objek tidak langsung dalam kata kerja dwitransitif bahasa Melayu. Tatabahasa Dewan menetapkan bahawa kata kerja dwitransitif hanya boleh diikuti oleh dua frasa determiner, manakala frasa preposisi dianggap sebagai penerang semata-mata. Walau bagaimanapun, kajian ini menguji semula pandangan tersebut melalui dua kaedah empirikal, iaitu analisis data korpus Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka (DBP) dan ujian kebolehterimaan ayat yang melibatkan 132 orang penutur natif bahasa Melayu daripada tiga kumpulan umur. Dapatan menunjukkan bahawa pola frasa determiner + frasa preposisi secara konsisten mencatatkan tahap kebolehterimaan yang lebih tinggi berbanding pola frasa determiner + frasa determiner merentas semua kumpulan umur. Berdasarkan kerangka Program Minimalis, kajian ini berhujah bahawa frasa preposisi dalam struktur dwitransitif bahasa Melayu berfungsi sebagai argumen wajib yang merealisasikan peranan tematik penerima, bukan sekadar adjung. Dapatan ini mencabar rumus preskriptif Tatabahasa Dewan dan menyumbang kepada pemahaman yang lebih tepat tentang sistem dwitransitif bahasa Melayu. This research study investigates the syntactic status of prepositional phrases as indirect objects in Malay ditransitive verbs. Tatabahasa Dewan maintains that ditransitive verbs may only be followed by two determiner phrases, while prepositional phrases are treated merely as modifiers. However, this study re-examines this claim through two empirical methods: an analysis of corpus data from the Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka (DBP) corpus and an acceptability judgement task involving 132 native speakers of Malay from three age groups. The findings indicate that the determiner phrase + prepositional phrase pattern consistently receives higher acceptability ratings than the determiner phrase + determiner phrase pattern across all age groups. Within the framework of the Minimalist Program, this study argues that prepositional phrases in Malay ditransitive constructions function as obligatory arguments that realise the Recipient thematic role rather than serving merely as adjuncts. These findings challenge the prescriptive account advanced in Tatabahasa Dewan and contribute to a more accurate understanding of the Malay ditransitive system.

doi:10.55197/qjssh.v7i4.1357.abstract: Cerita rakyat merupakan warisan sastera lisan yang berperanan penting dalam menyampaikan nilai, norma serta pandangan hidup masyarakat Melayu. Kajian ini bertujuan untuk mengenal pasti kebijaksanaan jati diri Melayu serta menganalisis konstruksi minda masyarakat Melayu yang terkandung dalam teks Himpunan Cerita Rakyat Seluruh Jajahan Kelantan. Kajian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif melalui kaedah kepustakaan dan analisis teks terhadap beberapa cerita rakyat terpilih. Bagi tujuan analisis, Teori Pengkaedahan Melayu oleh Hashim Awang digunakan sebagai kerangka utama dengan penekanan kepada pendekatan firasat. Pendekatan ini membolehkan pengkaji meneliti makna tersirat, simbol serta perlambangan yang mencerminkan cara pemikiran masyarakat Melayu. Hasil kajian mendapati bahawa cerita rakyat Kelantan mengandungi pelbagai nilai jati diri Melayu yang merangkumi aspek budaya, agama, politik dan ekonomi, sekali gus membentuk pola pemikiran masyarakat yang berteraskan akal budi, kepercayaan dan pengalaman hidup. Selain itu, dapatan kajian turut menunjukkan bahawa cerita rakyat bukan sahaja berfungsi sebagai hiburan, malah berperanan sebagai medium pembentukan pemikiran dan identiti masyarakat Melayu. Oleh itu, kajian ini diharap dapat menyumbang kepada pemahaman yang lebih mendalam tentang peranan cerita rakyat dalam memperkukuhkan jati diri serta konstruksi minda Melayu dalam konteks semasa. Folktales represent a form of oral literature that plays a significant role in conveying values, norms, and the worldview of the Malay community. This study aims to identify the wisdom of Malay identity and to analyse the construction of the Malay mindset as reflected in the text Himpunan Cerita Rakyat Seluruh Jajahan Kelantan. This research adopts a qualitative approach through library research and textual analysis of selected folktales. The analysis is guided by the Malay Methodology Theory introduced by Hashim Awang, with particular emphasis on the intuitive (firasat) approach. This approach enables the researcher to interpret implicit meanings, symbols, and representations embedded in the narratives, which reflect the patterns of Malay thought. The findings indicate that Kelantanese folktales encompass various elements of Malay identity, including cultural, religious, political, and economic aspects, which collectively shape the community’s way of thinking based on intellect, belief, and lived experience. In addition, the study reveals that folktales function not merely as a form of entertainment but also as a medium for shaping identity and intellectual perspectives within Malay society. Therefore, this study contributes to a deeper understanding of the role of folktales in strengthening Malay identity and the construction of the Malay mindset in contemporary contexts.

doi:10.55197/qjssh.v7i4.1358.abstract: Naratif lisan merupakan sebahagian karya kesusasteraan Melayu yang menjadi khazanah warisan budaya bagi mencerminkan gaya hidup serta pemikiran masyarakat Melayu. Konsep akal budi memiliki perkaitan dengan cerita rakyat di bawah naratif lisan kerana merupakan satu bentuk pemikiran yang tercetus dengan menggunakan kebijaksanaan melalui pengalaman atau penghayatan seseorang individu. Oleh itu, kajian ini dilakukan bagi mengenal pasti dan menganalisis manifestasi kepimpinan Islam dan akal budi yang terkandung dalam teks Seuntaian Naratif Lisan di Lembangan Sungai Pengkalan Datu, Kelantan. Kajian ini hanya membataskan kepada tiga (3) naratif lisan dalam teks pilihan seperti cerita berjudul Terhempasnya Zero Fighter Jepun di Ti Lebar, Asal Usul Kampung Babong dan Asal Usul Datu. Tambahan lagi, kajian ini menggunakan reka bentuk kualitatif iaitu berdasarkan kaedah kepustakaan dan analisis teks. Kajian ini turut menggunakan teori pengkaedahan Melayu dengan memfokuskan pengkaedahan keagamaan. Oleh itu, hasil kajian mendapati bahawa naratif lisan yang dipilih oleh pengkaji menunjukkan manifestasi kepimpinan Islam dan akal budi berkait dengan elemen kemampuan menyelesaikan masalah dan keputusan, berkeyakinan tinggi dan ketinggian motivasi diri. Oleh itu, jelaslah bahawa naratif lisan sememangnya mampu memberikan pendidikan kepada khalayak dengan mengambil kira pendedahan konsep kepimpinan birokrasi untuk kebaikan sejagat. Oral narratives are part of Malay literary works that are a treasure trove of cultural heritage to reflect the lifestyle and thinking of the Malay community. The concept of common sense is related to folklore under oral narratives because it is a form of thinking that is triggered by using wisdom through an individual's experience or appreciation. Therefore, this study was conducted to identify and analyze the manifestations of Islamic leadership and common sense contained in the text Seuntaian Naratif Lisan di Lembangan Sungai Pengkalan Datu, Kelantan. This study is only limited to three (3) oral narratives in selected texts such as the story titled Terhempasnya Zero Fighter Jepun di Ti Lebar, Asal Usul Kampung Babong and Asal Usul Datu. In addition, this study uses a qualitative design based on the method of literature and text analysis. This study also uses the theory of Malay method. Therefore, the results of the study found that the oral narratives chosen by the researcher show manifestations of Islamic leadership and common sense related to the elements of problem-solving and decision-making ability, high confidence and high self-motivation. Therefore, it is clear that oral communication is indeed capable of providing education to the audience by taking into account the exposure of the concept of bureaucratic leadership for the universal good.

doi:10.55204/trc.v6i2.e726.abstract: Sentiment analysis in digital environments has undergone a rapid methodological evolution, transitioning from classic sequential models to deep learning architectures capable of understanding profound human linguistic context. To examine this progression, a systematic review was conducted applying the PRISMA protocol, evaluating high-impact empirical studies (2020-2025) extracted from Scopus, IEEE Xplore, Web of Science, etc. The findings validate the efficacy of these technologies in real-world scenarios, highlighting their use in e-commerce satisfaction monitoring and public health trend assessment. However, the review reveals a priority research gap: the urgency of integrating algorithmic explainability (XAI) from the system's conception and democratizing these tools for low-resource languages. It is concluded that the current state of the art lies in combining Transformers and Large Language Models (LLMs) with parameter-efficient adaptation techniques (such as LoRA), offering organizations an optimal balance between maximum predictive accuracy and computational viability.
doi:10.55204/trc.v6i2.e726.title: Análisis De Sentimiento y Minería De Opiniones En Entornos Digitales Mediante Deep Learning: evolución desde modelos secuenciales hasta modelos de lenguaje de gran escala (LLMs)

doi:10.55210/asmaraloka.v4i2.659.abstract: Fenomena campur kode bahasa Inggris dalam tuturan bahasa Indonesia sering ditemukan pada interaksi guru dan siswa di SMK Negeri 8 Samarinda. Penelitian kualitatif deskriptif ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan bentuk dan faktor penyebab fenomena tersebut. Data dikumpulkan melalui teknik rekam dan catat, lalu dianalisis menggunakan metode padan pragmatik serta model SPEAKING Dell Hymes untuk memahami konteks peristiwa tutur secara menyeluruh. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bentuk campur kode dominan berupa penyisipan kata dan frasa asing, seperti next, join, stop, dan break, yang muncul dalam situasi formal maupun informal. Fenomena ini dipicu oleh faktor penutur, yakni latar belakang kebahasaan dan keinginan membangun suasana santai, serta faktor kebahasaan terkait kepraktisan istilah tertentu. Disimpulkan bahwa campur kode berfungsi sebagai strategi komunikasi untuk mempermudah penyampaian pesan dan beradaptasi dengan dinamika lingkungan pendidikan. Penggunaan unsur asing tersebut membantu menciptakan interaksi yang lebih efektif dan komunikatif dalam proses pembelajaran di sekolah.

doi:10.55210/asmaraloka.v4i2.692.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan bentuk, proses pembentukan, serta fungsi reduplikasi bahasa Indonesia dalam buku kumpulan cerpen Perempuan Pelangi karya Nelly Martin. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan metode analisis isi (content analysis). Sumber data penelitian berupa buku kumpulan cerpen Perempuan Pelangi karya Nelly Martin yang diterbitkan oleh PT Grasindo tahun 2014. Data penelitian berupa satuan kebahasaan yang mengandung proses reduplikasi, meliputi reduplikasi utuh, reduplikasi sebagian, reduplikasi perubahan bunyi, dan reduplikasi dasar berafiks. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik simak, teknik catat, dan teknik klasifikasi data. Analisis data menggunakan metode agih dan metode padan untuk mengidentifikasi bentuk dasar, proses pembentukan, serta fungsi penggunaan reduplikasi dalam teks sastra. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa reduplikasi utuh sebesar 57,1% merupakan bentuk yang paling dominan ditemukan dalam buku cerpen Perempuan Pelangi karya Nelly Martin. Ditemukan pula reduplikasi sebagian 1,7%, reduplikasi perubahan bunyi 9,2%, serta reduplikasi dasar berafiks dengan prefiks ber-, meN-, ter-, berkonfiks ber-an, se-nya, berkonfiks me-kan dan me-i, serta bersufiks -an 31,9%. Penggunaan reduplikasi dalam cerpen tidak hanya berfungsi secara gramatikal, tetapi juga memiliki fungsi estetis dan ekspresif untuk memperkuat suasana, penegasan makna, intensitas tindakan, serta penggambaran emosi tokoh dalam cerita.

doi:10.55227/ijhess.v6i1.2420.abstract: This study analyzes public sentiment in YouTube comments on felt-earthquake news in Indonesia and compares a bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory implementation (LSTM) with IndoBERT. An experimental quantitative design was used. Comments were collected through the YouTube Data API v3 using official earthquake-event references from the Indonesian Agency for Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics (BMKG) and keyword-based video searches covering January 2021 to August 2025. The acquisition stage produced 51,870 comments from 1,626 unique videos. Data were processed through duplicate removal, text cleaning, case folding, slang normalization, tokenization, and stopword removal, resulting in 49,041 clean comments. Positive, negative, and neutral labels were assigned by aggregating word-polarity scores from the Indonesian Sentiment Lexicon (InSet), which served as weak supervision. Stratified sampling divided the dataset into 80% training data and 20% testing data. The LSTM model used a 100-dimensional embedding, a 64-unit bidirectional LSTM layer, global max pooling, and early stopping; IndoBERT was fine-tuned from indobenchmark/indobert-base-p2 for four epochs. Performance was assessed with accuracy, macro precision, macro recall, macro F1-score, and confusion matrices. Positive sentiment accounted for 41.2% of the corpus, negative sentiment for 35.5%, and neutral sentiment for 23.2%. IndoBERT achieved 91.50% accuracy and a 91.03% macro F1-score, outperforming LSTM at 90.91% accuracy and a 90.34% macro F1-score. IndoBERT provided the strongest contextual classification, while LSTM remained a competitive and substantially lighter option for resource-constrained monitoring

doi:10.5530/irc.3.3.34.abstract: This study presents a bibliometric analysis of financial behavior research in Southeast Asia from 2020 to 2025, aiming to map its intellectual structure, research trends, and emerging themes. Using data retrieved from the Open Alex database and analyzed through VOS viewer and Bibliometrix, the study examines publication growth, influential authors, journals, institutions, and collaborative networks. Findings reveal a rapid increase in research output, with Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore leading in productivity and impact. Core themes center on financial literacy, finance, business, and economics, while emerging topics include digital finance, fintech adoption, and behavioral perspectives. The analysis also highlights strong intra-regional collaboration but limited global integration. The study underscores the importance of financial behavior in promoting financial inclusion, economic stability, and individual well-being. By providing a comprehensive overview, the findings offer valuable insights for researchers, policymakers, and practitioners in developing evidence-based financial strategies in the Southeast Asian context.
doi:10.5530/irc.3.3.34.title: Mapping the Research Structure of Financial Behavior in Southeast Asia: A Bibliometric Review

doi:10.55606/jupti.v5i3.8152.abstract: This study was motivated by the large volume of user reviews for the DANA application on the Google Play Store, which contain diverse opinions regarding user experiences. While these reviews offer insights into user satisfaction and perceptions, systematic analysis is required to identify the underlying sentiments. This research aims to classify DANA user reviews into positive, negative, and neutral sentiment categories using the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm. The dataset was sourced from the "DANA Sentiment Analysis from Indonesian Play Store" dataset, comprising 50,000 reviews, from which a subset of 1,500 reviews was selected using stratified sampling. The research process involved text preprocessing, TF-IDF feature weighting, data splitting, and sentiment classification using SVM with a linear kernel. Model performance was evaluated using a confusion matrix, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The results indicate that the SVM model achieved an accuracy of 82.00%, demonstrating the method's effectiveness in classifying the sentiment of DANA user reviews. These findings can serve as supporting information for identifying user responses and evaluating the user experience with the DANA application.

doi:10.56201/ijcsmt.vol.12.no6.2026.pg73.abstract: Machine Translation (MT) systems for low-resource languages are scarce, particularly for highly divergent languages like Kalabari, a Niger-Congo language of the Ijo family. The persistent exclusion of these languages from modern language technologies is largely driven by a lack of parallel corpora, standardized tools, and the massive computational resources typically required for Neural Machine Translation (NMT). This research addresses this hardware bottleneck by detailing the end-to-end implementation of a foundational NMT system built entirely on consumer-grade CPU hardware. To establish this benchmark, a parallel corpus of 10,222 sentence pairs was manually created from available texts, carefully cleaned, and tokenized using SentencePiece Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) to mitigate morphological sparsity. A lightweight Transformer architecture was trained from scratch in OpenNMT-py on an AMD Ryzen 9 processor with 8GB RAM, utilizing SSD swap space and gradient accumulation to overcome memory limitations. The system achieved BLEU scores of 15.8 (Kalabari-to-English) and 13.5 (English-to-Kalabari), alongside promising chrF2 scores of 37.2 and 39.7 respectively. For deployment, the model was served on CPU using INT8 quantization via CTranslate2, a standard technique for reducing model size and accelerating inference on commodity hardware. The results demonstrate a reproducible, CPU-centric pipeline, proving that the lack of specialized GPU infrastructure is not an insurmountable obstacle for digital language preservation and baseline NMT development.

doi:10.56201/ijelcs.vol.11.no6.2026.pg50.abstract: Fulfulde, spoken by an estimated 25-30 million people across West and Central Africa, remains underrepresented in digital spaces despite its role as a lingua franca among pastoralist and rural communities. This paper examines how the integration of Fulfulde Studies with Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) can advance three interrelated goals: 1) language documentation and preservation, 2) mother-tongue and bilingual education, and 3) digital inclusion for marginalized populations in West Africa. Drawing on models from Cameroon, Nigeria, and broader sub-Saharan ICT interventions, we propose a framework called “Mdocumentation for Fulfulde” that combines corpus building, mobile learning platforms, AI assisted transcription, and community-driven content creation. The study addresses structural barriers such as poor connectivity, low digital literacy, and limited institutional support, while highlighting opportunities in open distance learning and multilingual digital pedagogy. Findings suggest that localizing ICT in Fulfulde can reduce the digital divide, improve educational outcomes, and support cultural continuity. We conclude with policy and research recommendations for governments, universities, and tech actors to mainstream Fulfulde in West Africa’s digital ecosystem. 5574c55a08e953da173e8d9f

background.en: Fulfulde is spoken by an estimated 25 to 30 million people across West and Central Africa and serves as a lingua franca among pastoralist and rural communities. Despite this significant speaker population, the language remains underrepresented in digital spaces. This lack of representation creates a critical gap that hinders language preservation, mother-tongue education, and digital inclusion for marginalized populations in the region.

Terlepas dari populasi penutur yang signifikan ini, bahasa tersebut tetap kurang terwakili di ruang digital. Kurangnya representasi ini menciptakan kesenjangan kritis yang menghambat pelestarian bahasa, pendidikan bahasa ibu, dan inklusi digital bagi populasi marjinal di wilayah tersebut.

contributions.en: The main contribution is the proposal of a comprehensive framework called Mdocumentation for Fulfulde. These prior efforts provide insights into addressing structural barriers such as poor connectivity, low digital literacy, and limited institutional support in developing contexts.

Upaya-upaya terdahulu ini memberikan wawasan dalam mengatasi hambatan struktural seperti konektivitas yang buruk, literasi digital yang rendah, dan dukungan kelembagaan yang terbatas dalam konteks berkembang.

results.en: Findings suggest that localizing ICT in Fulfulde can successfully reduce the digital divide, improve educational outcomes, and support cultural continuity. The study concludes with policy and research recommendations for governments, universities, and tech actors to mainstream Fulfulde in West Africa's digital ecosystem.
results.id: Temuan menunjukkan bahwa melokalisasi *ICT* dalam bahasa Fulfulde dapat berhasil mengurangi kesenjangan digital, meningkatkan hasil pendidikan, dan mendukung kelanjutan budaya. Studi ini ditutup dengan rekomendasi kebijakan dan penelitian bagi pemerintah, universitas, dan pelaku teknologi untuk mengarusutamakan bahasa Fulfulde dalam ekosistem digital Afrika Barat.

tldr.en: This paper examines how integrating Fulfulde Studies with Information and Communication Technologies advances language documentation, education, and digital inclusion in West Africa. Findings suggest that localizing ICT in Fulfulde reduces the digital divide, improves educational outcomes, and supports cultural continuity.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengkaji bagaimana integrasi *Fulfulde Studies* dengan *Information and Communication Technologies* memajukan dokumentasi bahasa, pendidikan, dan inklusi digital di Afrika Barat. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa melokalisasi *ICT* dalam bahasa Fulfulde mengurangi kesenjangan digital, meningkatkan hasil pendidikan, dan mendukung kelanjutan budaya.

doi:10.56201/wjimt.v10.no6.2026.pg272.27.abstract: The development of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools for endangered and low resource languages is fundamentally hindered by the scarcity of high-quality parallel data. Data for languages like Kalabari is not only scarce but often noisy, inconsistently digitized, and orthographically unstandardized. While prior work has leveraged religious texts for corpus creation, the specific challenges of extracting and normalizing morphologically rich languages with complex diacritics remain underexplored. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a reproducible, modular curation methodology tailored for such languages. We document a six-step pipeline that transforms raw digital texts—sourced from the Kalabari Bible (FiaFia Biabulu) and instructional literature (Kalabari Lingua)—into a clean, verse aligned, 10,222-pair parallel corpus. We demonstrate that enforcing Normalization Form C (NFC) is critical for preserving sub-dot diacritics, and we validate the corpus by training a baseline Transformer NMT system. Our contributions are threefold: (1) a transferable curation framework for endangered languages, (2) the first sizable Kalabari-English parallel corpus, and (3) baseline experiments that reveal both the promise and the hallucination pitfalls of training on highly constrained, domain-specific data.

doi:10.56324/jariyah.v12i1.113.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis dampak penggunaan bahasa daerah terhadap kemampuan siswa dalam menguasai Bahasa Indonesia di SDN 3 Baroko, Kecamatan Baroko, Kabupaten Enrekang. Dengan pendekatan kualitatif jenis studi kasus, penelitian ini melibatkan siswa kelas IV, V, VI, guru, serta orang tua. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi dan wawancara mendalam untuk mengeksplorasi pola penggunaan bahasa daerah dan pengaruhnya terhadap keterampilan berbahasa Indonesia, meliputi membaca, menulis, berbicara, dan mendengarkan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan bahasa daerah memberikan dampak positif berupa kemudahan siswa memahami materi pada tahap awal pembelajaran, meningkatkan rasa percaya diri, serta memperkuat identitas budaya lokal. Namun, dampak negatif juga ditemukan, seperti kesulitan siswa dalam menguasai istilah formal Bahasa Indonesia, yang memengaruhi hasil belajar dan kemampuan mengikuti ujian. Solusi yang ditawarkan meliputi peningkatan intensitas penggunaan Bahasa Indonesia di sekolah, pelatihan bagi guru dalam pengajaran dwibahasa, penggunaan media pembelajaran berbasis Bahasa Indonesia, serta program literasi. Kolaborasi antara guru dan orang tua juga penting untuk memperkuat penguasaan Bahasa Indonesia di rumah. Dengan strategi yang seimbang, pelestarian bahasa daerah dapat dilakukan tanpa menghambat penguasaan Bahasa Indonesia sebagai bahasa resmi pendidikan nasional.

doi:10.56444/soshumdik.v5i3.3848.abstract: Ancient Indonesian manuscripts are a written cultural heritage containing a wealth of information about the lives, beliefs, laws, and traditions of past societies. Therefore, their preservation is crucial. Manuscript replication is the process of copying a manuscript while maintaining the physical and visual features of the original manuscript so that it can be used without further deteriorating the fragile original collection. The purpose of this research was to determine the technical aspects of making and testing the feasibility of replicas of ancient Indonesian manuscripts held at the National Library of Indonesia. This research used a descriptive qualitative approach. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, documentation, and observations with librarians, replica craftsmen, and the head of the Nusantara manuscript collection service. The Theory of Copy and Facsimile Representation was used to analyze the replication technique and evaluate the feasibility of the replicas. The results showed that the replication process was carried out through systematic stages, including selecting the manuscripts to be replicated, digitizing the original manuscripts, determining the media and materials for the replicas, and manually copying by craftsmen, taking into account the typology of the script, layout, and page structure, before the evaluation and submission stage. Replicas deemed suitable were then given special labels as markers and used in exhibitions and education. This research shows that replication allows for safer public access to cultural heritage. Manuscript replication also serves as a means of physical preservation of collections.

Proses mengubah bentuk fisik naskah menjadi format digital.
