background.en: Ancient Indonesian manuscripts represent a vital written cultural heritage that contains extensive information regarding the traditions, laws, beliefs, and past societies of Indonesia. Because these original collections are fragile and susceptible to damage, their preservation is of utmost importance. However, restricting access entirely limits their utility for education and exhibition, creating a gap between the need to preserve the physical items and the necessity of providing public access.
background.id: Naskah kuno Nusantara merepresentasikan warisan budaya tulis yang sangat penting yang memuat informasi ekstensif mengenai tradisi, hukum, kepercayaan, dan masyarakat masa lalu di Indonesia. Karena koleksi asli ini rapuh dan rentan terhadap kerusakan, pelestariannya menjadi hal yang sangat penting. Namun, pembatasan akses sepenuhnya membatasi kegunaannya untuk edukasi dan pameran, menciptakan kesenjangan antara kebutuhan untuk melestarikan benda fisik dan keharusan menyediakan akses publik.

contributions.en: The primary contribution of this research is the documentation and analysis of the technical procedures involved in making and testing the feasibility of ancient manuscript replicas at the National Library of the Republic of Indonesia. The study demonstrates how systematic replication acts as both a physical preservation method and a safe alternative for public exhibition and educational use.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama dari penelitian ini adalah dokumentasi dan analisis prosedur teknis yang terlibat dalam pembuatan dan pengujian kelayakan replika naskah kuno di Perpustakaan Nasional Republik Indonesia. Studi ini menunjukkan bagaimana *replication* yang sistematis bertindak sebagai metode *preservation* fisik sekaligus alternatif yang aman untuk pameran publik dan penggunaan edukasional.

method.en: This study adopted a descriptive qualitative approach to investigate the manuscript replication process. Data were gathered through semi-structured interviews, direct observations, and documentation involving librarians, replica craftsmen, and the head of the Nusantara manuscript collection service. The Theory of Copy and Facsimile Representation served as the analytical framework to evaluate the replication techniques and the feasibility of the resulting replicas.
method.id: Studi ini mengadopsi pendekatan *descriptive qualitative* untuk menyelidiki proses *replication* naskah. Data dikumpulkan melalui wawancara semi-terstruktur, observasi langsung, dan dokumentasi yang melibatkan pustakawan, pengrajin replika, dan kepala layanan koleksi naskah Nusantara. Teori *Copy and Facsimile Representation* digunakan sebagai kerangka kerja analitis untuk mengevaluasi teknik replikasi dan kelayakan replika yang dihasilkan.

results.en: The findings reveal that the replication process follows systematic stages: selecting manuscripts, digitizing originals, selecting appropriate media and materials, and performing manual copying by craftsmen who pay close attention to script typology, layout, and page structure. Following an evaluation stage, suitable replicas are marked with special labels and deployed for exhibitions and educational purposes, thereby confirming that replication successfully facilitates safer public access and physical preservation.
results.id: Temuan mengungkapkan bahwa proses *replication* mengikuti tahapan yang sistematis: pemilihan naskah, digitalisasi naskah asli, pemilihan media dan bahan yang tepat, serta penyalinan manual oleh pengrajin yang memperhatikan tipologi aksara, tata letak, dan struktur halaman dengan cermat. Setelah tahap *evaluation*, replika yang layak diberi label khusus dan digunakan untuk pameran serta keperluan edukasi, sehingga menegaskan bahwa replikasi berhasil memfasilitasi akses publik yang lebih aman dan *preservation* fisik.

tldr.en: This research investigates the technical aspects and feasibility of creating replicas of ancient Indonesian manuscripts at the National Library of Indonesia. The findings demonstrate that systematic replication processes successfully provide safer public access while physically preserving fragile original cultural heritage collections.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengkaji aspek teknis dan kelayakan pembuatan replika naskah kuno Nusantara di Perpustakaan Nasional Republik Indonesia. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa proses *replication* yang sistematis berhasil menyediakan akses publik yang lebih aman sekaligus melestarikan koleksi warisan budaya asli yang rapuh.

doi:10.56705/ijodas.v7i2.445.abstract: Gold price movements are closely monitored by investors because gold functions as both a safe-haven asset and a hedging instrument. With the rapid growth of social media, public discussions provide valuable insights into market sentiment. This study proposes a weakly supervised sentiment classification framework for analyzing Indonesian public sentiment toward gold prices on Platform X. A total of 7.283 Indonesian-language tweets were collected using the keyword “harga emas” during the 2023–2025 period. After preprocessing, 4.429 tweets were retained for sentiment labeling and model development. Sentiment labels were automatically generated using a domain-specific lexicon and subsequently validated through manual annotation to assess label reliability before model training. Four classification models, namely Naïve Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and IndoBERT, were evaluated. Manual validation produced a Cohen's Kappa coefficient of 0.8718, indicating almost perfect agreement between annotators, while the lexicon-based labels achieved an accuracy of 70.62% against the manually annotated gold-standard dataset. Among the evaluated models, IndoBERT achieved the best performance with an accuracy of 98.31% and a Macro F1-score of 98.16%, outperforming SVM, Naïve Bayes, and KNN. However, evaluation using the manually annotated dataset yielded an accuracy of 69.49%, indicating that downstream classification performance remains dependent on the quality of weakly supervised labels. These findings demonstrate that weak supervision is an efficient strategy for large-scale sentiment annotation while emphasizing the importance of label validation for reliable sentiment classification in Indonesian financial social media

doi:10.56874/xe2nnw58.abstract: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa: 1) Keterampilan gu mengelola kelas pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indoensia di SD 140 Batang Gadis sudah tampak terampil, yang mana hal tersebut didapatkan dari hasil penelitian, yaitu: pertama, dari segi mengelola kondisi kelas yang meliputi pengelolaan kebersihan kelas, pengaturan tempat duduk dengan format kolom dan baris, penempatan poster /gambar/media pendidikan mudah terlihat dan rapi, tetapi dari segi pengaturan udara, masih kurang terampil karena dari upaya guru Bahasa Indonesia tersebut membuat beberapa siswa tidak nyaman. Kedua, dari segi sikap tanggap yang mana dari segi ini guru senantiasa tanggap terhadap aktivitas siswa, ketiga dari segi pemberian perhatian kelompok, guru memberi perhatian yang sama kepada setiap siswa tanpa membedakan-bedakannya, keempat keterampilan memberi petunjuk dan tujuan yang jelas juga sudah dilakukannya dan didukung oleh penggunaan bahasa yang jelas, kelima keterampilan dari segi memberi teguran, guru pun sudah terampil karena telah memberikan teguran dengan baik dan tidak mempermalukan siswa, sementara dalam memberi penguatan dilakukan dengan memberi pujian dan motivasi kepada siswa; 2) Kendala guru dalam mengelola kelas pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di kelas SD 140 Batang Gadis, yakni sistem kurikulum yang selalu berubah, keterbatasan guru yang menguasai sistem pembelajaran K13, kemudian faktor siswa itu sendiri dan ketersediaan sarana dan prasarana yang dimiliki sekolah.

doi:10.5815/ijem.2026.04.07.abstract: Fake news has become a major challenge in today’s digital environment, particularly in languages where labeled data is limited. Most existing research has primarily focused on English due to the easy availability of annotated datasets, whereas low-resource languages such as Bengali remain underexplored. This study presents a multilingual approach for fake news detection using machine learning with contextual-based feature extraction. The proposed method integrates n-gram techniques with sentence-level contextual embeddings to capture both word-level patterns and semantic meaning. Since labeled data is not available for the Bengali dataset, a translation-based strategy is employed, followed by a pseudo-labeling process to assign labels automatically. The models are trained on English news titles and subsequently evaluated on both English and Bengali datasets to examine their cross-lingual effectiveness. The experimental findings indicate that ensemble-based classifiers such as Random Forest and Gradient Boosting achieve reliable performance across both languages. In some cases, the results for Bengali data are comparable or slightly better than those for English. The study demonstrates that effective fake news detection is possible in low-resource languages using short text data without relying on manually labeled datasets. The proposed approach provides a simple and efficient solution for multilingual fake news detection in data-scarce environments.

doi:10.5815/ijisa.2026.04.12.abstract: The high flow of information from online media in Indonesia makes it difficult for manual analysis to identify emerging themes and sentiments. News headlines, as the first element seen by the public, play a crucial role in shaping opinion, but their massive volume and diverse themes make it difficult for manual analysis to identify topics and their underlying sentiments. To address this challenge, this study analyzed 30,329 news headlines from the online news portal detik.com for the entire year 2024. A quantitative Natural Language Processing (NLP) framework was applied, consisting of data collection through web scraping, text preprocessing, transformer-based topic modeling using BERTopic, sentiment classification using IndoBERT, and a topic sentiment intersection analysis. Preprocessing included case folding, text cleaning, normalization of informal words, and tokenization. For lexicon-based labeling, stopword removal and stemming were applied, while transformer-based models utilized minimally processed text to preserve contextual information. Topic modeling was performed using BERTopic, while sentiment classification (positive, negative, and neutral) used the IndoBERT model. The main objective of this study was to evaluate the combined performance of the two models in mapping dominant issues and the sentiments contained in media reports. The results showed that BERTopic successfully identified 366 topics. An evaluation of the 10 most dominant topics yielded a coherence score of 0.5145, indicating a relevant topic clustering. The IndoBERT demonstrated high agreement with lexicon-generated sentiment labels, with an accuracy of 94.78%, a precision of 95.04%, a recall of 94.79%, and an F1-score of 94.81%. These findings confirm that the combination of transformer-based models is effective for in-depth analysis of discourse in Indonesian-language political news headlines from a major Indonesian online news portal (detik.com).

doi:10.5815/ijisa.2026.04.12.title: Topic Modeling and Sentiment Analysis on News Headlines Using BERTopic and IndoBERT Models
doi:10.5815/ijisa.2026.04.12.venue: International Journal of Intelligent Systems and Applications

doi:10.58230/27454312.4914.abstract: Pembelajaran literasi Bahasa Indonesia di sekolah dasar sering kali masih sebatas pemahaman teks secara harfiah dan kurang memanfaatkan realitas kultural siswa, sehingga potensinya untuk menumbuhkan kepekaan sosial belum optimal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan implementasi strategi integrasi kearifan lokal Tari Cepetan dalam pembelajaran literasi kritis dan menganalisis dampaknya terhadap pembentukan lingkungan belajar inklusif. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan desain studi kasus deskriptif pada siswa kelas 4 di SDN 1 Korowelang, Kabupaten Kebumen. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi partisipatif, wawancara semi-terstruktur, dan studi dokumen, yang kemudian dianalisis secara interaktif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa transformasi narasi sejarah dan filosofi Tari Cepetan menjadi teks wacana analitis berhasil meningkatkan nalar kritis siswa terhadap nilai kesetaraan. Secara empiris, implementasi ini berdampak pada peningkatan interaksi inklusif antarsiswa secara signifikan, yang ditandai dengan tumbuhnya sikap saling menghargai pendapat dan kemauan berkolaborasi tanpa membedakan latar belakang kemampuan. Meskipun ditemukan tantangan berupa kendala pemahaman kosakata historis dan dominasi siswa tertentu pada awal diskusi, intervensi pedagogis melalui pemberian perancah (scaffolding) kebahasaan terbukti mampu mengatasi hambatan tersebut. Penelitian ini menegaskan bahwa kearifan lokal dapat melampaui fungsi apresiasi seni dan bertransformasi menjadi instrumen pedagogis yang efektif untuk mengeliminasi eksklusivitas sosial melalui ranah kebahasaan.
doi:10.58230/27454312.4914.title: Integrasi Nilai Kearifan Lokal dalam Literasi Kritis: Strategi Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia untuk Membangun Lingkungan Belajar Inklusif di Sekolah Dasar

doi:10.58266/jpmb.v4i4.1596.abstract: Kegiatan pengabdian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan kompetensi mahasiswa Fakultas Keguruan dan Ilmu Pendidikan (FKIP) Universitas Kristen Indonesia (UKI) Tana Toraja dalam mengembangkan instrumen tes dan non-tes berbasis kecerdasan buatan (Artificial Intelligence/AI) sebagai calon pendidik. Metode pelaksanaan menggunakan pendekatan pelatihan partisipatif berbasis proyek (project-based) yang terdiri atas sosialisasi, pelatihan penyusunan instrumen tes dan non-tes, penerapan teknologi AI melalui teknik prompt engineering, serta pendampingan telaah dan validasi instrumen, yang dilaksanakan pada tanggal 7–9 Mei 2026 dan diikuti oleh mahasiswa FKIP UKI Tana Toraja. Hasil pelaksanaan kegiatan menunjukkan bahwa peserta mengalami peningkatan pemahaman dalam menyusun kisi-kisi, mengembangkan butir soal berbasis HOTS, merancang instrumen non-tes, serta memanfaatkan AI secara terarah dan bertanggung jawab dalam mendukung proses evaluasi pembelajaran. Dapat disimpulkan bahwa kegiatan pelatihan dan pendampingan ini berkontribusi terhadap peningkatan kompetensi mahasiswa sebagai calon pendidik dalam mengembangkan instrumen asesmen berbasis teknologi AI yang valid, reliabel, dan siap diterapkan dalam praktik pembelajaran, microteaching, maupun Praktik Pengalaman Lapangan (PPL).
doi:10.58266/jpmb.v4i4.1596.title: Pelatihan dan Pendampingan Pengembangan Instrumen Tes dan Non-Tes Berbasis AI Bagi Mahasiswa FKIP UKI Tana Toraja

doi:10.58344/jig.v4i8.587.abstract: Pengelolaan sampah di wilayah pedesaan masih menghadapi berbagai kendala, terutama terkait dengan keterbatasan sarana pengolahan dan maraknya praktik pembakaran terbuka yang berdampak pada pencemaran udara serta gangguan kesehatan masyarakat. Kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan mengimplementasikan teknologi Rocket Stove sebagai alternatif pembakaran sampah lebih terarah dan minim asap guna mendukung pengelolaan sampah berkelanjutan di tingkat desa. Program dilaksanakan oleh mahasiswa KKN 02 Debanta STKIP PGRI Sampang di Dusun Taman Sareh, Desa Banjar Talela, Kecamatan Camplong pada tanggal 14–16 Juli 2026 dengan pendekatan partisipatif melibatkan masyarakat dalam seluruh tahapan kegiatan. Metode pelaksanaan mencakup observasi awal untuk identifikasi masalah, persiapan alat dan bahan, pembuatan Rocket Stove dengan desain ruang bakar dan sistem aliran udara terarah, uji coba alat pada tiga sesi berbeda, serta sosialisasi dan edukasi mengenai cara penggunaan dan pemeliharaan alat secara aman. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan Rocket Stove berhasil dibuat dan berfungsi baik, mencapai suhu rata-rata ruang bakar sebesar 615°C, mampu mereduksi volume sampah hingga 90–98%, serta menghasilkan asap secara visual lebih tipis dan cepat hilang dibandingkan pembakaran terbuka. Dari aspek sosial, program ini meningkatkan pemahaman masyarakat tentang pengelolaan sampah aman, dengan 85% peserta menyatakan komitmen menggunakan teknologi ini berkelanjutan. Implikasi penelitian ini mencakup kontribusi praktis berupa tersedianya alternatif teknologi tepat guna murah, mudah dibuat, dan efektif dalam mengurangi volume sampah, serta kontribusi teoretis berupa pengayaan literatur tentang penerapan teknologi pembakaran terkendali di wilayah pedesaan. Program ini diharapkan mendukung terciptanya lingkungan Desa Banjar Talela yang lebih bersih dan berkelanjutan serta menjadi model bagi desa-desa lain dalam pengelolaan sampah berbasis teknologi tepat guna.
doi:10.58344/jig.v4i8.587.title: Rocket Stove: Inovasi Teknologi Tepat Guna Minim Asap Untuk Mendukung Desa Bebas Sampah di Desa Banjar Talela

doi:10.58344/locus.v5i8.6172.abstract: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya kemampuan literasi membaca peserta didik sekolah dasar yang disebabkan oleh dominasi pendekatan konvensional teacher-centered sehingga peserta didik cenderung pasif dan kesulitan memahami bacaan secara mendalam. Penelitian bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh penerapan pendekatan Deep Learning dan motivasi belajar terhadap hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia peserta didik kelas IV SD. Penelitian menggunakan metode eksperimen desain faktorial 2x2 dengan 60 siswa (30 eksperimen Deep Learning, 30 kontrol konvensional). Instrumen penelitian telah valid dan reliabel (Cronbach's Alpha 0,812 dan 0,876). Data berdistribusi normal dan homogen. Hasil uji hipotesis menggunakan ANAVA Dua Jalur menunjukkan bahwa terdapat pengaruh signifikan penerapan pendekatan Deep Learning terhadap hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia (p = 0,007 < 0,05) dan terdapat pengaruh signifikan motivasi belajar terhadap hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia (p = 0,007 < 0,05), namun tidak ditemukan efek interaksi yang signifikan antara pendekatan pembelajaran dan motivasi belajar terhadap hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia (p = 0,187 > 0,05). Penelitian menyimpulkan bahwa pendekatan Deep Learning secara mandiri efektif meningkatkan hasil belajar kognitif Bahasa Indonesia peserta didik sekolah dasar tanpa terikat pada tinggi rendahnya motivasi belajar awal mereka, serta memberikan kontribusi empiris bagi pengembangan model pembelajaran berbasis Kurikulum Merdeka di sekolah dasar.
doi:10.58344/locus.v5i8.6172.title: Pengaruh Penerapan Pendekatan Deep Learning dan Motivasi Belajar Terhadap Hasil Belajar Bahasa Indonesia Peserta Didik Kelas IV SDN Utan Kayu Utara 07 Kecamatan Matraman Jakarta Timur

doi:10.58477/cj.v4i2.497.abstract: This study analyzes sentiment in InDrive user reviews from the Google Play Store using IndoBERT, Genetic Algorithm (GA), and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN). A total of 2,000 reviews were assigned to three sentiment classes: 1,695 negative, 235 positive, and 70 neutral reviews. The pretrained indobenchmark/indobert-base-p1 model was used as a feature extractor by taking the [CLS] representation to produce 768-dimensional embeddings. The dataset was divided using a stratified 80:20 split into 1,600 training and 400 testing samples. The optimal K value was determined through stratified five-fold cross-validation on the training data. GA was applied only to the training set using a population of 30 individuals, 25 generations, a crossover rate of 0.8, a mutation rate of 0.005, and a feature penalty of 0.002. GA selected 250 features, reducing the dimensionality by 67.45%. IndoBERT + KNN correctly classified 365 of 400 test samples, achieving 91.25% accuracy (95% CI: 88.07–93.64%) and a macro F1-score of 66.88%. IndoBERT + GA + KNN correctly classified 362 samples, achieving 90.50% accuracy (95% CI: 87.23–93.00%) and a macro F1-score of 62.71%. Both models exceeded the 84.75% majority-class baseline. However, only three and two of the 14 neutral samples were correctly classified, respectively. GA substantially reduced feature dimensionality but did not improve predictive performance, indicating a trade-off between representation compactness and minority-class classification performance.

glossary.explanation_id: IndoBERT adalah *model bahasa* berbasis arsitektur *BERT* yang telah dilatih secara khusus untuk merepresentasikan teks dalam *bahasa Indonesia* secara kontekstual.
Genetic Algorithm adalah metode optimasi pencarian metaheuristik yang terinspirasi dari mekanisme *genetika* dan seleksi alam untuk menemukan kombinasi fitur terbaik.
K-Nearest Neighbor adalah algoritma *supervised learning* yang mengklasifikasikan data berdasarkan kedekatan jarak antarvektor pada ruang fitur *training data*.
Stratified 5-Fold Cross-Validation adalah teknik *evaluasi* model yang membagi *data latih* menjadi lima bagian dengan proporsi kelas yang tetap terjaga di setiap bagiannya.
Macro F1-score adalah metrik *evaluasi* yang menghitung rata-rata nilai *F1-score* dari seluruh kelas secara merata tanpa memandang jumlah sampel pada setiap kelas.
Embedding adalah representasi numerik berupa vektor padat yang dihasilkan oleh model *transformer* untuk menangkap makna semantik dari suatu teks.

background.en: The rapid growth of application-based transportation services has established new interaction patterns between users and providers, where app reviews on platforms like the Google Play Store serve as valuable repositories for user feedback, appreciation, and complaints. Processing this vast volume of textual feedback manually is impractical, necessitating automated sentiment analysis to categorize opinions into positive, neutral, and negative classes. However, user reviews present distinct linguistic challenges, including informal phrasing, abbreviations, and varied sentence structures that defy simple keyword matching. Furthermore, sentiment datasets are often severely imbalanced, as negative reviews frequently dominate, creating evaluation difficulties where high overall accuracy can mask poor performance on minority classes.
background.id: Pertumbuhan pesat layanan transportasi berbasis aplikasi telah membentuk pola interaksi baru antara pengguna dan penyedia layanan, di mana ulasan aplikasi pada platform seperti Google Play Store berfungsi sebagai gudang berharga untuk umpan balik, apresiasi, dan keluhan pengguna. Memproses ulasan teks dalam jumlah besar ini secara manual tidak praktis, sehingga memerlukan analisis sentimen otomatis untuk mengategorikan opini ke dalam kelas positif, netral, dan negatif. Namun, ulasan pengguna menghadirkan tantangan linguistik tersendiri, termasuk frasa informal, singkatan, dan struktur kalimat bervariasi yang menyulitkan pencocokan kata kunci sederhana. Selain itu, dataset sentimen sering kali sangat tidak seimbang karena ulasan negatif kerap mendominasi, memunculkan kesulitan evaluasi di mana akurasi keseluruhan yang tinggi dapat menutupi performa buruk pada kelas minoritas.

contributions.en: This paper presents an empirical evaluation of incorporating a Genetic Algorithm as a wrapper feature selection method on high-dimensional text representations extracted via a pretrained IndoBERT model, coupled with K-Nearest Neighbor classification for multiclass sentiment analysis of InDrive user reviews. The study explicitly investigates the impact of reducing IndoBERT features from 768 down to 250 dimensions on classification accuracy, macro F1-scores, and minority class recognition. Additionally, the work provides a rigorous evaluation framework utilizing stratified cross-validation, 95 percent confidence intervals, and McNemar statistical testing to compare full-feature and reduced-feature scenarios.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyajikan evaluasi empiris mengenai penggabungan *Genetic Algorithm* sebagai metode seleksi fitur *wrapper* pada representasi teks berdimensi tinggi yang diekstrak melalui model IndoBERT *pretrained*, yang dikombinasikan dengan klasifikasi *K-Nearest Neighbor* untuk analisis sentimen multikelas pada ulasan pengguna inDrive. Penelitian ini secara eksplisit menyelidiki dampak reduksi fitur IndoBERT dari 768 menjadi 250 dimensi terhadap akurasi klasifikasi, *macro F1-score*, dan pengenalan kelas minoritas. Selain itu, karya ini menyediakan kerangka evaluasi yang teliti menggunakan *stratified cross-validation*, interval kepercayaan 95 persen, dan pengujian statistik McNemar untuk membandingkan skenario fitur penuh dan fitur tereduksi.

future_work.en: The paper does not discuss future work in detail.
future_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas pekerjaan masa depan secara mendetail.

method.en: The study utilizes a dataset of 2,000 InDrive user reviews scraped from the Google Play Store, mapped into negative, neutral, and positive sentiment classes based on star ratings. Following minimal text preprocessing consisting of case folding, URL removal, handle removal, non-ASCII stripping, punctuation replacement, and whitespace normalization, texts are passed through the pretrained indobenchmark/indobert-base-p1 model without fine-tuning to extract 768-dimensional embeddings from the [CLS] token. The dataset is split using an 80:20 stratified ratio into 1,600 training and 400 testing samples. A Genetic Algorithm is applied strictly to the training set using 30 individuals, 25 generations, a crossover rate of 0.8, a mutation rate of 0.005, and a feature penalty coefficient of 0.002, optimizing a fitness function based on macro F1-scores evaluated via stratified five-fold cross-validation. Finally, K-Nearest Neighbor classification with K equals 1 is evaluated on both the full 768-dimensional feature set and the 250-dimensional feature subset selected by the Genetic Algorithm.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan dataset yang terdiri atas 2.000 ulasan pengguna inDrive yang dikeruk dari Google Play Store, dipetakan ke dalam kelas sentimen negatif, netral, dan positif berdasarkan peringkat bintang. Setelah pra-pemrosesan teks minimal yang terdiri atas *case folding*, penghapusan URL, penghapusan *handle*, pembersihan karakter non-ASCII, penggantian tanda baca, dan normalisasi spasi, teks dilewatkan melalui model *pretrained* indobenchmark/indobert-base-p1 tanpa *fine-tuning* untuk mengekstrak *embedding* berdimensi 768 dari token [CLS]. Dataset dibagi menggunakan rasio berstrata 80:20 menjadi 1.600 data latih dan 400 data uji. *Genetic Algorithm* diterapkan secara ketat pada data latih menggunakan 30 individu, 25 generasi, tingkat *crossover* 0,8, tingkat *mutation* 0,005, dan koefisien penalti fitur 0,002, guna mengoptimalkan fungsi *fitness* berdasarkan *macro F1-score* yang dievaluasi melalui *stratified five-fold cross-validation*. Terakhir, klasifikasi *K-Nearest Neighbor* dengan K bernilai 1 dievaluasi pada set fitur penuh berdimensi 768 dan subset fitur berdimensi 250 yang dipilih oleh *Genetic Algorithm*.

related_work.en: Prior research has extensively applied transformer models such as IndoBERT, BERT, and RoBERTa to analyze sentiment across various Indonesian digital services, including e-commerce, mobile healthcare, banking, and transportation platforms. While these studies demonstrate the efficacy of transformer-based feature extraction for Indonesian texts, high-dimensional representations such as the 768-dimensional IndoBERT outputs contain redundant information, motivating feature selection techniques. Prior investigations into feature reduction methods like Genetic Algorithms have produced mixed outcomes, frequently achieving dimensionality reduction without corresponding gains in classification accuracy, highlighting a recurring trade-off between representation compactness and predictive capability.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya telah secara ekstensif menerapkan model *transformer* seperti IndoBERT, BERT, dan RoBERTa untuk menganalisis sentimen di berbagai layanan digital Indonesia, termasuk lokapasar, kesehatan seluler, perbankan, dan platform transportasi. Meskipun studi-studi ini mendemonstrasikan keampuhan ekstraksi fitur berbasis *transformer* untuk teks berbahasa Indonesia, representasi berdimensi tinggi seperti keluaran IndoBERT berdimensi 768 mengandung informasi redundan, yang memotivasi penggunaan teknik seleksi fitur. Penyelidikan terdahulu terhadap metode reduksi fitur seperti *Genetic Algorithm* telah menghasilkan luaran yang beragam, kerap kali mencapai reduksi dimensi tanpa peningkatan akurasi klasifikasi yang bersesuaian, sehingga menyoroti kompromi berulang antara keringkasan representasi dan kapabilitas prediktif.

results.en: The IndoBERT plus K-Nearest Neighbor model using all 768 features achieved an accuracy of 91.25 percent with a 95 percent confidence interval of 88.07 to 93.64 percent and a macro F1-score of 66.88 percent. In contrast, the IndoBERT plus Genetic Algorithm plus K-Nearest Neighbor model utilizing 250 selected features achieved an accuracy of 90.50 percent with a confidence interval of 87.23 to 93.00 percent and a macro F1-score of 62.71 percent. Both configurations substantially outperformed the majority-class baseline of 84.75 percent. However, feature selection caused a drop in macro F1-score and exhibited severe limitations in identifying minority classes, correctly classifying only two out of fourteen neutral samples compared to three for the full feature model, indicating that the Genetic Algorithm successfully reduced dimensionality by 67.45 percent but sacrificed performance on underrepresented sentiment categories.
results.id: Model IndoBERT ditambah *K-Nearest Neighbor* yang menggunakan seluruh 768 fitur mencapai akurasi sebesar 91,25 persen dengan interval kepercayaan 95 persen sebesar 88,07 hingga 93,64 persen serta *macro F1-score* sebesar 66,88 persen. Sebaliknya, model IndoBERT ditambah *Genetic Algorithm* ditambah *K-Nearest Neighbor* yang memanfaatkan 250 fitur terpilih mencapai akurasi sebesar 90,50 persen dengan interval kepercayaan 87,23 hingga 93,00 persen serta *macro F1-score* sebesar 62,71 persen. Kedua konfigurasi secara substansial mengungguli *baseline* kelas mayoritas sebesar 84,75 persen. Namun, seleksi fitur menyebabkan penurunan *macro F1-score* dan menunjukkan keterbatasan parah dalam mengidentifikasi kelas minoritas, di mana model hanya mengklasifikasikan secara benar dua dari empat belas sampel netral dibandingkan tiga sampel pada model fitur penuh, yang mengindikasikan bahwa *Genetic Algorithm* berhasil mereduksi dimensi sebesar 67,45 persen tetapi mengorbankan performa pada kategori sentimen yang kurang terwakili.

tldr.en: This study analyzes sentiment in InDrive user reviews from the Google Play Store using IndoBERT, a Genetic Algorithm, and K-Nearest Neighbor classification. The results show that while the Genetic Algorithm successfully reduces feature dimensionality by over sixty-seven percent, it does not improve predictive performance compared to using full IndoBERT embeddings.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini menganalisis sentimen ulasan pengguna inDrive dari Google Play Store menggunakan IndoBERT, *Genetic Algorithm*, dan klasifikasi *K-Nearest Neighbor*. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa meskipun *Genetic Algorithm* berhasil mereduksi dimensi fitur lebih dari enam puluh tujuh persen, metode tersebut tidak meningkatkan performa prediktif dibandingkan penggunaan *embedding* IndoBERT penuh.

doi:10.58477/cj.v4i2.497.title: Analisis Sentimen Ulasan Pengguna inDrive Menggunakan IndoBERT dan Algoritma Genetika pada Klasifikasi K-Nearest Neighbor

doi:10.58578/ahkam.v5i4.11589.abstract: Although film music has been used to bind narratives in culturally themed animated films, the application of the leitmotif technique in hybrid animation featuring Tingkuluak remains limited. This study aimed to describe and analyze the implementation of the leitmotif technique in the film score of the animated film Tingkuluak: Pusaka Perempuan Minang dalam Sehelai Kain. The study employed a qualitative descriptive approach with a practice-based research design encompassing the preproduction, production, and postproduction stages. Data were collected through questionnaires administered to young people, an interview with a cultural informant, a literature review, documentation of the creative process, alpha testing, and beta testing with an animation expert. The data were analyzed descriptively by categorizing musical requirements, interpreting audiovisual compatibility, and conducting technical evaluations. The results showed that leitmotifs developed through variations in melody, harmony, tempo, dynamics, instrumentation, and sound layering were able to establish a musical identity, reinforce the atmosphere, and maintain narrative continuity. The use of MIDI, virtual instruments, talempong, and Malay flute further accentuated the nuances of Minangkabau culture. The testing results also indicated the need to improve the consistency of dialogue volume, the alignment of the music with the emotions of the scenes, and audiovisual synchronization. This study enriches the practice of creating film music based on local culture and offers a film-scoring production workflow that can be applied to the development of educational animation media.
doi:10.58578/ahkam.v5i4.11589.title: Implementasi Musik Ilustrasi Film Animasi Hybrid "Tingkuluak: Pusaka Perempuan Minang dalam Sehelai Kain" Menggunakan Teknik Leitmotif

doi:10.58578/anwarul.v6i4.11710.abstract: The integration of website-based media into English language learning offers opportunities to improve instructional accessibility, interactivity, and student engagement; however, context-specific digital resources for teaching analytical exposition texts in vocational secondary schools remain limited. This study aims to develop DiLe (DisasterLearn), a website-based learning medium for Grade XI English instruction at SMK Nusantara Bogem Diwek Jombang, and to examine students’ responses to its use. The study employed a Research and Development approach using the ADDIE model, comprising analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. The product was validated by a media expert and a subject-matter expert before being tested with students as end users. Expert validation was conducted to assess the validity and instructional suitability of the developed medium, while students’ responses were collected through a questionnaire. The findings show that the media expert evaluation yielded an average score of 92%, categorized as highly valid, while the subject-matter expert evaluation likewise placed the product in the highly valid category. Student-response data also indicated a highly positive evaluation, as reflected in the predominance of “agree” and “strongly agree” responses across the assessed dimensions. These findings demonstrate that DiLe is highly valid and suitable for supporting the teaching of analytical exposition texts. The study contributes a contextually relevant website-based instructional resource and indicates that its implementation has the potential to strengthen students’ interest and motivation in English language learning.
doi:10.58578/anwarul.v6i4.11710.title: Development of Website-Based Dile (DisasterLearn) Media for Eleventh-Grade English Subject at SMK Nusantara

doi:10.58578/yasin.v6i5.11585.abstract: Although the use of games as a medium for introducing culture continues to develop, studies that specifically discuss the process of translating Minangkabau cultural identity into pixel art visual assets remain limited. This study aimed to design the visual assets for the game “Jejak Pagaruyuang” as an interactive medium for introducing Minangkabau culture. The study employed a research and development approach using the Multimedia Development Life Cycle model, which includes the stages of concept, design, material collection, production, and testing. Data were obtained through direct observation at Istana Basa Pagaruyung, visual documentation, literature review, and functional testing, and were then analyzed descriptively and qualitatively based on visual appropriateness, asset consistency, and functional success. The results of the study produced main character, NPC, environment, cultural object, user interface, and supporting animation assets developed using Aseprite. Alpha testing of five components showed that all assets functioned in accordance with the design. These findings indicate that form simplification, color palette consistency, silhouette readability, and the appropriateness of cultural attributes are important elements in the design of culture-themed pixel art. This study contributes to the development of visual communication and digital cultural games and broadens understanding of visual asset design based on local cultural identity.
doi:10.58578/yasin.v6i5.11585.title: Perancangan Visual Asset Game Pixel Art Jejak Pagaruyuang sebagai Media Interaktif Pengenalan Budaya Minangkabau

doi:10.58602/itsecs.v4i3.353.abstract: The rapid expansion of the Indonesian animation industry has sparked vibrant public discourse on social media, yet existing research primarily focuses on binary or overall sentiment rather than fine-grained aspect-level evaluations. This study presents an aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) comparing a traditional machine learning baseline (Random Forest with TF-IDF and SMOTE) against a deep learning model (fine-tuned IndoBERT) on 2,759 tweets discussing domestic animated films Jumbo and Merah Putih: One For All (MPOA). An 11-class joint aspect-sentiment classification scheme was established using a semi-automated annotation pipeline, achieving almost perfect inter-annotator agreement (Cohen’s Kappa κ = 0.8616). Experimental results demonstrate that fine-tuned IndoBERT significantly outperformed the Random Forest baseline, increasing accuracy from 40.16% to 51.64% (+11.48 percentage points) and weighted F1-score from 36.60% to 45.69% (+24.8% relative gain). Corpus-wide aspect distribution revealed that general film evaluation dominates social media discussion (95.9%), followed by animation quality (1.9%) and storyline (1.6%). Furthermore, sentiment analysis uncovered contrasting reception patterns: Jumbo attained overwhelmingly positive net sentiment (+63.8%), whereas MPOA faced severe negative backlash (−46.2%) driven by technical animation critiques and public controversies. Despite overall performance constraints caused by severe class imbalance and limited training data, these findings confirm the superiority of pre-trained Transformer architectures for complex multi-class ABSA tasks in low-resource Indonesian social media text.
doi:10.58602/itsecs.v4i3.353.journal_ref: Journal of Information Technology Software Engineering and Computer Science (ITSECS)
doi:10.58602/itsecs.v4i3.353.title: Evaluating Audience Perception in Indonesian Animation: Comparative Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis Using Random Forest and IndoBERT

doi:10.58812/jbmws.v5i03.3850.abstract: The internship program is one of the study completions tracks at Nusa Putra University, designed to equip students with real work experience in their respective fields. This report is based on the pre-internship activities at PT. Inovasi Utama Nusantara – MuseAkademi, a company engaged in education and digital training. During the internship, the author was involved in various activities, including creating and editing digital content (social media posts and promotional materials), supporting event promotions and online campaigns, helping to maintain smooth internal and external communication, and contributing ideas to improve branding and audience engagement. The methods used in data collection included observation, interviews, and documentation. The results of these activities are expected to enhance students’ competencies in digital communication, social media management, and teamwork skills, while also providing meaningful contributions to the company in developing its digital-based programs and activities.

doi:10.58915/johdec.v15.2026.3447.abstract: Character design in digital games is more than creating visually appealing figures; it is an evolving discipline that blends storytelling, cultural heritage, and artistic expression. Asglobal audiences increasingly seek diverse and culturally grounded narratives, Southeast Asian folklore offers a rich and underrepresented source of inspiration for digital games. This study investigates how Southeast Asian mythological characters are adapted and reimagined in game design, focusing on the representation of cultural identity through character design. The research centres on Kabaret, a narrative-driven game developed by Persona Theory Games, which features a cast of characters inspired by Southeast Asian myths and legends. Adopting a qualitative methodology, this study combines literaturereview with visual and thematic analysis. It examines character names, design aesthetics, personality traits, costume elements, cultural references, and symbolic forms to explore how cultural identity is visually encoded. Findings reveal that Kabaret achieves a balance between creative reinterpretation and cultural authenticity, presenting Southeast Asian culture in a manner that is both respectful and globally accessible. Each character contributes to a cohesive narrative that bridges traditional heritage with contemporary game aesthetics. This research underscores the role of digital games as powerful platforms for cultural storytelling and heritage preservation. It contributes to academic discourse in game studies on cultural representation and provides practical insights for developers and artists seeking to produce culturally respectful content. By bringing Southeast Asian folklore into the digital sphere, Kabaret demonstrates how games can foster intercultural appreciation and strengthen the visibility of regional identities in the creative industries. Reka bentuk watak dalam permainan digital bukan sekadar penciptaan figura yang menarik secara visual, ia merupakan satu disiplin yang berkembang dengan menggabungkan penceritaan, warisan budaya, dan ekspresi artistik. Dalam era ketika khalayak global semakin menginginkan naratif yang pelbagai dan berasaskan budaya, cerita rakyat Asia Tenggara menawarkan sumber inspirasi yang kaya namun kurang diwakili dalam permainan digital. Kajian ini menyelidik bagaimana watak mitologi Asia Tenggara disesuaikan dan diolah semula dalam reka bentuk permainan, dengan memberi tumpuan kepada representasi identiti budaya melalui reka bentuk watak. Penyelidikan ini memfokuskan kepada Kabaret, sebuah permainan naratif yang dibangunkan oleh Persona Theory Games, yang menampilkan barisan watak yang diinspirasikan daripada mitos dan legenda Asia Tenggara. Dengan menggunakan metodologi kualitatif, kajian ini menggabungkan ulasan literatur dengan analisis visual dan analisis tematik. Ia meneliti nama watak, estetika reka bentuk, ciri-ciri personaliti, elemen kostum, rujukan budaya, dan bentuk simbolik bagi meneroka bagaimana identiti budaya dikodkan secara visual. Dapatan kajian menunjukkan bahawa Kabaret berjaya mencapai keseimbangan antara interpretasi kreatif dan keaslian budaya, serta mempersembahkan budaya Asia Tenggara secara hormat dan boleh diakses oleh khalayak global. Setiap watak menyumbang kepada naratif yang padu, yang menghubungkan warisan tradisional dengan estetik permainan kontemporari. Kajian ini menegaskan peranan permainan digital sebagai platform yang berkuasa dalam penceritaan budaya dan pemeliharaan warisan. Ia menyumbang kepada wacana akademik dalam kajian permainan mengenai representasi budaya dan memberikan panduan praktikal kepada pembangun dan artis yang ingin menghasilkan kandungan yang menghormati nilai budaya. Dengan membawa cerita rakyat AsiaTenggara ke dalam ruang digital, Kabaret membuktikan bahawa permainan mampu memupuk penghargaan antara budaya serta memperkukuh keterlihatan identiti serantau dalam industri kreatif.

doi:10.58915/johdec.v15.2026.3447.title: Reimagining Southeast Asian Mythology in Digital Games: A Case Study of Kabaret by Persona Theory Games

doi:10.58918/lofian.v6i1.301.abstract: Pengelolaan data kepegawaian yang masih berbasis konvensional di lingkungan pendidikan sering kali memicu berbagai permasalahan administrasi, seperti risiko kesalahan pencatatan, duplikasi data, kehilangan dokumen, hingga keterlambatan penyusunan laporan. Permasalahan serupa terjadi di SMK Nusantara 1 Kotabumi, di mana pengelolaan informasi staf, absensi, cuti, penggajian, dan pelaporan masih dilakukan secara manual sehingga dinilai kurang efektif dan efisien. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk merancang, mengembangkan, menerapkan, serta menguji Sistem Informasi Kepegawaian Berbasis Web yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan spesifik sekolah. Metode pengembangan sistem yang digunakan mencakup analisis kebutuhan, perancangan antarmuka dan basis data, hingga tahap implementasi dan pengujian fungsionalitas menggunakan metode Black Box Testing. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa sistem informasi kepegawaian berbasis web yang dibangun berhasil mengintegrasikan seluruh proses administrasi kepegawaian ke dalam satu platform terpusat secara akurat. Implementasi sistem ini terbukti mampu mempercepat alur kerja administrasi, meminimalkan potensi kesalahan input data, serta mempermudah penyediaan laporan kepegawaian secara real-time. Kesimpulannya, sistem ini layak diterapkan untuk mendukung proses transformasi digital sekolah serta meningkatkan kualitas pengelolaan administrasi kepegawaian di SMK Nusantara 1 Kotabumi secara efektif dan efisien.

doi:10.59024/jipa.v4i3.2350.abstract: Globalization and the dominance of national and foreign languages have contributed to the declining use of regional languages in literacy practices among younger generations, including children's literature learning in higher education. This study aims to reconstruct regional language children's story writing practices by strengthening the role of lecturers as cultural literacy role models. The research employed a quantitative descriptive approach supported by qualitative data through observations, interviews, document analysis, and questionnaires involving 33 students in children's literature courses at universities. Data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and thematic interpretation to identify lecturers' exemplary roles in the learning process. The results indicate that all indicators of lecturers' roles were categorized as very high, with average scores ranging from 4.39 to 4.64 on a five-point scale. Lecturers actively demonstrated creative writing processes, provided examples of regional language use in literary works, guided writing activities, gave feedback, encouraged publication, motivated students, developed collaborative learning environments, and integrated character values into literary creations. These findings demonstrate that lecturers’ roles as cultural literacy models significantly contribute to strengthening cultural identity, revitalizing regional languages, and developing writing cultures in higher education. The study proposes a learning model that positions lecturers and students as collaborative creative communities in preserving local cultural values through regional language children's stories.

doi:10.59095/ijcsr.v5i2.283.abstract: The development of Natural Language Processing (NLP) has encouraged the use of Named Entity Recognition (NER) technology to extract important information from text data automatically. This research aims to apply the IndoBERT model to recognize named entities in classic Indonesian literary texts, namely Hikayat Wayang Arjuna & Purusara. The research focused on the identification of three categories of entities, namely Person (PER), Location (LOC), and Organization (ORG). The dataset is compiled through an annotation process using the BIO (Beginning, Inside, Outside) scheme, then processed through the preprocessing stage, tokenization using the IndoBERT Tokenizer, and fine-tuning the IndoBERT model. Evaluation was conducted using precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. The results showed that the IndoBERT model obtained a precision score of 56.30%, recall of 60.55%, and an F1-score of 58.35%. Based on the evaluation of each entity category, the Location (LOC) category obtained the best performance with an F1-score of 76.07%, followed by Person (PER) of 64.67%, while Organization (ORG) obtained a score of 44.96%. These results show that IndoBERT is quite effective in recognizing entities in classic literary texts in Indonesian and has the potential to support the process of information extraction, digitization, and preservation of folklore based on NLP technology.

doi:10.59095/ijcsr.v5i2.283.title: Implementation of the IndoBERT Model on Named Entity Recognition for Entity Identification in the Folklore of the Tale of Wayang Arjuna & Purusara

doi:10.59395/ijadis.v7i2.1572.abstract: Insecurity detection on social media is crucial for early mental health intervention, yet imbalanced data distribution poses significant challenges for text classification. This study compares the performance of hybrid IndoBERT-Self-Paced Ensemble (SPE) and IndoBERT- RUSBoost for imbalanced text classification in insecurity detection on social media X. A dataset of 5,179 Indonesian tweets was collected using keywords "insecure" and "overthinking", preprocessed through text cleaning and slang normalization, and labeled automatically using a fine-tuned IndoBERT model as insecurity (positive) or non-insecurity (negative). Results demonstrated that RUSBoost significantly outperformed SPE across 8 of 13 evaluation metrics, achieving balanced accuracy of 0.8521, F1-score of 0.6763, and AUC-ROC of 0.9459 compared to SPE's 0.8465, 0.5171, and 0.9242 respectively. RUSBoost showed superior specificity (0.9460 vs 0.8381) and precision (0.6104 vs 0.3706), while SPE excelled in recall (0.8548 vs 0.7581). Gradient Boosting achieved the highest AUC-PR (0.7100) and specificity (0.9622). The findings confirm that hybrid IndoBERT- RUSBoost provides more balanced and robust performance for imbalanced text classification, offering practical implications for early insecurity detection systems on social media platforms.

doi:10.59395/ijadis.v7i2.1572.title: Performance Comparison of Hybrid Indobert-Self-Paced Ensemble and Indobert- Rusboost for Imbalanced Text Classification (Case Study: Insecurity Detection on Social Media X)

doi:10.59395/kj702z78.abstract: Perkembangan teknologi informasi telah meningkatkan penyebaran berita hoaks yang berpotensi menimbulkan disinformasi di masyarakat. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis performa model IndoBERT yang telah melalui proses fine-tuning dalam mendeteksi berita hoaks berbahasa Indonesia pada konteks lokal Kabupaten Karawang. Dataset penelitian terdiri atas 3.215 berita, yang meliputi 2.578 berita nasional sebagai data pelatihan dan validasi serta 637 berita Kabupaten Karawang sebagai data pengujian. Karena distribusi kelas pada dataset tidak seimbang (imbalanced dataset), penelitian ini menerapkan Weighted Cross Entropy Loss untuk mengurangi bias terhadap kelas mayoritas selama proses pelatihan. Tahapan penelitian meliputi pengumpulan dan pelabelan data, text preprocessing, tokenization and encoding, fine-tuning model IndoBERT, serta evaluasi menggunakan metrik accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, dan confusion matrix. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa model IndoBERT yang telah di-fine-tuning memperoleh accuracy sebesar 95,53%, precision 80,00%, recall 98,11%, dan F1-score 88,14%. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan bahwa pendekatan transfer learning melalui fine-tuning IndoBERT mampu mendeteksi berita hoaks secara efektif serta memiliki kemampuan generalisasi yang baik pada dataset berita lokal Kabupaten Karawang.

doi:10.59395/kj702z78.title: Deteksi Berita Hoaks Berbasis Fine-Tuning IndoBERT pada Dataset Kabupaten Karawang

doi:10.59543/comdem.v3i.18346.abstract: The article explores how globalization and digitalization affect the preservation of national or minority languages in the modern world. The aim of the study was to identify and interpret the relationships between global linguistic diversity, the level of digitalization of countries and their socio-economic development, as well as to assess the potential risks and opportunities provided by the digital environment for linguistic heritage. The theoretical basis of the study includes modern sociolinguistic approaches, digital studies and language policy. The empirical base of the study is taken from international data from open sources (Our World In Data, World Bank, W3Techs, Ethnologue and UNESCO). The following statistical methods were used to process statistical data: descriptive statistics, Spearman and Kendall rank correlations, Kraskel-Wallis test for nonparametric statistical testing, and comparative analysis of temporal trends. In the course of the study, the authors found that linguistic diversity is unevenly distributed throughout the world, a comparative analysis was carried out by continents and countries of the world. A statistically significant negative correlation was found between the amount of living languages and the extent of internet use in the countries of the world, which suggest an asymmetry between language representation and internet inclusion. Statistically significant differences between groups of countries in terms of income level were also found: the average number of living languages in high-income countries is less than in lower-income countries. An analysis of the linguistic composition of web materials in the world from 2015 to 2026 showed that the English language retains its dominance, but the shares of Spanish and Portuguese are growing. The scientific novelty of the study lies in the complex combination of sociolinguistic and statistical analysis of global language processes in the context of the digital economy. The practical significance of the study lies in the formation of recommendations for national and international language policy, in particular the development of digital data corpora, the localization of technological platforms, the support of low-resource languages in artificial intelligence systems, and the expansion of language communities' access to digital infrastructure.
doi:10.59543/comdem.v3i.18346.title: Globalization and Preservation of National Languages: Challenges of the Digital Age

doi:10.59543/jidmis.v3.1383.abstract: As digital ecosystems expand globally, intelligent web localization is increasingly critical for ensuring information accessibility and digital inclusion among low-resource language communities. While dominant languages often dictate internet infrastructure, native dialects remain vital for localized information processing and cultural identity. This study investigates the strategic need for and potential impact of developing an online Akeanon translation system designed to bridge the digital divide for both Aklanon and non-Aklanon speakers in the Philippines. Employing a user-centric descriptive-survey design, empirical data were gathered from 100 respondents—encompassing students and non-native speakers—to evaluate user requirements for localized digital tools. Analysis revealed a significant system gap, with 71% of participants recognizing the critical necessity of an additional, dedicated application to supplement existing Akeanon translation frameworks. Both quantitative and qualitative findings demonstrated that intelligent web localization enhances user engagement in digital content creation, while providing essential infrastructural support for the education and tourism sectors. Furthermore, qualitative responses highlighted the technology's crucial role in facilitating daily communicative decision-making. The findings establish that deploying localized translation technology is a vital mechanism for sustaining linguistic heritage while fostering inclusive digital spaces. Consequently, the study recommends the architectural development of robust mobile and web-based Akeanon translators, alongside their strategic integration into educational curricula and regional digital frameworks, ensuring equitable information access and the continued relevance of the Akeanon language in the digital age.

doi:10.59543/jidmis.v3.1383.title: Intelligent Web Localization: Enhancing Information Accessibility and Digital Inclusion Through Akeanon Translation

doi:10.59562/jeeni.v4i1.14030.abstract: This study aims to develop an Indonesian sentiment analysis model that achieves high classification performance while providing post-hoc explanations of prediction results.The study utilized a quantitative experimental approach using the IndoNLU SmSA dataset, comprising 11,000 training and 1,260 validation samples across positive, neutral, and negative categories. The proposed model integrates an IndoBERT contextual representation generator with a Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network to model sequential relationships. Furthermore, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are applied to provide post-hoc interpretations of the model's predictions by identifying individual token contributions. The IndoBERT-BiLSTM model achieved an accuracy of 92.78%, a Macro F1-score of 0.9013, and a Macro Average AUC of 0.976, outperforming standard LSTM and fine-tuned IndoBERT baselines. However, learning curve analysis indicated mild overfitting during the training process. SHAP visualizations successfully explained the token-level contributions to the classification decisions, providing transparency into the model's reasoning. This study demonstrates the integration of the IndoBERT-BiLSTM architecture with SHAP to deliver accurate and explainable Indonesian sentiment analysis. The approach effectively bridges the gap between deep learning performance and decision transparency without compromising classification accuracy.

doi:10.59562/jeeni.v4i1.14030.title: Implementation of the IndoBERT-LSTM Model for Indonesian Sentiment Analysis withan Explainable AI Approach Using SHAP

doi:10.59784/glosains.v7i3.853.abstract: Background: Bantul Regency promotes cultural tourism through the "Bantul Bumi Mataram" branding, which positions Mataram heritage, including the Javanese script (Hanacaraka), as a core destination asset. However, most tourism actors in Bantul have limited literacy in Javanese script, restricting their ability to explain cultural symbols to visitors and reducing the effectiveness of this branding strategy. Objective: This study develops and evaluates an Android-based digital literacy model for Javanese script that improves tourism actors’ script literacy and strengthens cultural tourism promotion in Bantul Regency. Methods: This research and development (R&D) study combined a needs analysis with a prototyping approach, using interviews, observation, and questionnaires administered to a purposive sample of tourism actors [author to confirm exact sample size] in Bantul Regency. The application was built with Adobe Flash Professional CS6 and evaluated through limited user trials with pre-test/post-test measurement of script-reading accuracy [author to confirm test scores]. Results: Tourism actors initially recognized only basic Hanacaraka characters and could not read simple sentences. After using the application, participants showed improved script-reading accuracy in the post-test [author to insert percentage/effect size] and reported greater confidence in explaining Javanese cultural symbols to visitors. Conclusion: The Android-based digital literacy model strengthens tourism actors’ Javanese script competence and reinforces Bantul’s cultural identity within the Bantul Bumi Mataram branding strategy, offering a replicable approach for digitally preserving other endangered scripts.
doi:10.59784/glosains.v7i3.853.title: Digital Javanese Script Literacy for Cultural Tourism Communication

doi:10.59841/blaze.v4i3.3846.abstract: Muhadatsah learning is an essential component in developing students’ Arabic speaking competence; however, students often experience difficulties influenced by their local language backgrounds. This study aims to analyze the problems encountered by students in muhadatsah learning and to identify the characteristics of these problems based on students’ local dialects at MAS Al-Manar. This research employed a qualitative approach with a case study design. Data were collected through interviews with students from Javanese, Malay, and Angkola Batak dialect backgrounds, as well as an interview with an Arabic teacher. The data were analyzed through data reduction, data presentation, and conclusion drawing. The findings reveal four main difficulties in muhadatsah learning: pronunciation difficulties, vocabulary retrieval problems, limited speaking fluency, and language anxiety. Furthermore, students’ local dialect backgrounds influenced the characteristics of their Arabic speaking problems. Javanese students experienced stronger pronunciation interference, Malay students showed difficulties in producing certain Arabic sounds and lexical transfer, while Angkola Batak students demonstrated distinctive pronunciation patterns influenced by their dialect features. These findings indicate that local dialects significantly affect students’ Arabic speaking performance. Therefore, Arabic instruction should consider students’ linguistic backgrounds and provide continuous communicative practice to improve muhadatsah competence.

doi:10.59841/saber.v4i3.3909.abstract: Malay culture in the Riau Islands, is vulnerable to displacement due to the high heterogeneity of society, while digital media specifically collecting Malay cultural news is still very limited. This study aims to design a Digitization and Aggregation Application for Malay Cultural News in the Riau Islands as an integrated information platform for the community. The research is software engineering in nature so it does not use statistical hypotheses, but instead applies the Waterfall model that includes Requirements Analysis, System Design, Implementation, Testing, Deployment, and Maintenance, supported by modeling theories of Data Flow Diagrams and Entity Relationship Diagrams. The research input is in the form of secondary data from literature studies and web scraping from several news portals, including articles, categories, events, media, and user data. The system is implemented using Laravel 11, PHP 8, MySQL, and Bootstrap 5, then tested using Black Box Testing on ten main feature scenarios and all tests are declared successful. The results of the study show that the application is able to display and aggregate Malay cultural news automatically from various sources into one platform. Further development is recommended at the operational deployment stage, adding news portal sources, and conducting non-functional and usability testing. These results are important as a reference for an automated aggregation-based local cultural digitization model that supports the preservation of Malay identity amidst urban social dynamics.

doi:10.59944/jipsi.v5i3.1319.abstract: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh belum tersedianya bahan ajar Bahasa Indonesia kelas IV MI/SD yang menarik, sesuai dengan karakteristik peserta didik, dan mengintegrasikan nilai-nilai moderasi beragama secara sistematis. Penelitian ini bertujuan bahan ajar mengembangkan berbasis moderasi beragam yang layak dan menarik untuk mendukung pembelajaran pemahaman membaca. Kebaruan produk terletak pada pengintegrasian nilai toleransi, penghargaan terhadap keberagaman, kerja sama, komitmen pengabdian, dan sikap antikekerasan ke dalam teks bacaan, ilustrasi, kegiatan berdiskusi, menulis, berbicara, asesmen, serta refleksi. Berbeda dari bahan ajar yang sebelumnya digunakan, produk ini tidak hanya menyajikan materi kebahasaan, tetapi juga memadukan penguatan literasi dan pendidikan karakter sesuai dengan Kurikulum Merdeka. Penelitian menggunakan metode Research and Development dengan model ADDIE yang meliputi tahap Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, dan Evaluation. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas guru serta siswa kelas IV MIN 4 Bandar Lampung, dengan uji coba kelompok kecil yang melibatkan 15 siswa dan kelompok besar 25 siswa. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, angket validasi ahli, dan angket respon peserta didik. Hasil validasi menunjukkan kategori sangat layak, dengan persentase 96%–98,6% dari ahli media, 95% dari ahli materi, dan 95% dari ahli bahasa. Respon peserta didik memperoleh kategori sangat menarik, yaitu 88% pada kelompok kecil dan 90% pada kelompok besar. Dengan demikian, bahan terbuka dinyatakan layak dan menarik digunakan. Namun, efektivitasnya dalam meningkatkan pemahaman membaca belum dapat disimpulkan karena penelitian belum menyajikan data pretest dan posttest. Oleh karena itu, penelitian perlu menguji keefektifan produk melalui desain eksperimen dan analisis peningkatan skor pada sampel yang lebih luas agar pengaruhnya terhadap pemahaman membaca dapat dibuktikan secara empiris.

doi:10.6007/ijarped/v15-i3/28715.abstract: HRMARS - The reform of aesthetic education in compulsory education in the new era clearly proposes the core goal of "holistic aesthetic education and cross-cultural character building," requiring core subject classrooms such as Chinese and mathematics to break through the limitations of solely focusing on traditional Chinese cultural aesthetic education and cultivate students' ability to embrace aesthetic empathy across diverse civilizations. As a typical multi-ethnic country, Malaysia's primary and secondary schools implement a trilingual teaching system of Malay, Chinese, and English. The classroom naturally incorporates visual aesthetic resources from three major ethnic groups: Malay batik, Chinese calligraphy, and Indian mandala. This forms a comprehensive aesthetic education model with "cross-cultural aesthetic empathy" at its core, deeply embedded in regular Chinese and mathematics teaching. This paper, based on a semester of classroom observation in primary and secondary schools in Selangor, Malaysia, employs a three-pronged research approach: classroom recordings, teacher and student interviews, and teaching text analysis. It outlines a complete practical paradigm for cultivating cross-cultural aesthetic empathy in Malaysian multilingual classrooms, encompassing curriculum design, implementation, and evaluation. Comparing this paradigm with my country's 2022 compulsory education curriculum standards for Chinese and mathematics, it analyzes four major challenges in cultural and aesthetic education in Chinese and mathematics classrooms: a singular cultural carrier, superficial subject integration, a lack cross-cultural aesthetic cultivation, and rigid evaluation standards. Drawing on Malaysia's experience in multi-faceted and integrated aesthetic education in national education, this paper constructs a practical path for cross-cultural aesthetic empathy education adapted to my country's compulsory education stage, focusing on five dimensions: reconstructing teaching cognition, developing classroom materials, implementing differentiated instruction, innovating diversified evaluation, and systematic teacher training. This path aims to shift Chinese and mathematics classrooms from "single-cultural aesthetic transmission" to "cultivating multi-cultural empathy," ultimately fulfilling the goals of moral education and the shared future of humanity.

doi:10.61104/jq.v4i4.11339.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan penggunaan alih kode dan campur kode serta faktor-faktor yang menyebabkan terjadinya kedua fenomena tersebut dalam komunikasi masyarakat Batak Toba di Desa Kampung Karo, Kecamatan Patumbak. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan metode deskriptif. Data diperoleh melalui observasi, wawancara semi-terstruktur, dokumentasi, perekaman suara, dan catatan lapangan terhadap lima orang informan yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Analisis data dilakukan dengan model Miles, Huberman, dan Saldaña yang meliputi reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa ditemukan dua jenis alih kode, yaitu alih kode internal dan alih kode eksternal, dengan alih kode internal sebagai bentuk yang paling dominan. Selain itu, ditemukan tiga jenis campur kode, yaitu campur kode ke dalam, campur kode ke luar, dan campur kode campuran, dengan campur kode ke dalam sebagai bentuk yang paling sering digunakan. Faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi terjadinya alih kode dan campur kode meliputi lawan tutur, situasi komunikasi, kebiasaan berbahasa, dan upaya mempermudah komunikasi. Temuan penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan bahasa masyarakat Batak Toba dipengaruhi oleh situasi sosial dan kebutuhan komunikasi dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

doi:10.61104/jq.v4i4.11841.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis efektivitas media gambar sebagai sarana dalam menumbuhkan minat belajar siswa kelas I pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di SDN Telajung 04. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan studi kasus. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas 30 siswa kelas I dan seorang guru kelas. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara semi-terstruktur, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan model analisis interaktif yang meliputi kondensasi data, penyajian data, serta penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan media gambar mampu meningkatkan perhatian, antusiasme, rasa ingin tahu, dan partisipasi aktif siswa selama proses pembelajaran. Media gambar juga membantu siswa memahami materi secara lebih konkret sesuai dengan karakteristik perkembangan kognitif peserta didik kelas awal. Faktor pendukung efektivitas media gambar meliputi kreativitas guru, relevansi gambar dengan materi, dan keterlibatan siswa, sedangkan keterbatasan media dan waktu persiapan menjadi faktor penghambat. Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi dalam memperkuat pemanfaatan media visual sebagai strategi pembelajaran yang efektif untuk meningkatkan minat belajar siswa sekolah dasar, khususnya pada pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia.

doi:10.61104/jq.v4i4.11841.title: Analisis Media Gambar sebagai Sarana Efektif dalam Menumbuhkan Minat Belajar Siswa Kelas 1 pada Pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di SDN Telajung 04
doi:10.61104/jq.v4i4.11841.venue: Jurnal QOSIM Jurnal Pendidikan Sosial & Humaniora

doi:10.61104/jq.v4i4.9142.abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis reorientasi pendidikan sastra dalam Kurikulum Merdeka melalui kajian kebijakan terhadap dokumen Capaian Pembelajaran (CP) Bahasa Indonesia Fase E dan F. Penelitian bertujuan mengidentifikasi orientasi pendidikan sastra yang terkandung dalam dokumen kebijakan tersebut serta memetakan implikasinya bagi pembelajaran di jenjang SMA. Metode yang digunakan adalah kualitatif deskriptif dengan pendekatan analisis dokumen dan analisis kebijakan pendidikan. Sumber data primer meliputi CP Bahasa Indonesia Fase E dan F, Permendikbudristek Nomor 12 Tahun 2024, buku teks Bahasa Indonesia Kurikulum Merdeka kelas X–XII, Panduan Pembelajaran dan Asesmen, serta dokumen Profil Pelajar Pancasila. Sumber sekunder berupa artikel jurnal nasional dan internasional bereputasi. Analisis data menggunakan model Miles, Huberman, dan Saldana yang meliputi pengumpulan, kondensasi, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Validitas data dijamin melalui triangulasi sumber dan teori. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Kurikulum Merdeka menandai pergeseran paradigmatik dalam pendidikan sastra, dari pembelajaran berbasis penguasaan teori sastra menuju lima orientasi utama: (1) literasi kritis, (2) penguatan karakter berbasis nilai Profil Pelajar Pancasila, (3) penguatan identitas budaya, (4) pengembangan kreativitas, dan (5) kompetensi literasi multimodal. Temuan ini memiliki implikasi strategis bagi perumusan kebijakan pembelajaran sastra dan pengembangan kompetensi guru bahasa Indonesia di abad ke-21

doi:10.61104/jq.v4i5.12333.abstract: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh rendahnya kemampuan literasi membaca siswa kelas XI pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia, khususnya pada materi teks karya ilmiah, di SMAN 3 Padang Panjang. Observasi awal menunjukkan bahwa siswa masih kesulitan memahami isi teks secara langsung, cenderung menggabungkan ide pokok dengan kalimat utama, serta hanya merangkum atau menyalin potongan kalimat tanpa mampu merumuskan kesimpulan dengan bahasanya sendiri, meskipun pembelajaran sebelumnya telah menerapkan model Project Based Learning. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh penerapan model pembelajaran Discovery Learning terhadap kemampuan literasi membaca siswa dalam mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia. Jenis penelitian yang digunakan adalah penelitian kuantitatif dengan metode eksperimen. Populasi penelitian ini adalah seluruh siswa kelas XI di SMAN 3 Padang Panjang tahun ajaran 2025/2026, dengan sampel ditentukan melalui teknik purposive sampling, yaitu kelas XI.4 (30 siswa) sebagai kelas eksperimen yang diajar menggunakan model Discovery Learning dan kelas XI.7 (31 siswa) sebagai kelas kontrol yang diajar menggunakan model Project Based Learning. Data kemampuan literasi membaca dikumpulkan melalui tes objektif bentuk pilihan ganda yang telah diuji validitas, menghasilkan 30 dari 35 butir soal dinyatakan valid, dan diuji reliabilitas dengan koefisien 0,876 pada kategori sangat tinggi. Data dianalisis secara bertahap melalui uji normalitas dengan uji Shapiro-Wilk, uji homogenitas dengan uji Bartlett, dan uji hipotesis dengan uji-t (independent sample t-test). Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa data kedua kelompok berdistribusi normal dan homogen. Rata-rata kemampuan literasi membaca kelas eksperimen memperoleh 87,93, jauh lebih tinggi dibandingkan kelas kontrol yang memperoleh rata-rata 67,84. Hasil uji-t menunjukkan thitung sebesar 14,174 lebih besar dari ttabel sebesar 2,001 pada taraf signifikansi 0,05, sehingga H1 diterima. Dengan demikian, dapat disimpulkan bahwa penerapan model pembelajaran Discovery Learning berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kemampuan literasi membaca siswa dalam mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di SMAN 3 Padang Panjang dibandingkan dengan model Project Based Learning.

doi:10.61104/jq.v4i5.12504.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan bentuk tindak tutur direktif yang terdapat dalam film 1 Kakak 7 Ponakan karya Yandy Laurens serta implikasinya terhadap pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di SMA, khususnya materi teks drama kelas XI Fase F. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan deskriptif kualitatif. Data penelitian berupa dialog dan monolog yang mengandung tindak tutur direktif dalam film 1 Kakak 7 Ponakan. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik simak, catat, dan dokumentasi. Analisis data mengacu pada teori tindak tutur direktif Prayitno (2017) yang meliputi perintah, permintaan, larangan, nasihat, ajakan, dan kritik. Keabsahan data dilakukan melalui triangulasi sumber. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa ditemukan 140 data tindak tutur direktif yang terdiri atas 30 data perintah, 38 data permintaan, 12 data larangan, 25 data nasihat, 16 data ajakan, dan 19 data kritik. Bentuk tindak tutur direktif yang paling dominan adalah permintaan, sedangkan bentuk yang paling sedikit ditemukan adalah larangan. Hasil penelitian juga menunjukkan bahwa tindak tutur direktif dalam film dapat dimanfaatkan sebagai sumber pembelajaran teks drama kelas XI Fase F. Dialog dalam film dapat digunakan untuk membantu peserta didik memahami bentuk, maksud, dan penggunaan bahasa berdasarkan konteks, serta mengembangkan kemampuan menganalisis dialog, karakter, dan konflik dalam drama. Dengan demikian, film 1 Kakak 7 Ponakan dapat menjadi sumber pembelajaran yang kontekstual dalam pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia

doi:10.61132/jupiter.v4i5.1555.abstract: The Pertamina Mandalika International Circuit is a major tourism destination in Lombok. This study develops an aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) system extracting sentiment from 1,772 valid Google Maps reviews filtered from 4,671 raw reviews, covering nine aspects defined via topic modeling and keyword validation. A two-stage IndoBERT pipeline is applied with Focal Loss, mean pooling, a differential learning rate, Back-Translation augmentation, and 5-fold cross-validation with per-aspect threshold tuning. The final model achieves a macro-F1 of 0.882 for aspect detection (accuracy 0.976; exact match accuracy 82.58%; hamming loss 0.024) and a macro-F1 of 0.87 for sentiment classification. Against classical TF-IDF baselines, IndoBERT (macro-F1 0.882) outperforms a linear Support Vector Machine (0.727) and Logistic Regression (0.711) on aspect detection, though a McNemar test shows the gap versus SVM is not statistically significant (p = 0.104), while the gap between SVM and Logistic Regression is significant (p = 0.001). Because labels are produced via weak supervision, additional validation is conducted using human annotation on 313 reviews (17.7% of the data); inter-annotator agreement (Cohen's Kappa) for aspect detection is very low (κ = 0.159), indicating that weak-supervision metrics may not directly reflect ground-truth sentiment accuracy. Venue (41.5%), Scenery (29.9%), and Organization (18.4%) are the most frequently discussed aspects in the reviews. The findings are translated into an actionable promotion strategy matrix, though larger-scale human validation remains necessary before direct application.
